column12: ANONYMIZING DATA FOR PRESERVING PRIVACY DURING USE FOR FEDERATED MACHINE LEARNING
column13: A computer-implemented method for training a global federated learning model using an aggregator server includes training multiple local models at respective local nodes. Each local node selects a set of attributes from its training dataset for training its local model. Each local node generates an anonymized training dataset by using a syntactic anonymization method, and by selecting quasi-identifying attributes from training attributes, and generalizing the quasi-identifying attributes using a syntactic algorithm. Further, each local node computes a syntactic mapping based on equivalence classes produced in the anonymized training dataset. The aggregator server computes a union of mappings received from all the local nodes. Further, federated learning includes training the global federated learning model by iteratively sending, by the local nodes to the aggregator server, parameter updates computed over the local models. The aggregator server aggregates the received parameter updates, and sends the aggregated parameters to the local nodes.

column12: Federal edge learning training method and system combining gradient quantization and bandwidth allocation
column13: The invention discloses a federated edge learning training method and system combining gradient quantization and bandwidth allocation. The method comprises the following steps: a node sends parameter information of own equipment to an edge server; the edge server calculates the channel condition of each node according to the parameter information sent by each node, obtains the channel gain of each uplink channel, solves the optimization problem according to the channel gain, the sending power, the sample number and the computing power, allocates the quantized bit number and bandwidth, and obtains the channel gain of each uplink channel; broadcasting the available quantized bit number and the global model to nodes participating in federated learning; the node calculates a local update gradient according to the global model and local data, quantizes the local update gradient based on the quantization bit number, and sends the quantized local gradient to the edge server; and the edge server aggregates the received gradients and updates the global model. column12: VAE-based medical care federated learning framework determination method

column12: Federal learning system and method for poisoning attack based on differential privacy
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning system and method for poisoning attacks based on differential privacy. column12: Layered differential privacy federal learning method based on Fisher information matrix
column13: The invention discloses a layered differential privacy federated learning method based on a Feixi information matrix, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. In the initial stage of federated learning global training, a client issues a global model to the client, the client starts local training, and in the local training process, the client sends a local model to the client; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, calculating an empirical toll information matrix of model parameters by using a gradient generated by training, measuring the importance of a client model layer by using an average value of elements corresponding to each layer of parameters in the empirical toll information matrix, and then correcting the probability of adding noise to each layer of parameter gradient according to the importance of the layer; then, according to the probability of adding noise in each layer of parameter gradient, carrying out differential selection on the layers, finally, adding differential privacy noise to the selected layers, after local data training is completed, uploading a local model to a server by a client, and then aggregating model parameters uploaded by the client by the server, so that the model parameters are obtained. And the noise interference degree of the whole system is reduced on the premise of meeting the privacy requirement of the client.

column12: Efficient federated learning aggregation method and device with robustness, verifiability and privacy

column13: The method for training the personalized model in the hierarchical federal learning framework is realized. According to the method, a personalized prediction model can be trained for each edge server, and the method has the advantages of fast convergence and high model precision.

column12: Block chain federal learning method based on personalized differential privacy and reputation mechanism

column12: Federated learning communication traffic optimization method and system based on core data set
column13: The invention relates to the field of federated machine learning, and discloses a federated learning communication traffic optimization method and system based on a core data set. The method comprisesthe following steps that: firstly, each terminal user screens out core data from local training data in parallel, a cloud center constructs a sparse global model according to a set sparse proportion,and each terminal user performs local model training according to the screened local core data to obtain a local model update; then, in order to enable the global model to adapt to local core data better, the cloud center adjusts the network structure of the global model according to global model update obtained by an aggregating local model update, including the two steps of removing unimportantconnection and adding important connection; and finally, the cloud center distributes the adjusted global model to each terminal user, and iterates the above steps until the global model converges. By screening the core data from the terminal user and deploying the adaptive sparse network model, the uploading of the model parameters of the terminal user and the cloud center is reduced, and the problem of high communication cost caused by frequent transmission of high-dimensional update parameters between the terminal user and the cloud center in the federated learning technology is essentially solved.

column12: Privacy preserving collaborative learning with domain adaptation
column13: Herein are techniques for domain adaptation of a machine learning (ML) model. These techniques impose differential privacy onto federated learning by the ML model. In an embodiment, each of many client devices receive, from a server, coefficients of a general ML model. For respective new data point(s), each client device operates as follows. Based on the new data point(s), a respective private ML model is trained. Based on the new data point(s), respective gradients are calculated for the coefficients of the general ML model. Random noise is added to the gradients to generate respective noisy gradients. A combined inference may be generated based on: the private ML model, the general ML model, and one of the new data point(s). The noisy gradients are sent to the server. column12: Communication compression method based on model weight distribution in federated learning

column12: Byzantine attack defending method in decentralized federated learning based on block chain
column13: The invention discloses a Byzantine attack defending method in decentralized federated learning based on a block chain. The method mainly solves the problem that in the prior art, when a Byzantine attack occurs in decentralized federated learning, the calculation overhead and the communication overhead are too high. The method comprises the following implementation steps: 1) a local user obtains a pre-trained model and establishes a reputation contrast relationship; 2) a local user trains the model and then transmits the model, and then generates a signature message and broadcasts the signature message; (3) the local user verifies the signature message and then stores the signature message, and when a certain number of signature messages are stored, blocks are generated, consensus is conducted on the blocks through an improved PBFT consensus algorithm, and then uplink is conducted; and 4) updating the reputation contrast relationship of the transmission and broadcast behaviors of other local users by the local user, then adjusting the generation difficulty of the signature message, and repeating the execution process until the model converges. According to the method, the calculation overhead and the communication overhead in the prior art can be effectively reduced, and the Byzantine robustness of decentralized federated learning can be improved.

column12: Federal learning performance optimization technology based on random hierarchical gradient updating
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning performance optimization technology based on random hierarchical gradient updating, and aims to solve the problem that the recognition precision of a global model is greatly influenced by the local overfitting phenomenon of federated learning due to the data isomerism phenomenon of federated learning, so that the model uploading process is divided into a random cycle wheel and a global cycle wheel; each client in the random cycle selects part of hierarchical gradients according to the same random rule and uploads the part of hierarchical gradients to the server, then the server only aggregates the uploaded part of gradients, all the hierarchical gradients of the model are uploaded to each client in the global cycle, and the server aggregates all the gradients and continuously iterates until the model is converged.

column12: Big model training method based on federated learning
column13: The invention relates to a big model method based on federated learning. Differential privacy protection is carried out on model classification, so that the data protection effect is improved; the monitoring and feedback module is used for monitoring whether privacy leakage exists in the data or not, reducing information leakage and facilitating maintenance and updating of a privacy protection mechanism; and data backup prevents data transmission from being affected by terminal disconnection, and improves the training effect.

column12: Full-connection neural network model aggregation method in federated learning scene
column13: The invention discloses a full-connection neural network model aggregation method in a federated learning scene, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps that hyper-parameters and parameters of a neural network are issued to all users providing independent models through a central server, and each user establishes a unified neural network according to the hyper-parameters obtained from the central server; each user sets an initial value of the neural network as a parameter obtained from the central server, and performs respective neural network training by using respective data; after respective neural network training is finished, each user uploads respective neural network parameters, namely, user model parameters, to the central server; the central server collects all user model parameters and aggregates the user model parameters to obtain a joint model; the central server judges whether the number of cycles is reached or not; and through layer-by-layer approximation of features obtained by each client model, a unified model suitable for all users to use can be obtained. The global accuracy and generalization ability of the joint model are improved.

column12: Communication method and system for heterogeneous federated learning of industrial Internet of Things
column13: The invention discloses a communication method and system for industrial Internet of Things heterogeneous federated learning, and belongs to the technical field of federated learning system communication optimization. According to the technical scheme, the method comprises the following steps: establishing a federal learning architecture; initializing a global model, randomly selecting a client node to issue the global model, and carrying out local model training; triggering a multi-granularity quantization module to quantify the updated local model parameters; the central server receives the model update uploaded by each equipment node, and transmits the quantized model update to a dequantization module for dequantization; and the central server sends a dequantized result to a stage aggregation module to realize model parameter aggregation, iteration is repeated until the federal learning reaches a preset training round number, training is ended, and the trained model is deployed to factory intelligent terminal equipment. According to the method, the communication cost of each equipment node is greatly reduced while the model precision is maintained, the global model convergence is accelerated, and the method has good generalization.

column12: Task scheduling method and system for federated learning and privacy computing

column12: COMMUNICATION METHOD, DEVICE, AND SYSTEM BASED ON MODEL TRAINING
column13: This application provides a model training-based communication method and apparatus, and a system, relates to the field of communication technologies, and is applied to a system including a central server and a communication device, to effectively decrease a data amount of a parameter transmitted between the communication device and the central server, and improve communication efficiency of a federated learning process without a loss of model training precision. The method includes: The communication device determines a change amount of a first model parameter value. If the communication device determines, based on the change amount of the first model parameter value, that a first model parameter is stable, the communication device stops sending an update amount of the first model parameter value to the central server in a preset time period. The update amount of the first model parameter value is determined by the communication device based on user data in a process of performing model training. The communication device receives a second model parameter value sent by the central server. In the preset time period, the second model parameter value does not include the first model parameter value.

column12: Lateral federal learning method and system based on localized differential privacy
column13: The invention discloses a lateral federated learning method and system based on localized differential privacy, and belongs to the technical field of federated learning, and the method comprises the steps: enabling each participant to locally train data, and generating model parameters; performing binary coding on the model parameters by each participant; each participant performs disturbance processing on the binary codes; each participant sends the disturbed binary code to the coordinator; the coordinator receives the disturbed binary codes and performs decoding correction; the coordinator performs numerical conversion on the corrected binary character string according to the bit weight; the coordinator calculates global model parameters according to a numerical conversion result; and the coordinator sends the global model parameters to each participant. According to the invention, each participant carries out differential disturbance processing on the local data locally and then sends the data after disturbance processing to the server of the coordinator, dependence on a centralized server is not needed, the privacy protection effect is improved, and the privacy leakage risk is reduced.

column12: Apparatuses, computer program products, and computer-implemented methods for privacy-preserving federated learning
column13: Privacy-preserving federated learning apparatuses, systems, computer program products, and methods are provided that generate an updated global model based on a set of client models while maintaining privacy regarding the data values embodying each client model and the updated global model. In this regard, masked client models are utilized, which cryptographically obfuscate data values embodying the client model while still enabling combination, or “aggregation,” of the masked client models to generate a masked updated global model. The masked updated global model similarly includes obfuscated data values embodying the updated global model, but may be unmasked to reveal the true values of the updated global model for use. Some embodiments utilize specific steps for communication between environments, systems, devices, and/or the like, to ensure the masked models can only be unmasked by intended entities.

column12: METHOD FOR VERIFYING MODEL UPDATE
column13: The federated learning system includes a moderator and client devices. Each client device performs a method for verifying model update as follows: receiving a hash function and a general model; training a client model according to the general model and raw data; calculating a difference as an update parameter between the general model and the client model, sending the update parameter to the moderator; inputting the update parameter to the hash function to generate a hash value; sending the hash value to other client devices, and receiving other hash values; summing all the hash values to generate a trust value; receiving an aggregation parameter calculated according to the update parameters; inputting the aggregation parameter to the hash function to generate a to-be-verified value; and updating the client model according to the aggregation parameter when the to-be-verified value equals the trust value.

column12: Federal learning training model based on batch increment mode
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning training model based on a batch increment mode. The method belongs to the field of federated learning training, and comprises the following operation steps: proposing to build a federated learning framework with incremental learning; reserving a historical forgetting problem existing in incremental learning in the federated learning framework; for a historical forgetting problem, selecting a targeted loss function optimization model by constructing local loss update; and establishing a federated learning local increment self-attention mechanism model, so that the memory of a federated learning framework with incremental learning during data training is enhanced, and the accuracy of task classification in a federated learning training model is improved. According to the method, the average value of the loss of all local models at present is added to the loss of the local models, so that the influence of quick forgetting of incremental learning is reduced; in addition, the self-attention mechanism is used in the most classical convolutional neural network, key information is reserved through the attention mechanism, feature extraction and selection are better carried out, and incremental learning memory is enhanced.

column12: Transverse federated learning-oriented trust management method
column13: The invention discloses a transverse federated learning-oriented trust management method. The method comprises the following steps of: issuing a federated learning task by a main aggregation server; the main aggregation server selects a candidate higher than a certain threshold value to participate in a federated learning process based on the credibility of the candidates; the candidates are users who are interested in the federal learning task and select to participate in the federal learning task; a set composed of the candidates higher than a certain threshold value is a participant set; the main aggregation server receives the local model parameters, aggregates the received local model parameter information according to an aggregation rule, and updates and sends the aggregated model back to the participants; in each round of iterative interaction process of the aggregation server and the participants, the aggregation server performs anomaly detection on local models of the participants, records behavior information of the participants, performs trust degree evaluation on the participants according to the behavior information of the participants, and performs trust degree evaluation on the participants according to the trust degree evaluation; the evaluation result is used for user selection when the aggregation server issues the task next time.

column12: Federal learning global model training method based on differential privacy and quantification
column13: A federated learning global model training method based on differential privacy and quantification comprises the following steps that a central server issues a pre-trained federated learning global model, a local model gradient of each local user is generated, and noise adding, threshold quantification and compression quantification is sequentially performed on the local model gradient of each local user, and the compressed and quantified local model gradient is uploaded to the central server, the central server performs weighted aggregation on the uploaded local model gradient by the central server, updates a global model, issues the global model to each local user, and training is ended when the privacy budget value of each local user is exhausted or the federal learning global model is converged. According to the method, on the premise that the precision of the federal learning global model is not lost, the privacy of local users is protected, the communication overhead in the transmission process is reduced, and the training efficiency of the federal learning global model is improved.

column12: Gradient-free efficient longitudinal federated learning method and system based on layer-by-layer optimization
column13: The invention discloses a gradient-free efficient longitudinal federated learning method and system based on layer-by-layer optimization. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out initial configuration on a longitudinal federated learning model, obtaining feature data of each participant and setting model parameters; considering the obtained model parameters and the calculation resource limitation of each participant, a Moore-Penrose generalized inverse matrix is adopted to replace the traditional gradient, and the communication overhead is reduced and the model training efficiency is improved through layer-by-layer optimization. column12: Mobile edge cache optimization method based on federated learning
column13: The invention relates to a mobile edge cache optimization method based on effective federated learning, and belongs to the field of Internet of Things and artificial intelligence. According to the method, the situation that the user mobility and the content popularity change continuously in the range of a single base station is considered, and the cache hit rate is increased by predicting the content popularity and placing the request content in an edge cache in advance. The method specifically comprises the steps of obtaining a user moment trajectory table to simulate a moving path of a user by using an RWP random path point model, selecting the user participating in FL local training in a clustering and threshold value combination mode in consideration of local training consumption, performing global model aggregation by using an attention mechanism control model weight, and performing global prediction according to an obtained global prediction model. And the predicted request content is cached to the server in advance to improve the cache hit rate. According to the method, a federated learning method is utilized, client selection and weight aggregation are optimized, and the effective federated learning method is realized, so that local training consumption is reduced, and the cache hit rate is increased.

column12: Federal learning system and method based on DAG block chain

column12: Collaborative fair federated learning framework based on trust evaluation mechanism

column12: Federal learning-oriented differential privacy protection method and device

According to the method, the added noise can fit the characteristics of the model weight information uploaded by the current client, so that higher model precision is obtained, and the privacy budget in differential privacy protection is effectively reduced.

column12: MANAGEMENT OF FEDERATED LEARNING
column13: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A server (e.g., a network entity, a model repository) may select user equipment (UEs) to participate in a federated learning procedure for training a predictive model. Based on selecting the UEs, the server may determine a set of training parameters for a training configuration for the federated learning procedure. The server may transmit an indication of the training configuration to the UEs. The server may activate the federated learning procedure by transmitting an activation indication to the UEs. Each UE may locally train the predictive model according to the training configuration, and may report the model parameters to the server. The server may aggregate the reported model parameters into an updated model parameter set. The server may assign an updated parameter set identifier (PS ID) to the updated model parameter set and may inform the UEs of the updated PS ID.

The method comprises: a first node trains an ith-round local model on the basis of local training data to determine gradient information of the trained (i+1)th-round local model (202), respectively clips and quantizes each piece of first sub-gradient information in the gradient information of the (i+1)th-round local model on the basis of gradient clipping and quantization rules to obtain each piece of second sub-gradient information (203), merges every m pieces of second sub-gradient information among all pieces of second sub-gradient information according to a gradient merging rule to obtain n types of third sub-gradient information (204), and performs homomorphic encryption on the n types of third sub-gradient information to obtain n types of ciphertexts (205), and sends the n types of ciphertexts to a blockchain (206). Because each piece of first sub-gradient information in the gradient information of the local model is respectively clipped, quantized and merged, and then homomorphic encryption is performed thereon, computing resource consumption generated by the homomorphic encryption can be reduced, and network resources consumed in the ciphertext transmission process can be reduced.

column12: Federal learning uplink compression quantization joint design method and system
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning uplink compression quantization joint design method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the number of communication resources and to-be-uploaded parameters of a user; introducing an optimization problem with constraints, and solving the optimization problem according to the to-be-uploaded parameters of the user based on communication resource quantity condition constraints to obtain a sparse budget and a quantization bit; sparsification is carried out on to-be-uploaded parameters of the user according to the sparse budget; performing random uniform quantization compression on the to-be-uploaded parameters of the user after sparsification according to the quantization digits; and uploading to a server for decompression. The system comprises an acquisition module, a solving module, a rarefaction module, a compression module and a decompression module. By using the invention, the compression error can be further reduced under the same communication overhead by minimizing the compression uplink transmission parameter error. The federated learning uplink compression quantization joint design method and system can be widely applied to the technical field of federated learning uplink compression.

column12: Hierarchical privacy protection federated learning method based on core data set
column13: The invention discloses a hierarchical privacy protection federated learning method based on a core data set, relates to the field of federated learning security and the field of data privacy, and in order to achieve the purpose, according to the technical scheme, firstly, a terminal user divides original data into a core data set and a non-core data set according to the data core degree; secondly, Gaussian noise of different privacy budgets is added to the core data set and the non-core data set respectively; then, the noised core and non-core data sets are merged for local model training. And finally, the central server gathers the local models, updates the local models to obtain a global model, issues the global model to the terminal user, and iterates the above steps until the global model converges. According to the method, relatively less noise is added in a core data set, but not relatively more noise is added in the core data set, so that precision loss of model training caused by a differential privacy mechanism is relieved, privacy protection intensity is further quantified, privacy budget distribution is dynamically adjusted according to model precision, and model availability and convergence are improved.

column12: Active content caching method based on federated learning
column13: The invention discloses an active content caching method based on federated learning, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. On the premise of ensuring the cache hit rate, a problem of data sharing between neighbor users is effectively avoided, so private data of the user is safer.

column12: Federal learning security aggregation method suitable for edge computing scene
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning security aggregation method suitable for an edge computing scene. The method comprises the following steps: (1) an edge node modifies a communication topological graph structure between terminals from a fully connected graph to a terminal connected topological graph based on a minimum spanning tree; (2) training a federal learning model by each terminal by using local data, and communicating with the neighbor terminal in a key broadcasting manner according to the modified terminal communication topological graph; (3) each terminal calculates a mask and is used for encrypting the model gradient; (4) the edge node receives the encrypted model gradient transmitted by the terminal and performs local aggregation; and (5) the cloud computing processing center receives the local aggregation model gradient, performs one-time aggregation to form a global aggregation model, and issues the global aggregation model to the edge node to provide service for the terminal. According to the method, the problem of privacy disclosure in federated learning is solved, meanwhile, a large amount of extra calculation and communication overhead is avoided, and the convergence speed of the model is increased.

column12: Defense method for federated learning neuron gradient attack

column12: METHODS AND APPARATUSES FOR DEFENSE AGAINST ADVERSARIAL ATTACKS ON FEDERATED LEARNING SYSTEMS
column13: Methods and computing apparatuses for defending against model poisoning attacks in federated learning are described. One or more updates are obtained, where each update represents a respective difference between parameters (e.g. weights) of the global model and parameters (e.g. weights) of a respective local model. Random noise perturbation and normalization are applied to each update, to obtain one or more perturbed and normalized updates. The parameters (e.g. weights) of the global model are updated by adding an aggregation of the one or more perturbed and normalized updates to the parameters (e.g. weights) of the global model. And, one or more learned parameters (e.g. weights) of the previous global model are also perturbed using random noise.

column12: METHODS AND APPARATUSES FOR DEFENSE AGAINST ADVERSARIAL ATTACKS ON FEDERATED LEARNING SYSTEMS
column13: Methods and computing apparatuses for defending against model poisoning attacks in federated learning are described. One or more updates are obtained, where each update represents a respective difference between parameters (e.g. weights) of the global model and parameters (e.g. weights) of a respective local model. Random noise perturbation and normalization are applied to each update, to obtain one or more perturbed and normalized updates. The parameters (e.g. weights) of the global model are updated by adding an aggregation of the one or more perturbed and normalized updates to the parameters (e.g. weights) of the global model. In some examples, one or more learned parameters (e.g. weights) of the previous global model are also perturbed using random noise.

The key management system comprises: a user interface module used for receiving a request of a user; a key service processing module which is configured to generate a visible key space specific to the user, wherein a key in the visible key space specific to the user can be used for responding to a request of the user; a key generation module; and a key storage module. The state of each secret key stored by the secret key storage module is determined according to whether the federated learning task corresponding to the secret key is finished or not and whether the security audit requirement corresponding to the federated learning task is met or not. The method not only can meet the requirements of various federated learning frameworks and software products for normalization and security, but also considers the requirements of subsequent security auditing and the differences of different individuals of the same participant or different participants in the aspects of permission, privacy, isolation requirements and the like.

column12: Federated learning-based noise label correction method
column13: The invention provides a federated learning-based noise label correction method. The method comprises the following steps of: sending local model parameters updated by a client according to local training data and a corresponding sample data volume to a server; obtaining global model parameters calculated by the server according to the local model parameters updated by the client and other clients and the corresponding sample data volume; enabling the client to calculate a plurality of local class references indicating the average prediction probability of different classes according to the global model parameters and the local training data and send the local class references to the server; and obtaining a plurality of global class references calculated by the server according to the plurality of local class references, and performing noise label correction on the local training data of the client based on the global model parameters and the global class references. When the correction method is applied to a federated learning system, information enhancement is realized, data loss and dependence on an additional reference set are reduced, and the accuracy of federated learning training structure testing is effectively improved.

column12: Dynamic Internet of Vehicles federated learning method based on node segmentation
column13: The invention provides a dynamic Internet of Vehicles federated learning method based on node segmentation. A node distribution map is formed based on geographic position distribution of a server and a vehicle terminal, and a vehicle terminal node selects a server node closest to the vehicle terminal node in the node distribution map to form federated learning of a client-server architecture; and grouping the vehicle terminal nodes which are not connected with the server by using a minimum generation tree algorithm. And the client connected with the server performs federated learning of a client-server architecture, and other node groups perform federated learning of a peer-to-peer architecture. According to the method provided by the invention, the nodes which are not uniformly distributed at the geographic position are grouped nearby for federated learning, so that the participation degree of the vehicle terminal on the federated learning at the geographic position is improved, and the influence of overlong response time caused by excessive nodes is reduced through grouping.

column12: Model training method and system based on federated learning
column13: The invention discloses a model training method and system based on federated learning. The method comprises the steps that a central server sends parameters to all node devices; each node device performs neural network model training based on the parameters and the local data set, and obtains a gradient value; each node device adds noise to the respective gradient value to obtain a noise-added gradient value and sends the noise-added gradient value to the central server, and the central server calculates the sum of the noise-added gradient values; each node device calculates the sum of the noise values in a point-to-point mode and sends the sum of the noise values to the central server; and the central server calculates to obtain a gradient value sum according to the noise adding gradientvalue sum and the noise value sum, obtains updated parameters based on the gradient value sum and an updated neural network model, and distributes the updated parameters to each node device. column12: Edge federal image classification method based on local differential privacy
column13: The invention provides an edge federal image classification method based on local differential privacy. column12: Differential privacy and denoising data protection method under vertical federated framework
column13: The invention discloses a differential privacy and denoising data protection method under a vertical federation framework. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a deep learning framework based on vertical federation; a local differential privacy budget is set, the local differential privacy budget is distributed to each local server, each local server disturbs own data after obtaining the local differential privacy budget, the local server is trained, and an initial embedded vector is obtained; uploading the local differential privacy embedding vector and the initial embedding vector obtained by each local server to a central server; the server splices the local differential privacy embedding and the initial embedding obtained by each participant to obtain a server differential privacy embedding and a server initial embedding; the server differential privacy is embedded into an input denoising layer, the denoising layer is optimized based on server initial embedding, and denoising embedding is obtained; and the de-noising is embedded into the input server model for training, a prediction result is obtained, and the accuracy is calculated based on the prediction result until the accuracy converges.

column12: Federated learning system equipment node selection method and device

According to the federated learning system equipment node selection method provided by the invention, the system energy consumption of the node equipment and the accuracy of the output result are comprehensively considered, the optimal selection of the equipment nodes by the server is realized, the accuracy of the system training model is improved, and the communication overhead energy consumption and the calculation energy consumption of the system are saved.

column12: 6G medical internet of things equipment data security access method and system based on federated learning architecture
column13: The invention provides a federated learning architecture-based 6G medical Internet of Things equipment data security access method and system, and relates to the technical field of data security. According to the scheme, a federal learning architecture is composed of a medical internet-of-things equipment layer, an edge computing layer and a cloud layer, and the three layers are connected through a 6G network; each hospital generates a local model according to data collected from the medical Internet of Things equipment cluster and sends all the local models to a cloud layer through a 6G network; executing encryption local model aggregation on the cloud layer to generate a global model; encrypted global model reasoning is executed on a cloud layer, and confidentiality of data input by a model owner is kept by applying a security policy in a model reasoning stage. According to the encrypted federated learning architecture constructed by the invention, by applying a security policy, encrypting local model aggregation and encrypting global model reasoning, the federated learning participants are prevented from model inversion or member reasoning attack and the like, and the security of the 6G medical Internet of Things application is improved.

column12: DISCRETE VARIABLE PREPROCESSING METHOD IN VERTICAL FEDERATED LEARNING
column13: Disclosed in the present invention is a discrete variable preprocessing method in vertical federated learning, for use in solving the problem of high-cardinality discrete variable encoding in vertical federated learning. The method is particularly suitable for preprocessing of high-cardinality discrete variables such as geographic positions such as native places in a communication anti-fraud scenario, and using Target-Encoding technology to perform high-cardinality discrete variable encoding while multiple parties have performed encrypted ID alignment. An algorithm provided by the present invention can well solve the problems of irregular feature encoding and the curse of dimensionality, and can well protect privacy data in vertical federation; in addition, the Cross-validation thought can be introduced in the preprocessing process to solve the overfitting problem caused by label leakage. The present invention expands discrete feature processing methods in the field of vertical federated learning, and encoding is performed while protecting privacy data of both parties, thereby improving the accuracy of a model; and according to a completely decentralized high-cardinality discrete feature preprocessing method, few feature quantities are generated after feature encoding, and feature dimension explosion cannot be caused.

The method comprises the following steps: a central server sends an original global model to an edge computing server; the edge computing server splits the original global model to obtain a plurality of sub-models; sending at least part of the sub-models to a plurality of clients for deployment, and deploying the rest of the sub-models in the edge computing server; performing joint training on the original global model through data interaction between the plurality of clients and the edge computing server to obtain a new intermediate model; and the central server fuses the new intermediate model and the original global model to obtain a target global model. According to the technical scheme, the federated learning system is deployed by utilizing the edge computing power, so that the training pressure of the client is relieved, and the communication efficiency of the client and the server is improved.

column12: Federal learning method and system for communication control of industrial Internet of Things
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning method and system for collaborative learning of industrial Internet of Things equipment. The federated learning system comprises a cloud server layer, an edge computing center layer and a terminal equipment layer. The cloud server is responsible for aggregation of a global model, the edge computing center is responsible for training of a local model, data cannot go out of the edge computing center all the time, data safety and privacy are guaranteed, data samples which are not inferred correctly by the global model in continuous multi-round federated learning training are recorded in the federated learning training process, and the data samples are stored in the cloud server. column12: Multi-device collaborative diagnosis method and system based on sparse filtering and federated learning
column13: The invention discloses a multi-device collaborative diagnosis method and system based on sparse filtering and federated learning. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, designing a sparse filter as a personalized network to extract sparse private fault features of each device from an original vibration signal; and secondly, an automatic encoder network is constructed for each device, federated learning is adopted to fuse the automatic encoder networks trained by each device, the fused common network can strengthen common fault features among different devices, and a federated framework protects data privacy security in a model training process. And finally, integrating fault features extracted by the personalized network and the common network, and training a classifier to output a final diagnosis result. According to the method, the problems of unbalanced fault data, incomplete fault types, poor migration precision of a single-device diagnosis scheme and the like can be effectively solved.

column12: Label reasoning attack method in longitudinal federated learning scene
column13: The invention provides a label reasoning attack method in a longitudinal federated learning scene. The method comprises the following steps: a passive party device end with data features participates in training of a federated model in a longitudinal federated learning scene according to a preset training protocol, and records a gradient vector returned by an active party device end with a data label in the longitudinal federated learning scene; calculating a # imgabs0 # norm value of the gradient vector by the passive party equipment end with the data characteristics, and performing curve fitting according to the # imgabs1 # norm value to obtain a gradient norm change curve; comparing the slope of the gradient norm change curve with a preset threshold value by the passive device end with the data characteristics to obtain a comparison result; and carrying out abnormal gradient vector sampling on the recorded gradient vector by the passive side equipment end with the data characteristics according to a comparison result, and generating a classification boundary based on a sampling result so as to complete label reasoning attack.

column12: Federal learning method based on graph neural network and bidirectional deep knowledge distillation

column12: Aggregation server selection method for decentralized federated learning

column12: Secure and efficient federal learning method and system based on secret sharing and differential privacy

column12: Model parameter updating method for distributed federated learning
column13: The invention belongs to the field of machine learning, discloses a model parameter updating method for distributed federated learning, and solves the problems of precision loss and low convergence rate caused by discarding of local correlation information implied by gradient values in a communication compression scheme adopted in a model parameter updating process in the prior art. According to the method, an edge node calculates a gradient value matrix of model parameters of a current round through a back propagation algorithm by using a locally stored training sample, and then compresses the gradient value matrix by using a pooling operator to obtain a sparse gradient matrix of the current round and uploads the sparse gradient matrix to a central server; according to the received sparse gradient matrix of the current round of each specified edge node, the central server updates the model parameters of the current round by using a distributed gradient descent algorithm to obtain updated model parameters, if the model parameters reach the required preset precision, the model parameters are output as final model parameters, otherwise, the model parameters are output. And if not, distributing the updated model parameters to each edge node again, and performing the next round of iteration.

column12: FEDERATED LEARNING METHOD BASED ON PARTIAL DECRYPTION KEY

column12: Federated learning model fusion strategy based on reinforcement learning
column13: The invention provides a federated learning model fusion strategy based on reinforcement learning. column12: Method for realizing multi-server efficient federated learning through air computing
column13: The invention discloses a method for realizing multi-server efficient federated learning through air computing, which belongs to the technical field of wireless communication, and comprises the following steps: S1, each user respectively keeps a part of data set and can receive federated learning models and corresponding parameter quantities from different server access points; s2, performing optimization operation on a local data set by each user by adopting different models, and updating a state parameter vector of each federated learning model; s3, converting the updated parameter vector into a gradient vector, and sending the gradient vector to the corresponding AP; s4, carrying out gradient superposition on sending signals of all users through an air computing technology, and converting the sending signals into M gradient superposition vectors; s5, superposing the M same-direction signals in one channel through a same-direction OTA (Over the Air) aggregation technology; and S6, each server performs unbiased estimation on the corresponding sending signal according to the channel characteristics and the received signal, updates the federated learning model parameters according to the result, and enters a new round of iteration.

column12: Communication optimization method based on federated learning
column13: The invention provides a communication optimization method based on federated learning, and belongs to the technical field of federated machine learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining local gradient core features uploaded by each client; the local gradient core feature refers to data extracted by preprocessing target data by each client, training a local model and performing singular value decomposition on the local model; sketch gradient compression and sketch gradient aggregation are carried out on the local gradient core features, first k sparse parameter matrixes are extracted, a federated average aggregation algorithm is carried out on the first k sparse parameter matrixes to obtain a global model, and the global model is sent to each client; and calculating an accumulated gradient error value and a gradient error compensation value of each client, adaptively adjusting a gradient which needs to be compensated by the local gradient core feature and a weight when sketch gradient aggregation is performed on the local gradient core feature, and then performing iteration. column12: Federal learning method fusing adaptive weight distribution and personalized differential privacy
column13: The invention provides a federal learning method fusing adaptive weight distribution and personalized differential privacy. The method comprises the following steps: a client receives a global model issued by a current server, and performs model training on local data to obtain a local model; the client adds different degrees of Gaussian noise to the model update information according to the privacy budget, and sends the Gaussian noise to the server; the server performs weighted aggregation on all the model update information according to the aggregation weight of each client, and reissues a global model obtained after aggregation to the client; and the server redistributes the aggregation weight of each client through a self-adaptive weight distribution algorithm every time the global model is updated by a set number of rounds. According to the method, the privacy preferences of different clients are met in the federated learning training process, meanwhile, the influence of personalization on a global model is emphatically considered, the aggregation weight can be dynamically adjusted according to the performance of the clients, and the clients with high data quality and low added noise are automatically screened out.

column12: Medical data sharing privacy protection method based on block chain by utilizing federated learning
column13: The invention relates to a medical data sharing privacy protection method based on a block chain by utilizing federated learning, and belongs to the technical field of block chain privacy protection. According to the method, a federal learning technology is used, and joint modeling is carried out on data under the condition that original data are not away from the local. In addition, differential privacy noise is added in a local model training process, so that an attacker is prevented from inferring sensitive information of a user by using a learned model. The block chain is used for storing and sharing the global model, so that the problems of single-point failure and the like of the centralized aggregator are avoided. In order to relieve the storage pressure on the block chain, a trained local model is uploaded to an interstellar file system, and then file hash is calculated to serve as a transaction to be uploaded to the block chain. The aggregated global training model is stored in a block chain account book after being subjected to consensus verification. Compared with the prior art, the method has good privacy, reliability and expandability.

The node for federated learning is determined through the expectation of each electric energy data node, and reliability evaluation is performed on each target node, so that the reliability of obtaining the electric energy data node participating in federated learning is improved, and the accuracy of reliability evaluation of the electric energy data is further improved.

column12: Framework design method for multi-task air federated learning with integrated sensing and computing energy
column13: The invention discloses a method for designing a multi-task air federated learning framework integrating sensorship and calculation energy, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the iterative updating of a transmitting precoding and a receiver combination vector through an alternating optimization method; each round of federal learning model updating comprises the following steps. Firstly, a base station selects a mobile device to participate in federated learning according to energy consumption limitation, the selected mobile device carries out local model training according to local data, after training is completed, a pilot signal is sent to the base station to obtain accurate channel state information, and then local model uploading is carried out. And after receiving the global model subjected to air calculation aggregation, the base station decodes and analyzes the global model, and then broadcasts the global model to carry out next round of federated learning. According to the method, in a multi-task air federated learning system under a non-independent identically-distributed scene condition, perception information and an energy consumption state of mobile equipment are considered, and a global model is updated by adjusting a transceiver algorithm, so that energy consumption and communication loss are reduced.

In the prediction stage, the trained global generation model can be utilized to generate more secure shared data, and effective data support is provided for more machine learning and deep learning tasks.

column12: Method and system for detecting backdoor attack in federated learning based on cooperative game theory
column13: The invention relates to a method and system for detecting backdoor attacks in federated learning based on a cooperative game theory, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining gradient data uploaded by each node, and calculating the gradient weight of each round and the Shapley value of the cooperative game theory according to the gradient data; fitting a first curve according to the gradient weight of each node, and constructing a first curve cluster consisting of the first curves of the plurality of nodes; fitting a second curve according to the Shapley value of each node, and constructing a second curve cluster consisting of the second curves of a plurality of nodes; and judging whether the node to be detected is an attacker or not according to the local outlier factors of the first curve cluster and the second curve cluster of the node to be detected. column12: Longitudinal federated learning system optimization method, apparatus and device and readable storage medium
column13: The invention discloses a longitudinal federated learning system optimization method, apparatus and device and a readable storage medium. The longitudinal federated learning system optimization methodcomprises the steps: obtaining a sample alignment result obtained by conducting sample alignment on local training sample sets of all participation devices, wherein data characteristics of samples owned by all the participation devices are not completely the same; according to the sample alignment result, cooperating with each participation device to obtain multiple groups of input data with different data dimensions; and training a preset to-be-trained machine learning model with variable input data feature dimensions according to the multiple groups of input data to obtain a target machinelearning model. According to the longitudinal federated learning system optimization method, when a participant of longitudinal federated learning uses the model trained through longitudinal federatedlearning, the participant can use the model independently without cooperation of other participants, so that the application range of longitudinal federated learning is expanded.

column12: Highly-efficient and robust federated learning method and system based on super-dimensional calculation
column13: The invention discloses a communication efficient and robust federated learning method and system based on super-dimensional calculation, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the sample coding, and obtaining a super-dimensional vector; aggregating the super-dimensional vectors according to classification categories; carrying out retraining on the initial local model based on the super-dimensional vector, and carrying out convergence judgment; binarization is carried out on the local model; performing aggregation operation on the binarized local model to obtain a global model; updating the initial local model based on the global model; and model retraining updating is circularly carried out, and a local model is output. The system comprises a sample coding module, a local model initialization module, a retraining module, a binarization module, a global aggregation module, a local model updating module and a local model output module. By using the method, the robustness of the model in the transmission process can be improved, the communication efficiency can be improved, and meanwhile, the model is ensured to have relatively good precision performance. The method can be widely applied to the technical field of federal learning.

column12: Industrial Internet of Things equipment federal learning participation method based on edge calculation and transfer learning
column13: Along with the development of artificial intelligence and Internet of Things, the industry 4.0 era has arrived. According to IBM prediction, along with continuous popularization of the 5G technology, the Internet of Things technology will be more widely applied in factories. In recent years, federal learning has become a hot topic for industrial Internet of Things researchers. However, many devices in the industrial internet of things have the problem of low computing power at present, so that the devices cannot well execute tasks of training and updating models in federated learning. In order to solve the problem, edge calculation is introduced into the industrial Internet of Things, so that the equipment can complete federal learning operation. In order to ensure the security of data transmission, the system introduces a block chain as a main algorithm for equipment authentication. In addition, in order to improve the efficiency and universality of the industrial Internet of Things training mode, transfer learning is introduced to improve the system performance. According to the method, the threshold of participation of low-performance industrial Internet of Things equipment in federated learning is reduced, the fate that most of the Internet of Things equipment is eliminated in the popularization process of federated learning is avoided, contributions are made to construction of a conservation-minded society in China, the popularization threshold of federated learning is reduced, and the popularization progress of federated learning is accelerated.

column12: Linear regression longitudinal federated learning method based on homomorphic encryption
column13: The invention discloses a linear regression longitudinal federated learning method based on homomorphic encryption. The method comprises the following steps: a) modeling training; and b) two predictions. A minist data set is adopted, and the method comprises the following steps that owner is a data application party, Paillier is used for generating a public and private key pair, consumer is data holding, the product of a feature value and a feature matrix is calculated and sent to owner, the owner calculates a prediction label, the prediction label is obtained through comparison with the actual Y, then the gradient is calculated, the weight of the feature value is updated through the gradient, and training is finished till the model reaches the convergence range. According to the first prediction method, no third party exists, the controller calculates the product of a feature value and a feature matrix and sends the product to the owner, and a predicted value is calculated and returned to the controller. The second prediction method comprises the steps that on the basis of differential privacy, the Call integrates the feature parameters of the two parties and then sends the feature parameters to the controller, and the controller calculates a prediction label and sends a result to the Call. The method is characterized in that in the training stage, the gradient is always encrypted, no third party exists, and excessive feature parameters are not exposed; the prediction stage can prevent collusion attacks.

column12: Federal learning aggregation weight design method for wireless network data isomerism
column13: The invention relates to a federal learning aggregation weight design method for wireless network data isomerism. According to the method, the problem of data distribution heterogeneity caused by non-uniform user distribution in a wireless network is optimized. According to the method, the non-independent identical distribution characteristic of data between users in the wireless network is considered, the data isomerism degree is defined as a parameter for measuring the user data distribution difference in the wireless network, and the parameter is related to training loss of each round generated when the users carry out neural network training. And allocating a proper aggregation weight to each user according to the data isomerism degree calculated by the training loss of the last round. The method provided by the invention solves a core problem of how to perform federated aggregation on an edge server deployed on a base station so as to reduce negative effects of data non-independent identical distribution on model performance.

column12: Anti-collusion Byzantine robust privacy protection federated learning optimization method
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of federated learning and privacy protection, in particular to an anti-collusion Byzantine robust privacy protection federated learning optimization method. The method is composed of a malicious gradient screening mechanism and an anti-collusion Byzantine robust aggregation strategy. Firstly, clients participating in federated learning training select different random numbers to blind local gradients by using a malicious gradient screening mechanism. And then the central server can calculate cosine similarity under the condition of not knowing the local gradient plaintext to screen malicious gradients, and data privacy and model robustness are both considered. Secondly, designing an anti-collusion Byzantine robust aggregation strategy, and weighting local gradients according to cosine similarity calculated by a malicious gradient screening mechanism; and finally, performing weighted aggregation on different local gradients by using weights, and ensuring data privacy by adopting homomorphic encryption in the aggregation process. And a private key is split by adopting a secret sharing technology, and cooperative decryption is needed when the client updates the model, so that collusion attacks among the training entities are resisted.

column12: Continuous incentive method for group crowdfunding game oriented to federated learning
column13: The invention relates to a federated learning-oriented group crowdfunding game continuous incentive method, which aims at the incentive mechanism design problem in a federated learning-oriented group crowdfunding architecture, adopts an incentive mechanism based on a Stackelberg double-layer game framework, and decomposes the mechanism design into three main steps including user selection, reward distribution and continuous incentive process. Firstly, for the problem that user perception data quality is unknown, a user selection problem is modeled into a combined multi-arm bandit problem, and meanwhile, in order to solve the problem of unfair selection among users, a virtual queue technology is introduced to ensure fair selection of the users. Secondly, modeling a federated learning distribution strategy into a two-stage Stackelberg game process to stimulate the user to participate in federated learning training, and determining an optimal pricing strategy of the platform and an optimal training strategy of the user; and finally, in order to ensure that enough users participate in the federal learning training process, proposing a reward incentive strategy based on user reputation, preventing high-reputation users from exiting the system, and ensuring continuous incentive.

column12: Federal learning differential privacy protection method based on model difference sparsification
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning differential privacy protection method based on model difference sparsification, which is provided with a central server and a plurality of clients, an initial global model is generated in the central server, and the central server issues the global model to each client participating in training. Each client participating in training performs multiple times of local training on the global model by using local data to obtain a local model, the local model is subtracted from the global model to obtain a model difference value, the model difference value is subjected to sparse processing, cutting and noise adding, the model difference value is uploaded to the central server, the central server aggregates a plurality of received model difference values, and the acquired model difference values are subjected to data processing; and subtracting the aggregated model difference from the global model to obtain a new global model, and iterating the steps for a plurality of times to obtain a final global model. According to the method, an enemy can be effectively prevented from reversely deducing the private data information of the client from the model parameters, and meanwhile, the availability of the model can be improved and the communication overhead can be reduced.

column12: Defense method for cluster federated learning attack, terminal and storage medium
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of machine learning, and discloses a defense method for cluster federated learning attacks, a terminal and a storage medium. The defense method is used for defending clustering failure caused by model poisoning attack on cluster federal learning, and comprises the following steps of: firstly, calculating cosine similarity between any two clients, performing clustering operation on the cosine similarity between the clients based on a clustering HDBSCAN algorithm, and separating malicious clients from benign clients. Then calculating a set of Euclidean distances between the global model and the local model of the client; and then selecting a median in the Euclidean distance set as a cutting upper bound to perform norm cutting, obtaining a cut weight and performing aggregation to obtain a preliminarily corrected global model, and finally adding Gaussian noise to the aggregated global model. According to the method, attackers suffering from model poisoning attacks in cluster federated learning can be efficiently found out, the defense effect is effectively achieved, and the robustness of cluster federated learning is improved.

column12: Non-IID data-based semi-supervised federated learning method
column13: The invention discloses a non-IID data-based semi-supervised federated learning method, solves the problem that existing federated learning lacks marked data, and belongs to the technical field of federated learning application. The method comprises the following steps that: 1, a server randomly selects clients with a set proportion F from all clients, and sends a global model omega<t> to the selected clients; 2, the server uses a local optimizer on a marked data set Ds to train a supervision model sigma<t> to obtain a supervision model sigma<t+1>; 3, the kth client uses a local label-free data set to train the received global model omega<t>, obtains an unsupervised model phi<t+1><k> and sends the unsupervised model to the server; 4, the server aggregates the phi<t+1><k> uploaded by the client and obtains a global unsupervised models psi<t+1> of the (t+1) th round; and 5, the server aggregates psi<t+1>, sigma<t+1> and omega<t> to obtain a new global model omega<t+1>, (omega<t+1> = alpha psi<t+1> + beta sigma<t+1> + gamma omega<t>, and t = t + 1), and the steps 1 to 5 are repeated until the global model omega<t+1> converges.

column12: Precision feedback federated learning method for privacy protection
column13: The invention discloses a precision feedback federated learning method for privacy protection. The method comprises the following steps that: 1, each client performs data enhancement on a local data set by using a GAN, and uploads the obtained generated data to a server to form a shared data set; 2, the server initializes the model parameters and broadcasts the model parameters to each client; 3, each client performs local model training by using the downloaded global parameters, and uploads the parameters to the server after training; 4, the server tests each local model to obtain model precision and then generate a new aggregation weight; 5, the server performs model aggregation on the local model by using the aggregation weight; 6, the server performs global training on the aggregated parameters by using the shared data set, and broadcasts the parameters to each client after obtaining a global model; and 7, steps 3-6 are repeated until the model performance meets the requirement. According to the method, the influence on the global model performance caused by non-independent identical distribution of the client data and the training weight of the client can be improved on the premise of protecting the client data.

column12: Training method and system of logistic regression model in longitudinal federated learning
column13: The invention relates to a training method and a prediction method of a logistic regression model in longitudinal federated learning, a longitudinal federated learning system and a storage medium, which are used for completing training of the logistic regression model in the longitudinal federated learning on the premise of not depending on a third party and protecting privacy data of both parties. The training method comprises the following steps: executing the following operations on any one party in the longitudinal federated learning system: receiving a second public key and a second encryption intermediate result sent by the other party; obtaining an encryption gradient based on the existing first encryption intermediate result, the second encryption intermediate result and local first sample data; confusing the encryption gradient to obtain an encryption confusion gradient and sending the encryption confusion gradient to the other party; receiving a plaintext confusion gradient sent by the other party; performing de-confusion on the plaintext confusion gradient to obtain a gradient, and updating a part of local logistic regression models based on the gradient; and carrying out loop iteration until a preset stop condition is met to obtain a trained logistic regression model.

column12: Self-adaptive bilateral distillation personalized federal learning method based on diffusion model

Meanwhile, a conditional diffusion model is introduced to generate high-quality pseudo data, and the aggregated global model is finely adjusted by using the pseudo data. column12: Control method and device for evaluating data value of each participant in federated learning
column13: The invention provides a control method for evaluating the data value of each participant in federated learning. The control method comprises the following steps: a, determining a mathematical expectation V that one participant is added into a joint model in different sequences; b, determining the sum W of contribution scores of all gradients added into the joint model by the participant; c, determining the participant data value based on the mathematical expectation V and the contribution score sum W; and d, repeatedly executing the steps a to c until the data values of all participants are determined. According to the method, two angles influencing the data contribution of each participant, namely the influence of the actual value and marginal effect of the data of each participant on the contribution of each participant, are comprehensively considered, and the data contribution of each participant can be measured more fairly. Meanwhile, the problem that data dimensions or numbers of participants are different is considered, and the probability that the participants enter the joint model in different sequences is continuously updated according to the thought of sampling statistics. The method is simple in process, convenient to use, powerful in function and extremely high in value.

column12: Building space unit cooling load prediction method and system based on federated learning
column13: The invention discloses a building space unit cold load prediction method and system based on federated learning. The method comprises the following steps: respectively training weights of building space unit cold load prediction models of corresponding regions through neural network models distributed in different regions, and calculating air conditioner load prediction values and unit air conditioner load prediction values of the corresponding regions; obtaining the model weight, the air conditioner load prediction value and the unit air conditioner load prediction value of the location with the aggregation value, judging and classifying different location models, and aggregating the weights of the models classified into one class by using a transverse federated learning method; then using a longitudinal federated learning method to aggregate the network load prediction values with weight differences to establish a regression prediction model, and predicting the building space unit cold load according to the regression prediction model; and updating the neural network model of the corresponding zone bit according to the aggregated model weights of the different zone bits. The method has high generalization, the network training efficiency is improved, and the communication cost needed for achieving the air conditioner load prediction function is reduced.

column12: Industrial fault prediction method based on federated learning, graph learning and CNN
column13: The invention provides an industrial fault prediction method based on federated learning, graph learning and CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks), and designs a neural network FG-CNN (Federated Learnings + Graph Learnings + Convolutional Neural Networks) for industrial fault prediction on the basis of a federated learning framework and a graph structure generation thought in combination with a convolutional neural network. The FG-CNN is firstly based on a federated learning framework, common modeling among factories with similar services can be realized on the basis of ensuring data privacy security and legitimacy and compliance, and the effect of an artificial intelligence model is improved. In addition, high-dimensional time series data formed among factories are recorded by different sensors, and some subtle relations always exist among the data recorded by the different sensors, so that how to capture the relations among the sensors and detect and explain the abnormal conditions of the relations has significant influence on a fault prediction result. The FG-CNN can protect the data privacy of each factory and improve the accuracy of model prediction and the generalization of the model while learning the relationship among the features.

column12: Longitudinal federated learning label poisoning method based on adversarial attack

column12: Federated learning classification tree construction method, model construction method and terminal equipment

The method comprises the steps of carryingout the classification of a user sample set according to a first classification feature and a first classification threshold, and obtaining at least two groups of user sample subsets; adding confuseduser samples into the first subset to obtain a second subset; calculating the sum of the first encryption gradient values corresponding to the second subset; after the primary encryption gradient value is subjected to secondary encryption, sending the primary encryption gradient value and the second subset to a second data provider together; receiving the sum of the second encryption gradient values; performing primary decryption on the sum of the second encryption gradient values, and feeding back the sum of the second encryption gradient values, the sum of the first encryption gradient values, the information of the first classification feature and the information of the first classification threshold to the second data provider; receiving information of the optimal classification feature and information of an optimal classification threshold corresponding to the optimal classification feature; and classifying the first subset according to the information of the optimal classification feature and the information of the optimal classification threshold corresponding to the optimal classification feature to form branch nodes of a federated learning classification tree, and constructing the federated learning classification tree.
