column12: Third-party-free logistic regression federated learning model training system and method
column13: The embodiment of the invention provides a third-party-free logic regression federated learning model training system and method, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the system comprises a first device and a second device. The first device generates a public key and a private key, calculates a first inner product and sends the public key and a first encrypted inner product to the second device. The second device calculates a second inner product, encrypts the second inner product, calculates an encryption forward gradient and a second encryption gradient for a second model, and sends the encryption forward gradient and the masked second encryption gradient to the first device. The first device decrypts the encryption forward gradient and the second encryption gradient, sends the second gradient to the second device, calculates a first gradient, and adjusts the first model parameter according to the first gradient. column12: Federal learning method based on attention guidance feature distillation and prototype comparison and alignment

column12: Lightweight privacy protection federated learning method based on chain structure quantification
column13: The invention discloses a lightweight privacy protection federated learning method based on chain structure quantification. The method comprises the following steps: initializing a global model through a central server and adding a mask; determining a list of participants participating in model training; the central server sends the current global model to the selected participant; the participants use local data to train the received global model, iterative training is carried out to update local model parameters, and the local model parameters are quantized and compressed; transmitting to the next participant; the last participant in the user list uploads the quantized and compressed final model parameter packet to the central server; the central server carries out mask removal operation on the obtained global model parameters and carries out dequantization on the global model parameters; and executing multiple rounds of local training, model aggregation and model distribution until model convergence is achieved. According to the invention, the challenges of a traditional chain structure federation learning scheme in the aspects of communication efficiency and privacy protection are solved.

column12: Electrocardiogram analysis method and device based on federated learning and related equipment
column13: The invention relates to a data processing technology, and provides an electrocardiogram analysis method and device based on federated learning, computer equipment and a storage medium. The electrocardiogram analysis efficiency and accuracy can be improved, and construction of smart medical treatment and smart cities is promoted.

column12: INTELLIGENT DIGITAL TWIN SYSTEM BASED ON FEDERATED LEARNING MODEL, AND OPERATION METHOD THEREFOR

column12: Self-adaptive dynamic parameter replacement strategy for resisting hidden backdoor attack in federated learning
column13: The invention relates to the field of federated learning security, in particular to a self-adaptive dynamic parameter replacement strategy, and aims to resist hidden backdoor attacks in federated learning. Federal learning is a distributed machine learning technology and allows clients to cooperatively train a deep neural network without centrally storing data. However, federal learning is susceptible to backdoor attacks due to the distributed characteristics. As the research on backdoor attack is deeper, the arrangement of the backdoor is more and more hidden, and the existing defense scheme can be bypassed, so that how to detect the hidden backdoor becomes an urgent problem to be solved. In the invention, a self-adaptive dynamic parameter replacement strategy is provided, and aims to defend hidden backdoor attacks in federated learning. Specifically, each client maintains a small-scale clean data set, dynamically monitors the change of model parameters, replaces parameters with low update frequency in # imgabs0 turns, realizes back door removal, and ensures the safety and robustness of the federated learning model.

column12: Federated learning method based on hierarchical tensor decomposition in edge calculation

According to the federated learning method, distributed training ofthe shared model is realized on the premise of protecting user privacy, and the demand for network bandwidth during distributed training is reduced, and the communication energy consumption of edge nodes is reduced.

column12: Anti-collusion federated learning optimization method based on correlation analysis
column13: The invention discloses an anti-collusion federated learning optimization method based on correlation analysis. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a federated learning training system based on a centralized architecture; secondly, n local clients are randomly selected as collusion attackers, the other clients are honest clients, and all the local clients are added into a training system and divided into one group to receive an initial global model issued by a central server; then all local clients carry out training according to the initial global model and upload a trained model gradient to the central server, and the central server carries out grouping according to the uploaded model gradient and calculates a gradient average according to groups as a new global model gradient of the group; and finally, the honest client uses the new global model gradient to carry out next iteration training. And the collusion attacker does not carry out any training. According to the method, the FR attack and the collusion attack can be resisted at the same time, and relatively high precision can still be ensured in a scene of large-scale clients.

column13: The invention discloses a federal learning implementation method based on client knowledge distillation. column12: Employing elastic weight consolidation (EWC) loss terms to mitigate disastrous forgetting in federated learning of machine learning models
column13: Implementations disclosed herein relate to consolidating (EWC) loss terms with elastic weights in federated learning of a global machine learning (ML) model. Implementations may identify a global ML model that is initially trained at a remote server based on a server data set, determine an EWC loss item for a global weight of the global ML model, and transmit the global ML model and the EWC loss item to a plurality of client devices. An EWC loss item may be determined based on a Fisher information matrix of a server dataset. Further, the plurality of client devices may generate corresponding client gradients based on processing the corresponding predicted outputs using the global ML model and based on the EWC loss terms, and transmit the corresponding client gradients to the remote server. Implementations may further generate an updated global ML model based on at least the corresponding client gradient.

column12: Non-IID federated learning method and device based on trajectory matching data set distillation
column13: The invention discloses a Non-IID federated learning method and device based on track matching data set distillation, and the method comprises the steps: 1, N participants exist, and the local data distribution and label of each participant and the data distribution between clients do not meet the independent identical distribution; at the clients, each client initializes a local model of the client, and replaces an original classifier of a given model architecture with the same ETF classifier; the server runs a standard federated average algorithm, the client trains a model on local data, updates model parameters and uploads the parameters to the server, the server aggregates the parameters and updates a global model, and the process is continuously repeated; the server initializes an implicit vector set of the synthetic data, and performs optimization according to an early trajectory of the global model; the server uses the optimized synthetic data to correct the aggregated global model until the number of communication rounds reaches, initializes an extended implicit vector set, and continues to perform optimization based on a later global model trajectory; further correcting the global model through synthetic data generated by the previous two times of optimization; along with continuous updating, aggregation and correction of the model, the final global model is gradually converged. According to the method, the performance of the global model can be remarkably improved, calculation and memory consumption is reduced, and the method is suitable for large-scale application.

column12: Homomorphic encryption federated learning method based on polynomial decomposition problem
column13: The invention provides a homomorphic encryption federated learning method based on a polynomial decomposition problem. The homomorphic encryption federated learning method comprises the steps that a server broadcasts global model parameters to clients; after receiving the global model parameters, the client uses local data to train a global model as a local model of the client and sends the local model to a specified credible third-party encryption module; the third-party encryption module converts local model parameters into parameter matrixes of the same type; initializing element positions in the parameter matrix into polynomial fractions; the polynomial fractions of all the clients are sent to the server; and after receiving the polynomial fractions from the third-party encryption module, the server calculates corresponding abnormal integrals by using a definition method, and gradually restores the aggregated model. According to the method, privacy leakage can be further prevented, and the privacy security of the federated learning framework is enhanced; the method has the advantages of being capable of resisting poisoning attacks of client model parameters and reasoning and inversion attacks of the model.

column12: Federal learning malicious node screening method based on block chain

According to the method, the distance between models is used for representing the difference of the models, malicious nodes are discriminated and eliminated by adopting a mode of carrying out global voting on an outlier model, and a decentralized training mode is adopted to uniformly disperse the power of each node in the whole federated learning process, so that the whole federated learning process is prevented from being excessively controlled by one node in a concentrated manner. The problem that attacks cannot be avoided and discriminated in the federated learning process and normal training cannot be recovered from hostile attacks is solved, the overall security of the federated learning system is improved by applying the block chain, and the model is prevented from being maliciously tampered in the transmission process.

column12: Medical data privacy protection method based on federated learning and bert model

column12: Internet of vehicles resource slicing method based on Transform double federated learning
column13: The invention discloses an Internet of Vehicles resource slicing method based on Transform dual federated learning, and the method comprises the steps: abstracting physical resources of a base station into a virtual resource pool in an Internet of Vehicles system, and carrying out the management of a controller; and the controller adjusts slice resource allocation according to the terminal request information fed back by each base station. column12: Anti-backdoor attack federated learning method based on abnormal model parameters
column13: The invention discloses an anti-backdoor attack federated learning method based on abnormal model parameters. The anti-backdoor attack federated learning method is used for effectively resisting backdoor attacks in a federated learning scene of non-independent identically distributed (non-IID) data. Firstly, abnormal parameters updated by a client model are detected through an abnormal parameter detection mechanism, and meanwhile the abnormal degree of the parameters is calculated. Secondly, clustering the abnormal parameters according to the abnormal degree, and only retaining clusters with higher abnormal degree; thirdly, counting the position of each abnormal parameter in the cluster in model updating; and if the number of the abnormal parameters belonging to a certain position has the unique maximum value, entering the next step. Otherwise, gradually reducing the size of the cluster according to the ascending order of the abnormal degree until the condition is met. And finally, the central server removes all model updates with abnormal parameters at the position, and aggregates all the remaining updates to update the global model.

column12: Federal distillation-based federal learning model training method and system, and medium
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning model training method and system based on federated distillation, and a medium, which can be applied to the technical field of model processing. The method comprises the following steps: a client adopts a federated learning algorithm and a local private data set to train and update a local model, adopts a public data set and the updated local model to predict a first output vector of a local normalization layer, and uploads a local average output vector corresponding to the first output vector to a server; the server performs global consensus operation on all the local average output vectors, determines a global average output vector and issues the global average output vector to all the clients; and the client performs knowledge distillation on the public data set by adopting the global average output vector and the updated local model, and trains and calls back the local model on the local private data set. According to the method, the communication cost only depends on model output and is not increased along with the multiple of the model size, so that the communication stability is effectively improved, and the delay is reduced.

column12: Three-stage adaptive federal learning system and method based on reputation committee
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of federated learning, and discloses a three-stage adaptive federated learning system and method based on a reputation committee, and the learning system comprises a three-stage adaptive federated learning module and a reputation committee module based on the behavior performance of participants. Meanwhile, the reputation score can effectively stimulate high-quality participants, and the beneficial effects of reducing the income of malicious participants and constructing a positive federal learning ecology are achieved.

An inference may be generated based on the updated ML model.

column12: Internet of vehicles identity authentication and privacy protection method and system based on federated learning

The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a federated chain identification code distributed when a vehicle participates in a historical federated learning task, wherein the federated chain identification code is sent by the vehicle; authenticating the identity of the vehicle based on the federal chain identification code; after the authentication is passed, public parameters and a model training task are sent to the vehicle; receiving returned data which is returned by the vehicle and extracted after the model training task is executed; and updating and adjusting the global model parameters based on the returned data. A federated learning method is adopted to train a global model, each participating vehicle only needs to locally perform training iteration and then return characteristics such as trained model parameters and the like, a platform aggregates the returned data to obtain new parameters of the global model, and in the process, original data of the vehicle is not transmitted, so that the original data of the vehicle is not transmitted. And the privacy and security of the local data of the vehicle are effectively ensured.

column12: Verifiable federated learning method and device based on double decomposition and aggregation
column13: The invention provides a dual decomposition and aggregation verifiable federated learning method and device, and belongs to the field of federated learning privacy security protection. The method specifically comprises the following steps: a trusted third party (TTP) performs key negotiation with each client to generate a corresponding key # imgabs0 # TTP, the key generates a random number # imgabs1 # through a random number generator, the random number # imgabs1 # is summed to obtain # imgabs2 # TTP, and the # imgabs3 # is sent to each client through a symmetric encryption method; each client decomposes trained model parameters into n parts, sends the n parts to other clients and receives parameters sent by other clients; each client performs a second round of decomposition on the parameters, the parameters are decomposed into a public part # imgabs4 # (sent to the server) and a private part # imgabs5 # (reserved locally), the private part is set as # imgabs6 #, and each client constructs a verification function vi based on the uploaded local model parameters and sends the verification function vi to the server together; the server aggregates the model parameter omega i and the verification function v i sent by the client, and sends an aggregation result to the client; and the client verifies whether the data are equal or not through a verification formula # imgabs7 #, if the data are equal, the subsequent updating operation is executed, and the received global model parameters with the bias and the privacy part reserved locally are aggregated to recover a real parameter model.

column12: Privacy protection dynamic edge cache design method based on distributed reinforcement learning in mobile edge computing network
column13: The invention discloses a privacy protection dynamic edge cache design method based on distributed reinforcement learning in a mobile edge computing network, which specifically comprises the following steps of: firstly, dynamically modeling user content popularity into a model-free Markov chain; then, constructing the cache hit rate maximization problem of each user equipment and server equipment in the system into a distributed optimization problem under privacy protection constraint; then converting the distributed optimization problem into a distributed model-free Markov decision process problem, and introducing a federated learning method for popularity prediction under privacy protection constraint; and finally, through conversion of an original distributed optimization problem, obtaining an action space, a state space and reward function system configuration. Through iterative learning, obtaining a dynamic transformation cache design method of each device under the privacy protection constraint. The content cache dynamic updating under the user privacy protection constraint in the mobile edge computing network is realized, and a higher cache hit rate is obtained while the user privacy is protected.

column13: The invention discloses a transverse federated learning optimization method and device based on semi-supervision and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps: receiving global model parameterswhich are issued by a server and updated by a label-free global model this time; performing pseudo supervision training on a local model to be trained according to the global model parameter and thepseudo label of the training sample to obtain a local model parameter; sending the local model parameters to a server, so that the server performs labeled global model updating in combination with theclients with the labeled samples according to the local model parameters sent by the clients to obtain global model parameters of new label-free global model updating, and issues the global model parameters to the clients; and repeating until a preset condition is met to stop training to obtain a target model. According to the invention, transverse federated learning can be carried out when onlya part of clients have a small number of labeled samples, so that the method is suitable for a real scene lacking label data, and the labor cost is saved.

column12: AUTHENTICATION BASED SECURE FEDERATED LEARNING
column13: Authentication based secure federated learning can be beneficial when updates to an initial artificial neural network (ANN) model generated by edge devices are to be aggregated into a federated ANN model. The updates can be generated by the edge devices after training the initial ANN locally. The edge devices can encrypt the updates using edge device-specific identifiers and transmit the encrypted updates to a server. The server can verify the authenticity of the updates, decrypt the updates, and aggregate the updates into the federated ANN model. The aggregation can be performed according to a secure multiparty computation protocol.

column12: Federated learning client intelligent selection method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning client intelligent selection method and system based on deep reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: enabling a federated platform to collect the state of a client from a federated service market environment as an input, inputting the state into a client selection agent based on a strategy network, and outputting a client selection scheme; enabling the federation platform to select a group of optimal clients from a plurality of candidate clients according to the current environment condition and the client selection scheme to cooperatively train a federation learning model, feeding back federation learning performance to the client selection agent as an award, and using the award for optimizing and updating a strategy network; obtaining the strategy network through offline training of a reinforcement learning method. According to the method, high-quality equipment can be selected from the candidate mobile edge equipment to participate in federated learning, so that the problem of low-quality data of a distributed client is solved, and the federated learning quality is remarkably improved.

column12: Multi-server federated learning method based on secret sharing and homomorphic encryption
column13: The invention relates to a multi-server federated learning method based on secret sharing and homomorphic encryption, belongs to the technical field of information security, and comprises an initialization stage, a model training stage, a model aggregation stage and a model updating stage for complex federated learning application of multiple servers and multiple clients. The gradient is segmented by using a Shamir secret sharing algorithm, and the segmented gradient is encrypted by using an Elgamal homomorphic encryption algorithm, so that the privacy of the gradient is protected, and the robustness of the scheme is enhanced; in addition, a gradient sparse algorithm is also designed, so that irrelevant gradients deviating from global convergence are filtered, and the communication overhead is reduced.

column12: MULTITASK HYBRID SUPERVISED MEDICAL IMAGE SEGMENTATION METHOD AND SYSTEM BASED ON FEDERATED LEARNING
column13: To break the limitation of a single label type, propose a multi-task hybrid model architecture based on federated learning, break the data silo of each participant, not only sufficiently mine a potential and deep value of multi-agency data, but also more effectively mine contextual features by fully utilizing the relationship between tasks, realize the complementarity of information between different hierarchical features, and further improve the accuracy and robustness of a model.SOLUTION: A multi-task hybrid supervised medical image segmentation method and system based on federated learning includes a data collection module based on various weakly supervised data, fully supervised data and unlabeled data; a multi-task network model module in the first stage based on the federated learning; a pseudo-label generation module based on the second stage, a dynamic sample selection module based on the second stage; and a federated model dynamic update module based on different stages.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

column12: Distributed intrusion detection method based on federated learning and trust evaluation and system thereof
column13: The invention provides a distributed vehicle-mounted intrusion detection system based on federated learning and trust evaluation and a method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: designing a distributed intrusion detection system model based on federated learning; building and pre-training of an intrusion detection model are realized based on federated learning, and broadcasting and distributing a global model by a distributed aggregator; performing edge model training based on intrusion detection data of the edge vehicle by the edge vehicle; selecting an edge representative node as a cluster head based on behavior evaluation to complete an aggregation task of an edge model; adding a mask to the model parameters and then uploading the model parameters to the RSU; performing trust evaluation on the RSU through the quality of a model aggregated by the RSU through the RSU aggregates model parameters uploaded by a cluster head, so that distributed aggregation nodes are stimulated to compete and aggregate a model with higher accuracy, and finally, storing the training model based on a block chain principle to complete model sharing. The invention further creates a defense detection system suitable for automatic driving to resist network intrusion by adopting a safety evaluation mode of information safety.

column12: Data prediction method and system based on longitudinal federated learning
column13: The invention provides a data prediction method and device based on longitudinal federated learning. The method comprises the steps that a client obtains original features of a training sample; the client inputs the original features into the constructed bottom model and carries out randomization processing to obtain feature embedding vectors after randomization processing; the server uses the randomized feature embedding vector to train the constructed top model to obtain a corresponding loss gradient so as to update the top model; the client updates and obtains a target bottom model based on the loss gradient; when a to-be-tested request exists, the client inputs to-be-tested original features of to-be-tested data into the target bottom model and carries out randomization processing to obtain to-be-tested feature embedding vectors after randomization processing; and the server inputs the randomized to-be-tested feature embedding vector into the top model to obtain a prediction result. Therefore, the data security and the data privacy in the training process and the prediction process of the longitudinal federated learning are improved.

column12: Internet of Things anomaly detection method and system based on federated learning and deep learning
column13: The invention provides an Internet of Things anomaly detection method and system based on federated learning and deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: collecting traffic data of Internet of Things equipment and carrying out dimension reduction on the traffic data; clustering the benign traffic data after dimension reduction and the Internet of Things devices to obtain different types of benign traffic data under different types of Internet of Things devices; constructing an Internet of Things anomaly detection model for various types of Internet of Things equipment; training each Internet of Things anomaly detection model through different types of benign traffic data under each type of Internet of Things equipment, and sending training parameters of each round to a global model of a federated learning center server to update global model parameters; updating the parameters of each Internet of Things anomaly detection model through the parameters of the global model; and testing the trained Internet of Things anomaly detection model through the traffic data after dimension reduction. According to the invention, unsupervised, low-complexity and high-accuracy online Internet of Things anomaly detection is realized.

column12: Efficient strong privacy protection federated learning system and method
column13: The invention discloses an efficient strong privacy protection federated learning system and method, relates to the technical field of federated learning, and solves the problem that efficient cooperative training cannot be carried out on the premise of ensuring strong privacy and correctness of a model in the prior art. The system comprises training participants, and a parameter server is used for initializing a training model and a homomorphic pseudorandom sequence generator and generating a re-encryption key; the aggregation server is used for performing aggregation operation on gradient updates of the ciphertexts uploaded by the participants; aggregation operation is carried out on the pseudo-random sequence seeds of the multiple participants in the ciphertext state, and after a round of interaction with all online participants is carried out, re-encrypted aggregation seeds are fed back to all the online participants; performing aggregation calculation on the plurality of verification parameters, and returning a calculation result to the participant; according to the method, the mask vector encryption model generated by the SHPRG is used, so that the encryption efficiency is greatly improved.

column12: Efficient communication federal learning method based on adaptive differential privacy
column13: According to the efficient communication federal learning method based on adaptive differential privacy disclosed by the invention, adaptive gradient threshold clipping is carried out on different clients and different rounds, and the model performance is improved while the data privacy is protected. However, this privacy-protecting collaborative learning form is at the cost of spending a large amount of communication overhead during training. In order to solve the problems, an improved Top-k mechanism is introduced, sparsification and quantization are combined, meanwhile, the improved Top-k mechanism is expanded to downstream compression and weight updating of optimal Golomb coding, and the communication overhead is remarkably reduced through the improved mechanism. According to the method, experiments are carried out in three different learning tasks, and results show that the privacy, the practicability, the communication efficiency and the like of the client-side-level DP are remarkably improved through the method.

column12: Longitudinal federated learning model aggregation method based on client double-factor characteristics
column13: The invention relates to a longitudinal federated learning model aggregation method based on client double-factor characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of federated learning, and the method comprises the steps: determining a federated learning model structure, and initializing related parameters; calculating a client node data volume normalization ratio; the client node carries out model pre-training to obtain a related parameter set and a gradient update vector; randomly selecting a threshold parameter, calculating the dissimilarity degree of the nodes based on the gradient update vector between the nodes, and removing suspected malicious nodes; comprehensively calculating contribution weights of the nodes according to a two-factor characteristic formed by a data volume normalization ratio and a dissimilarity degree of the nodes, and performing aggregation based on the weights to form a single-iteration global model; adjusting a threshold parameter, analyzing the performance of each pre-training model, and determining an approximate optimal threshold parameter; and performing formal training according to the approximate optimal threshold parameter. The efficient and safe federal learning aggregation method is achieved, the convergence speed is increased, and the accuracy and safety of the model are enhanced.

column12: Personalized privacy protection longitudinal federated learning system based on lattice
column13: The invention discloses a lattice-based personalized privacy protection longitudinal federated learning system, belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and relates to personalization and privacy protection of federated learning in the field of artificial intelligence. The method mainly comprises the steps of system design, establishment of a personalized longitudinal joint learning framework, selection of a personalized federal learning algorithm, data alignment and how to realize lattice-based privacy protection aggregation. On one hand, a personalized longitudinal federated architecture (pFedPQA) is constructed through a PFL algorithm, and meanwhile, the security of interactive data is ensured by using a matrix mask. And on the other hand, in consideration of rapid development of quantum computers in recent years, an original privacy protection aggregation protocol is improved by utilizing a lattice-based encryption method, a lattice-based post-quantum privacy protection aggregation protocol (PQLA) is designed, and the security of the system is improved.

column12: Federal learning-based multi-center first schizophrenia patient identification method, device and system
column13: The invention discloses an identification method, device and system for a multi-center first schizophrenia patient based on federated learning. The identification method, device and system are a client-server system based on multi-center personalized federated learning. Each client collects brain T1 image data of a first schizophrenia patient and a normal population, preprocesses the brain T1 image data, and stores the preprocessed image in the local federal learning client; constructing a 3D convolutional neural network model for identifying the first schizophrenia, and storing the 3D convolutional neural network model in a federal learning server; each client uses respective data to train an initial model downloaded from the federated learning server and feeds back trained model parameters to the federated learning server, and the federated learning server receives the feedback and then trains the model to obtain a trained model; and inputting preprocessed brain T1 image data to be detected, and identifying whether the patient is the first schizophrenia patient by using the trained model.

column12: Beam forming system in decentralized federated learning scene
column13: The invention discloses a beam forming system in a decentralized federated learning scene, which is based on a decentralized federated learning architecture and comprises a learning scene module, a learning model module, a beam forming module and a neural network module, and is characterized in that the learning scene module comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and ground equipment; the unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary ground equipment carries out local model training and model parameter sharing in the learning model module; and the beam forming module is used for carrying out rate maximization description of beam forming so as to simulate input and output mapping of a traditional algorithm by adopting the neural network module, modeling an interference relationship between links in the hybrid communication network into a heterogeneous graph, and then obtaining an optimal beam forming vector based on the input of the heterogeneous graph. According to the method, the unmanned aerial vehicle is introduced to assist the ground equipment to perform local model training and model parameter sharing, the spectrum utilization rate is improved, the same-frequency interference is reduced, the power consumption of the ground equipment is reduced, and then the model training accuracy and convergence speed of federal learning are improved.

column12: Adversarial generative network model training method based on federated learning and related equipment thereof
column13: The embodiment of the invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, is applied to the field of intelligent security and protection, and relates to an adversarial generative network model training method based on federated learning. The invention further provides an adversarial generative network model training device based on federated learning, computer equipment and a storage medium. column12: Unmanned aerial vehicle small base station cluster RAN slicing method based on hierarchical federated learning
column13: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle small base station cluster RAN slicing method based on hierarchical federated learning for a scene in which an unmanned aerial vehicle small base station cluster provides differentiated services for ground users, and provides a dynamic RAN slicing framework based on hierarchical federated learning, so as to improve a slicing performance isolation effect and reduce communication cost in a cooperative training process. Firstly, in consideration of the characteristics of dynamic deployment, insufficient data and the like of the unmanned aerial vehicle, local model training is promoted through data augmentation; and then, according to the position and data distribution information, a clustering strategy oriented to an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is designed, and edge model aggregation is supported, so that edge member unmanned aerial vehicles have more opportunities to participate in federated learning, and the communication cost is reduced. And finally, exploring an edge and global model aggregation scheme based on an attention mechanism, and enhancing the generalization ability of the global federated learning model. column12: Lightweight federal learning training method
column13: The invention provides a lightweight federated learning training method, which comprises the following steps that: a central server initializes parameters of a deep convolutional neural network model to obtain an initialized deep convolutional neural network model and transmits the initialized deep convolutional neural network model to a plurality of clients; the client reversely distills the model of the initialized deep convolutional neural network model to a local deep convolutional neural network model; inputting the local image data into a local deep convolutional neural network model to update the parameters of the local deep convolutional neural network to obtain a trained local deep convolutional neural network model; pruning the trained local deep convolutional neural network model through a pruning algorithm to obtain a lightweight deep convolutional neural network model, and performing forward distillation to a local local model; inputting the local models into a central server for aggregation to obtain a global model; compared with the prior art, the method can improve the accuracy of the model while improving the communication and aggregation efficiency.

column12: Implementation method of distributed and personalized federated learning in wireless ad hoc network
column13: The invention discloses a method for realizing distributed and personalized federated learning in a wireless ad hoc network. The invention realizes the distributed and personalized federated learning method in the wireless ad hoc network. In a wireless ad hoc network environment, federated learning faces many challenges, such as training equipment heterogeneity, training data statistics heterogeneity, limited spectrum resources, wireless signal interference, dynamic change of network topology and the like. In order to deal with the challenges, the invention provides a method for realizing completely distributed personalized federal learning on the wireless ad hoc network. According to the method, the wireless interference problem is solved by using the non-orthogonal multiple access technology and the continuous interference elimination strategy, the wireless spectrum utilization rate is optimized, and the overall communication efficiency is improved. One of the main advantages of the method is that local model exchange can be directly carried out between adjacent clients, and model aggregation can be carried out without coordination of a central server. In the model aggregation process, the method comprises the following steps: firstly, calculating the similarity between local models by using a Tanimoto coefficient, and setting an aggregation weight according to the similarity between the models; the method emphasizes the contribution of a similar model to a global model, and effectively solves the problem of data statistical heterogeneity.

column12: RANDOM GREEDY ALGORITHM-BASED HORIZONTAL FEDERATED GRADIENT BOOSTED TREE OPTIMIZATION METHOD
column13: A random greedy algorithm-based horizontal federated gradient boosted tree optimization method, which comprises the following steps: a coordinator configures gradient boosted tree model relevant parameters, which comprise but are not limited to a maximum number of decision trees (T), a maximum tree depth (L), an initial prediction value (base), etc., and sends same to each participant (p_i); and each participant partitions a current node dataset according to a partition feature f and a partition value v, and allocates new partitioned data to a child node. In the present random greedy algorithm-based horizontal federated gradient boosted tree optimization method, horizontal federated learning comprises participants and a coordinator, the participants possess local data, the coordinator does not possess any data, and is a center that aggregates participant information, the participants respectively calculate a histogram and send the histogram to the coordinator, and after collecting all histogram information, the coordinator searches for a maximally optimal partition point according to a greedy algorithm, and then shares same with each participant, and operates in coordination with an internal algorithm.

column12: Method and system for federated learning
column13: A transformer-based foundation model (FM), comprising several transformer blocks, is trained for a specific downstream task using federated learning. A pre-trained FM 10 is received at a client device 200 from a server 100, and has a trainable module 16 that is coupled to the transformer blocks. Whilst the FM is frozen, the trainable module is trained using a local training dataset, and then sent to the server for aggregation. Training may involve processing a data item in the training dataset using the frozen FM, outputting a token from each of its blocks, inputting each token into the trainable module, and training the trainable module to process the tokens to output a prediction for the data item, possibly to minimise a task specific loss between the prediction and a ground truth of the data item. The training module may comprise a self-attention block.

column13: The invention provides an efficient communication privacy enhancement federated edge learning method based on equipment probability access, and aims to improve the communication and training efficiency of a federated edge learning system while protecting sensitive data of a user. column12: Single-budget multi-round federated learning incentive mechanism method, device and system and medium
column13: The invention discloses a single-budget multi-round federated learning incentive mechanism method, device and equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps of receiving a total budget, a learning task and a standard small data set of a task publisher; according to the standard small data set, performing quality evaluation on the local models of all task participants in the current round; according to the selection strategy and the payment function, in combination with the quality evaluation value of the local model of each task participant in the current round, selecting the task participant participating in federated learning in the current round and determining the reward of the task participant; if the total budget is greater than 0 after payment, sending the global model to each selected task participant, so that each task participant performs local training on a local model; and receiving a local model trained by each task participant, and performing global model aggregation by using an aggregation method. According to the method, a feasible incentive mechanism is designed for non-independent identically distributed federal learning, and landing use of federal learning application can be further promoted.

column12: Defense method and device for label reasoning attack based on decentralized training
column13: The invention discloses a label reasoning attack defense method and device based on decentralized training. The method comprises the following steps of S1, initializing a bottom layer model of a participant; s2, the participants perform training according to the respective training sets and the respective parameters to obtain bottom layer model parameters; s3, obtaining all outputs of the underlying model; s4, updating the top layer model; s5, calculating a loss function by using the trained top-layer model parameters and the label of the top-layer model to obtain the gradient of the top-layer model, and downloading the gradient to the malicious participant A and the honest participant B by the top-layer model; and S6, repeating the steps S1 to S5 until the top layer model and the bottom layer model converge. According to the method, the label reasoning attack effect of longitudinal federated learning can be reduced to the random guess degree, leakage of label information during federated learning training is avoided, and the label reasoning attack in longitudinal federated learning is effectively defended.

column12: Hybrid aggregation mode federated learning optimization method based on queuing network
column13: The invention discloses a mixed aggregation mode federated learning optimization method based on a queuing network. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a federated learning model; k clients are selected to participate in the current round of training, and the average time needed by the selected clients to complete local training in the synchronous aggregation mode is calculated; calculating the average time required for completing local training by the selected client in the asynchronous aggregation mode by using an approximation algorithm of a closed queuing network theory; and comparing the average time in the synchronous and asynchronous aggregation modes, if the former is not greater than the latter and the number of completed training rounds is greater than 80% of the preset total number of training rounds, selecting the synchronous aggregation mode to carry out the training round, otherwise, selecting the asynchronous aggregation mode. And repeating the steps until a preset total training round number is reached. According to the method, under the reasonable communication overhead, the convergence speed and training precision of the global model are effectively improved, meanwhile, the calculation overhead is small, the result is accurate, and the method has wide universality and applicability.

column12: Cloud edge cooperative training method and system based on federated learning and neural architecture search

According to the method, the model reusability is improved by selecting proper branch models and deploying the branch models on different edge devices.

column12: Continuous back perception federated learning defense method based on zero trust
column13: The invention provides a continuous back awareness federated learning defense method based on zero trust, and provides a zero trust policy to ensure that the reliability and robustness of federated learning are guaranteed when the client attack and the increasing risk of the back behavior are faced. Through the policy, the system no longer endows any client with inherent trust, but adopts a continuous risk assessment mechanism to dynamically adjust the trust level to the client. The core of the strategy lies in that the credibility of a client with reliable performance in the past must be maintained through continuous behavior verification, so that possible internal threats are effectively prevented. In addition, the policy further comprises strict behavior analysis on all participating clients, the behavior mode and potential risk of each client are evaluated through an advanced algorithm model, and the data integrity and the model training safety in the federal learning process are ensured.

column12: User screening method, system and device based on local model gradient in federated learning and storage medium
column13: The invention relates to a user screening method, system and device based on a local model gradient in federated learning and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: after a server receives a local model gradient matrix transmitted by each user, firstly, expanding the local model gradient matrix of each user into a vector according to rows or columns; carrying out dimensionality reduction on a vector by utilizing PCA (Principal Component Analysis), then, carrying out clustering by utilizing a DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) clustering method to obtain a category with the largest quantity in clustering results, then, solving geometric center points of all dimensionality reduction local model gradients in the category, and finally, selecting users according to the distance between the dimensionality reduction local model gradient of each user and the geometric center points, and selecting gradients of partial users closest to the central point to update the global model. According to the screening method, the local model gradient based on high-quality data calculation can be effectively screened, and the robustness of a federated learning system is improved.

column12: Method for improving performance of federated learning in Non-IID and Mismatched scenes
column13: The invention discloses a method for improving the performance of federated learning in Non-IID and Mismatched scenes, and the method comprises the steps: 1, each client updates a local model in each round of training, and the client is provided with a generative adversarial network; 2, after receiving the local models from the clients, the server side aggregates the local models into an intermediate state model and transmits the intermediate state model back to the clients; step 3, each client predicts false data by using the received intermediate state model, compares the false data with the label of the false data, selects the false data needing to be uploaded to form a false data subset, and uploads the false data subset to the server; and step 4, the server processes the false data subsets received from the clients to obtain a false data set similar to IID distribution, and the false data set is utilized to train the intermediate state model to obtain a final global model of the round. column12: Efficient federated learning large model training method based on dynamic layer selection
column13: The invention discloses an efficient federated learning large model training method based on dynamic layer selection, and relates to the technical field of efficient training of federated learning. column12: Federated learning poisoning detection method based on neuron distribution characteristics
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning poisoning detection method based on neuron distribution characteristics, which comprises the following steps: (1) obtaining a plurality of edge models trained and uploaded at clients, and according to the similarity of adjacent edge models uploaded for several times corresponding to each client, screening a plurality of edge models meeting screening requirements from the plurality of edge models uploaded each time to serve as candidate poisoning models; (2) screening at least one model from the candidate poisoning models as a poisoning model according to the distribution state of the model parameters, and removing the poisoning model, (3) inverting the poisoning model according to the sample data and the label to obtain poisoning patch data, optimizing the aggregation model parameters of the server according to the poisoning patch data, and obtaining an optimized aggregation model; and issuing the optimized aggregation model to the client bythe server to serve as an edge model of the client for edge training of the next round. The federated learning poisoning detection method can rapidly detect the poisoning model.

column12: Edge federal learning training method and system for heterogeneous data

column12: Efficient privacy protection federated learning method and device for defending poisoning attack
column13: The invention discloses an efficient privacy protection federated learning method and device for defending poisoning attacks, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and solves the problems that privacy protection federated learning cannot defend poisoning attacks and the calculation overhead is large in the prior art. column12: Decentralized verifiable federated learning method and device based on block chain
column13: The invention provides a decentralized verifiable federated learning method and device based on a block chain. Comprising the following steps: an activity initiator issues a task, a client calculates a local gradient, divides and transmits the local gradient to a server node, and calculates and uploads a gradient verification value to a verification main node; and the server nodes aggregate the gradient shares to obtain a part of global gradients, and calculate a part of verification values to be stored in the block chain. And the aggregation main node further aggregates to obtain a global gradient sum value for verification of participants in the next round. By comparing verification values on the block chain, the participant confirms whether the gradient is tampered or not, if not, the model is updated, and if not, the model is reported. And the verification main node traces and deletes the untrusted nodes by using the block chain. According to the method, the problems of single-point failure and bandwidth bottleneck possibly caused by a centralized architecture of traditional federated learning are effectively avoided; the safety of the user data in the training process is ensured; through a linear homomorphic Hash technology, verification of an aggregation result and tracking of a malicious server are realized.

column12: Verifiable federated learning method supporting single-initialization multi-round aggregation
column13: The invention relates to a verifiable federated learning method supporting single-initialization multi-round aggregation. According to the method, the privacy of plaintext gradient updating is protected by adding two different types of masks, and the huge calculation overhead generated when the masks are decrypted is reduced by adopting a distributed key generation (DKG) mode. And meanwhile, in order to efficiently verify a server aggregation result, a homomorphic hash function is adopted to realize a verification code with homomorphic property. The server aggregates the gradient update results and aggregates messages sent by the clients and used for verifying the aggregation results, the gradient update results and the messages are returned to the clients together, and the clients judge whether the received aggregation results are tampered or not by verifying whether the aggregation results returned by the server are consistent with aggregation verification information or not. And the correctness and integrity of an aggregation result are ensured. According to the method, the verifiability of a calculation result is further guaranteed while the communication and calculation overhead of the federated learning process is reduced and the practicability is improved.

column12: Method for detecting backdoor attacks in federated learning based on cooperative game theory

According to the method, hidden backdoor attacks for federation learning under various attack configurations can be accurately detected within an acceptable time overhead range, and the influence of the hidden backdoor attacks on the training of the whole federation learning mechanism is eliminated, so that the safety and robustness of the training process are ensured.

column12: Federal learning data privacy protection method based on Paillier
column13: The invention discloses a Paillier-based federated learning data privacy protection method, which is implemented by the following steps of: constructing a federated learning system, initializing parameters by a federated server and distributing the parameters to clients, randomly selecting one client to generate a public key and a private key and sharing the public key and the private key to other clients, and all clients respectively establish a plaintext pool and a noise pool according to the public key and the private key. In the training process, a client calculates a local gradient according to private data of the client, synchronizes a gradient range with other clients in the federated learning system, determines a quantization coefficient, quantizes the gradient according to the quantization coefficient, encrypts gradient data based on a plaintext pool and a noise pool and sends the gradient data to a server, and the server sends the gradient data to the client. column12: COMMUNICATION METHOD AND APPARATUS
column13: Provided in the embodiments of the present application are a communication method and apparatus. column12: User-level member reasoning method based on generative adversarial network
column13: The invention discloses a user-level member reasoning scheme based on a federated learning environment. A GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks) method is adopted to acquire data distribution so as tostart member reasoning. In a federated learning environment, an attacker initiates a member reasoning attack without accessing user data to deduce whether a given data record belongs to a target training set so as to steal data privacy of a target data set. The method comprises the following steps: 1) user-level member reasoning: a malicious user initiates a member reasoning attack to steal member privacy of a specific user, and further reveals safety vulnerabilities of current joint learning; and 2) performing data expansion by using a locally deployed generative adversarial network so as toobtain data distribution of other users. The effectiveness of the attack method provided by the invention is fully considered under the condition that the user data has multiple tags.

column12: Decentralized Group Privacy in Cross-Silo Federated Learning
column13: Federated training of a machine learning model with enforcement of subject level privacy is implemented. Respective samples of data items from a training data set are generated at multiple nodes of a federated machine learning system. Noise values are determined for individual ones of the sampled data items according to respective counts of data items of particular subjects and the cumulative counts of the items of the subjects. Respective gradients for the data items are the determined The gradients are then clipped and noise values are applied. Each subject's noisy clipped gradients in the sample are then aggregated. The aggregasted gradients for the entire sample are then used for determining machine learning model updates.

column12: Method and system for federated learning in unstable scene
column13: The invention provides a federated learning method and system oriented to an unstable scene. The method comprises the following steps of: 1, determining a sampling strategy according to data volume, computing power and network bandwidth required by training a local model; 2, M edge nodes are selected according to a sampling strategy, and pre-training is carried out; 3, the server initializes the global model; 4, when the fault node list is not empty, selecting a top-level node from the fault node list and adding the top-level node into the edge nodes participating in training; step 5, the edge node performs local training according to the local data and the received global model to obtain a new local model, and uploads the new local model to the server; step 6, in a set time period, if the server receives the local model of the edge node, combining the local model into a global model; otherwise, adding the edge nodes which are not returned to the local model to the fault node list; and 7, repeating the steps 4 to 6 until an end condition is met, and outputting the global model at the moment.

column12: HORIZONTAL FEDERATED LEARNING MODELING OPTIMIZATION METHOD, DEVICE, MEDIUM AND PROGRAM PRODUCT
column13: The present application discloses a horizontal federated learning modeling optimization method, a device, a medium, and a program product, applied to a federation participant. The horizontal federated learning modeling optimization method comprises: according to an acquired training task data set and target white box signature, by means of performing iterative training updating on a local neural network model, embedding the target white box signature into a preset signature position in a network parameter of the local neural network model to obtain a signature-embedded local model; sending the signature-embedded local model to a horizontal federated server, so that the horizontal federated server aggregates signature-embedded local models transmitted by each federation participant to obtain an aggregate signature-embedded local model, different federation participants having different preset signature positions; and optimizing the signature-embedded local model on the basis of the aggregate signature-embedded local model to obtain a target signature-embedded model.

column12: DATA VALIDATION METHOD FOR VERTICAL FEDERATED LEARNING
column13: A data validation method for vertical federated learning, comprising the steps of: storing probability distribution features of features of training data that are obtained on the basis of a batch of valid training data; setting a normal occurrence probability threshold ε of the training data according to the probability distribution features of the features of the training data; calculating an occurrence probability P(x) of a piece of data x occurring in the same distribution as a batch of valid training data; and comparing the occurrence probability P(x) with the normal occurrence probability threshold ε, if the occurrence probability P(x) is less than the normal occurrence probability threshold ε, determining that the piece of data is abnormal data, otherwise, determining that the piece of data is normal data.

column13: The invention discloses a personalized model training method and system combining federated learning and a user portrait, and the specific implementation of the method comprises the steps that each participant inputs private data into a model, carries out the local training, obtains a local model, encrypts a to-be-aggregated parameter in the model, and transmits the encrypted to-be-aggregated parameter to a central server; the central server calculates the contribution degree of each participant according to the to-be-aggregated parameters sent by each participant, updates the aggregated modelparameters according to the result, and issues the model parameters to each participant; and each participant updates the local model according to the parameters issued by the server and the local personalized parameters. column12: Unbiased federated learning excitation method and device based on Stackelberg game
column13: The embodiment of the invention discloses an unbiased federated learning excitation method and device based on the Stackelberg game, which are used for ensuring the unbiasedness of a model under the condition that target participants in each round of training are random and the number of the target participants is uncertain, and realizing faster and better model convergence. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention comprises the following steps: determining a user utility function and a service utility function based on an expected participation level of each alternative participant; determining a target optimization problem corresponding to the service utility function and the user utility function based on a Stackelberg game model; solving a target optimization problem, and obtaining a target participation level of each alternative participant and a corresponding target excitation function; performing federated learning based on the target participant of each round of training until the model converges to obtain a target model; the target participant in each round of training is determined by performing random sampling on the plurality of alternative participants according to the target participation level, and the target model is obtained by aggregating the actual participation levels of the target participant in each round of training.

column12: Self-balancing model training method based on federal learning
column13: The invention discloses a self-balancing model training method based on federated learning. The self-balancing model training method is characterized by mainly comprising the following steps that: 1) K devices participating in federated learning training send distribution information to a central server; 2) equipment is grouped according to the relative entropy, and a weight parameter w of the global neural network model and a neural network architecture alpha are sent to all proxy servers and all equipment; 3) models are trained in parallel among the proxy servers, and the models are sequentially trained from small to large according to the relative entropy in the proxy servers; and 4) updating the global neural network w and alpha to carry out a new round of training until the model converges. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that neural network architecture search is performed under the condition that the computing power of equipment is limited, the problem that the accuracy of the model is reduced due to unbalanced equipment data distribution is solved, and the robustness and the training efficiency of the federated learning model are greatly improved.

column12: Distributed federated learning communication compression scheme based on model splitting
column13: The invention relates to the field of machine learning, in particular to a distributed federated learning communication compression scheme based on model splitting, and aims to reduce network transmission gradient communication traffic by compressing a model parameter matrix in a parameter updating process. column12: Robust security training method based on double-server reputation evaluation mechanism in federated learning

column12: Distributed consensus system based on federal learning and operation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a federated learning-based distributed consensus system and an operation method thereof. The method is applied to a federated learning scene, and comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-party training sample data, and performing federated training on an XGBoost tree model according to the multi-party sample data; performing clustering compression on the sample data based on data features to obtain a clustering matrix and a clustering index; constructing a sparse matrix based on the clustering matrix, and calculating an aggregation matrix based on the clustering index; performing fragmentation processing on the sparse matrix to obtain a first fragment matrix, and performing fragmentation processing on the aggregation matrix to obtain a second fragment matrix; matrix multiplication processing based on data encryption is carried out based on the first fragment matrix and the second fragment matrix, and summation is carried out on same-bucket feature clustering centers to obtain gradient histogram data; and performing model training according to the gradient histogram data to obtain a target XGBoost tree model. Clustering compression is carried out on the features to realize operation acceleration on a sparse matrix, the data calculation amount and transmission amount in the model training process are reduced, and the efficiency is improved.

The device generates labeled data using the spoken input, and updates the on-device models using the spoken input and the labeled data. The updated model data is provided to the system to enable the system to update the system-level (global) models.

column13: The invention relates to a privacy protection problem in distributed AI model training in federated learning, in particular to a privacy protection type large model training and deployment method based on federated learning. column12: Federal learning privacy protection method based on block chain
column13: The invention provides a federated learning privacy protection method based on a block chain, and belongs to the technical field of federated learning, privacy protection and block chains, and the technical scheme is that the method comprises the following steps: global initialization: a system administrator constructs a block chain and distributes security parameters to all participants of a task; the participants train a local model, and encrypt model parameters by using safety parameters and the Chinese remainder theorem; the leader selected by the consensus mechanism executes ciphertext aggregation; the participant decrypts the aggregated ciphertext and updates the local model; the model owner obtains the final model, and the participant calls the incentive contract to obtain rewards. The method has the advantages that the block chain is used for recording the federation learning process, safety parameter distribution and model aggregation are achieved, the Chinese remainder theorem and the blinding technology are used for protecting privacy, the possibility that an aggregation party and part of participants collude to steal privacy of other participants is completely eradicated, and safety in the federation learning process is enhanced.

column12: Federal learning method and device based on parameter decoupling and medium

According to the method, only the basic model parameters added with the localized differential privacy noise are uploaded in the model uploading stage, the parameters of the personalized input model and the personalized output model are reserved in the local client, and the precision of the models is improved while the privacy of participants is protected.

column12: Federal incremental image classification method based on plastic distillation and local enhancement
column13: The invention designs a federal incremental image classification method based on plastic distillation and local enhancement. According to the method, the plasticity of a federal increment model is taken as a starting point, and a plastic distillation module and a local enhancement module are provided respectively. According to the method, a knowledge distillation mode in class incremental learning is further improved, a prediction expectation vector is decoupled into a label item and a non-label item, and distillation with different weight coefficients is carried out respectively. Meanwhile, when the teacher model is selected, the global model of the last communication round is not used in the plastic distillation, and the model of the next increment stage is distilled by using the global model which is not completely fitted. In the local class enhancement, a new class is generated through inter-class mutual combination of local clients, and classification is carried out by using an independent class enhancement classifier. In local class enhancement, overfitting of a local model to a local class is prevented through a large number of generated new classes, and the problem of isomerism under federated learning is relieved by combining multiple times of aggregation and distribution of federated models.

column12: Linear regression model federated learning training method based on homomorphic encryption
column13: The invention discloses a homomorphic encryption-based linear regression model federated learning training method, and belongs to the technical field of privacy data encryption calculation. The problem that in the prior art, a traditional privacy protection machine learning model training method is large in communication traffic in the homomorphic encryption stage is solved. According to the method, in a longitudinal federated learning scene, a user side and a service side adopt an additive homomorphic encryption algorithm of a superposition matrix multiplication protocol to train a linear regression model, that is, initial parameters and input codes are updated, and an updated ciphertext polynomial is obtained; and decrypting the updated ciphertext polynomial through the coordinator, sending the decrypted ciphertext polynomial to the service party and the user party, updating a gradient and a loss function according to a gradient descent method selected by the linear regression model, determining whether training is ended or not according to a judgment condition, and repeating the steps until the training of the linear regression model is ended. According to the method, the security of multi-party privacy data homomorphic encryption calculation is effectively improved, the calculation time is shortened, and the method can be applied to privacy data encryption calculation.

column12: Accelerated adaptive federated learning algorithm of client level in data heterogeneous scene
column13: The invention relates to a client-level accelerated adaptive federated learning algorithm in a data heterogeneous scene, and the algorithm specifically comprises the following steps: 1, initializing a to-be-trained model structure and hyper-parameters, 2, randomly selecting a client by a central server and issuing a global model and a global step length, updating a local model by the client by using a stochastic gradient descent method, and carrying out the global model and the global step length; 3, the client dynamically adjusts the size of the local step length according to the local Lipscherz value and uploads the local model and the local step length to the central server, and 4, the server adjusts the contribution degree of the local model through the local step length and aggregates the received local model. Iteration of the next communication period is carried out, when the communication period reaches a set threshold value T, training is stopped, and a final global model is obtained. According to the technical method provided by the invention, the communication cost can be reduced while the problem of client drift is solved, and an algorithm framework is completely based on a traditional federated learning framework and has relatively high expandability.

The method comprises the steps of obtaining an intersection with the same sign between private data of a first participant and private data of a second participant; obtaining an associated data set according to a mapping mode determined based on the mark; grouping the hardware resources of the first participant and the hardware resources of the second participant through a preset grouping rule to obtain a hardware group of the first participant and a hardware group of the second participant respectively; respectively obtaining a first matching relationship between the associated data set and the hardware group of the first participant and a second matching relationship between the associated data set and the hardware group of the second participant; and cooperatively transferring the hardware resources of the first participant and the hardware resources of the second participant according to the first matchingrelationship and the second matching relationship, and performing parallel training by using the associated data set.

column12: Layered federal learning method for edge aggregation interval adaptive control, computer equipment and storage medium
column13: The invention discloses a layered federated learning method for edge aggregation interval adaptive control. The method comprises the following steps: 1) establishing a layered federated learning system taking edge equipment, an edge server and a cloud server as main elements; 2) in the initial stage of each training period, enabling the cloud server to optimize an edge aggregation interval and a training time delay budget of the current period according to the current training condition; 3) in the training process, enabling the edge equipment to train the local model; sending the local model to an edge server for edge aggregation according to the edge aggregation interval so as to generate an edge model; at the end stage of each period, enabling the edge server to upload the edge model to the cloud server for global aggregation so as to generate a global model. According to the invention, the edge aggregation interval can be adaptively adjusted, and the balance between the learning performance and the training time delay is achieved.
