column12: Credit analysis method and device based on longitudinal federated learning
column13: The invention provides a credit analysis method and device based on longitudinal federated learning, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the behavior feature matching of to-be-analyzed object information in response to a credit analysis request carrying the to-be-analyzed object information; the to-be-analyzed object information is sent to the data assistance end; performing feature binning query on the first behavior feature value matched with the to-be-analyzed object information; performing evidence weight query on a first feature sub-box to which the first behavior feature value belongs; calling a credit classification model to carry out credit classification processing on the first evidence weight value; receiving encrypted second credit classification information fed back by the data assistance end, and decrypting the encrypted second credit classification information; and calling a preset credit analysis model to perform credit analysis calculation processing on the first credit classification information and the second credit classification information to obtain a credit analysis result of the to-be-analyzed object. The reliability of the credit analysis result can be effectively improved.

column12: Internet of Things equipment fault detection method based on block chain and federated learning
column13: The invention provides an IOT (Internet of Things) equipment fault detection method based on a block chain and federated learning. In order to solve the problem of data heterogeneity in IOT equipmentfault detection, a brand new weighted federated average (CDW_FedAvg) algorithm based on centroid distance is provided, and the algorithm considers the distance between the positive class and the negative class of each edge node data set. In order to realize the verifiable integrity of client data in a scalable manner, each client server periodically creates a Merkle tree, each leaf node representsa client data record, and a tree root is stored on a block chain. Based on the size of customer data used in local model training, an on-chain incentive mechanism is designed to accurately and timelycalculate the contribution of each customer. According to the Internet of Things fault detection method based on federated learning of the block chain, the accuracy and performance in Internet of Things fault detection can be effectively improved, the problem of data multi-source isomerism is solved, and the production and development requirements are met.

column12: Data processing method and device based on federated learning
column13: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and provides a data processing method and device based on federated learning. The method comprises the steps: obtaining a first local model of first user equipment, and a second local model and a second data generator from second user equipment; utilizing a second data generator to generate second virtual data; and selecting second target virtual data from the second virtual data, wherein the second target virtual data is used for updating the first local model. According to the method, the data generator is utilized, data knowledge exchange is achieved on the premise that data privacy and safety are guaranteed, no requirement for the structure of a local model exists, and the method can be suitable for more application scenes.

column12: Ultra-dense Internet of Vehicles adaptive resource allocation method based on deep reinforcement learning
column13: The invention discloses an ultra-dense Internet of Vehicles adaptive resource allocation method based on deep reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: building a communication model of the ultra-dense Internet of Vehicles, the communication model comprises a base station, a transmitting vehicle and a receiving vehicle, the base station exchanges data with the vehicles through a V2I link, and the vehicles communicate with each other through a V2V link; determining a weighted interference model taking the receiving vehicle as the center according to the interference relationship between the vehicles in the communication model; according to the communication model and the weighted interference model, a resource allocation model of the communication model is established, and the resource allocation model is an optimization problem which aims at the maximum resource reuse rate and no conflict of allocated resources under a certain constraint condition; converting the optimization problem into a Markov decision process problem; and solving by using a FedAvg-AC algorithm to obtain a resource allocation strategy of the ultra-dense Internet of Vehicles. The resource allocation method has the beneficial effect that the resource allocation efficiency is improved.

column12: Data processing method and device and equipment
column13: Embodiments of the invention disclose a data processing method and device, and equipment. The method comprises the steps of acquiring to-be-detected target data provided by a data providing mechanism in a federated learning framework; inputting the target data into a first data risk detection model to obtain a first output result, and inputting the target data into a second data risk detection model to obtain a second output result. The first data risk detection model is obtained by supervising and training first sample data provided by the data providing mechanism in the federated learning framework; the second data risk detection model is obtained by supervising and training second sample data provided by the data providing mechanism in the federated learning framework and a mechanism identifier of the data providing mechanism to which the second sample data belongs through an information reconstruction mode. If the first output result is not matched with the second output result, it is determined that the target data is data containing toxin information.

column12: Security union solving method, device and equipment applied to federated learning and medium
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a security union method and device applied to federated learning, equipment and a medium. A sender and a receiver fill data in respective data sets into n data groups according to a hash function; filling each data group of the respective data set by using a special virtual item, so that the number of data contained in each data group is m + 1; sequentially judging whether each data in each data group of a sender exists in a certain data group of a receiver or not through a reverse private membership test protocol to obtain a judgment index value of each data in each data group of the sender, and determining whether each data in each data group of the sender exists in a certain data group of the receiver according to each judgment index value. Determining all data not in the data set of the receiver in the data set of the sender according to the data set of the receiver and the data in each data set and the corresponding special virtual item, and carrying out summation on the data and the data set of the receiver to obtain a union set of the data of the two parties; and the execution efficiency of the security merging task in federated learning is improved.

column12: High-low voltage motor data processing method, system and device based on federated learning
column13: The invention relates to a high-low voltage motor data processing method, system and device based on federated learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a training sample; after the type of the training model is determined, starting a training algorithm built in a federated computing node device, and extracting features for independent training; encrypting training results and uploading to a cloud server for summary calculation; enabling the cloud server to perform homomorphic encryption to calculate the average gradient and respective loss, returning the average gradient and respective loss to each computing node device in an encryption mode, updating each device model after decryption, and repeating the steps for many times until the model is stable. The method predicts the corresponding motor fault state of the real-time waveform data transmitted to the device according to the optimal model when predicting the running state of the motor. According to the method, a federated learning framework is adopted, so that private data of each enterprise can be well protected, and meanwhile, the accuracy of model training is improved.

column12: Tree model longitudinal federated learning feature importance calculation method and system based on TreeSHAP
column13: The invention provides a tree model longitudinal federated learning feature importance calculation method and system based on TreeSHAP, and the method comprises the steps: predicting a data set, calculating the sample proportion of each node in a tree model, and recording the shunting features used by each sub-tree; traversing each node of the tree by adopting a recursive method, and updating the proportionality coefficient array of each node according to the shunting correctness of the sample and the sample proportion to obtain the proportionality coefficient of each leaf node under the condition of different shunting correctness; and recursively inputting the data set into each node, calculating a shunting correctness vector and a target characteristic shunting correctness vector of each sample according to the shunting characteristic of each node, querying the proportionality coefficient according to the shunting correctness vector of each sample, and calculating the SHAP value of each sample. The calculation method provided by the invention can reduce communication overhead and calculation complexity, improve calculation efficiency and is more suitable for a federated learning environment.

column12: Unmanned aerial vehicle federal learning method fusing clustering and selection optimization
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle mobile communication, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle federated learning method fusing clustering and selection optimization, which comprises the following steps: a cloud issues global model parameters to each unmanned aerial vehicle for training; clustering the unmanned aerial vehicles according to the gradient direction of the unmanned aerial vehicle parameter updating model, and determining an unmanned aerial vehicle set participating in model parameter updating in each cluster based on the delay and resources of the unmanned aerial vehicles; the unmanned aerial vehicles selected for model parameter updating in each cluster perform cluster federated learning to train a model parameter based on the cluster where the unmanned aerial vehicles are located and upload the model parameter to the cloud; the cloud end collects model parameters of all the selected unmanned aerial vehicles, and global model parameters are updated according to the collected model parameters; issuing the updated global model parameters to the unmanned aerial vehicle, and repeating the above operations until a preset number of training times is reached or a training stop condition is satisfied; according to the invention, the operation cost of the unmanned aerial vehicle is obviously reduced, and the intelligence and efficiency level of the whole unmanned aerial vehicle network is improved.

column12: Federal learning method and system combined with personalized differential privacy
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning method and system combined with personalized differential privacy. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a global model of the current round sent by a server; after the global model of the current round is received, using a privacy budget allocation mechanism to obtain privacy parameters of the current round; based on the privacy parameters of the current round, sampling a local data set by using a sampling mechanism; training the global model of the current round on the sampled data set to obtain local model update of the current round; performing noise addition processing on the local model update by applying a Gaussian mechanism to obtain the local model update after noise addition processing; and updating and uploading the local model subjected to noise addition processing to the server, so that the server updates based on the local model subjected to noise addition processing to obtain an updated global model. According to the method, during federal learning, the influence of a differential privacy mechanism on the model effect can be reduced as much as possible under the condition that the personalized privacy requirement of the user is met.

column12: Federal learning method and device combined with differential privacy and storage medium
column13: The invention provides a federal learning method and device combined with differential privacy and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a server initializes global model parameters; when each round of communication begins, the server selects a part of clients from a plurality of clients to participate in training of the clients of the current round, and the server issues global model parameters of the current round to the selected clients; after the selected client receives the global model parameters, local parameters are initialized, and internal updating and external updating are executed locally; after updating of the local model parameters is finished, the client side sends the updated local model parameters to the server, and after the server receives updating from all participating client sides, aggregation operation of the model parameters is executed through weighted aggregation, and new global model parameters are obtained. According to the method, the differential privacy technology is introduced, so that the security and robustness of federal personalized learning are improved.

column12: FPGA accelerator and chip for federated learning and privacy calculation
column13: The invention relates to an FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) accelerator and chip for federated learning and privacy calculation. The FPGA accelerator comprises a plurality of basic operator units, each basic operator unit comprises multiple stages of pipeline operation units, and each stage is configured to select one from multiple basic operations and is further configured to selectively obtain input data from the previous stage and send a calculation result to the next stage. The plurality of basic operator units form a plurality of operator engines, each operator engine comprises at least one basic operator unit which is connected in parallel, and all the basic operator units of the operator engines are subjected to parallel calculation. A plurality of operator engines form at least one operator engine block, and each of the at least one operator engine block comprises at least one operator engine which is combined in a series-parallel connection mode. The FPGA accelerator executes one or more operation tasks through the at least one operator engine block, and the calculation process of the FPGA accelerator can be expanded into a combination of the multiple basic operations. Therefore, the method has improved calculation efficiency and adaptability.

column12: Key collaborative data sharing method of federated learning under block chain
column13: The invention discloses a secret key collaborative data sharing method for federated learning under a block chain, two parties on the block chain form a pair of secret keys and confirm that the opposite parties know the negotiated secret keys, so that packet loss attacks can be resisted. The recipient knows that only the sender can use the key to generate a message to secure the transaction and to resist decryption failure attacks to meet the authenticity of the negotiation key. Besides, the federation training strategy has high efficiency, higher security and stability are provided for data sharing, and the method is suitable for data sharing scenes with high security requirements. In the later stage of iteration, illegal users can be prohibited from participating in training, and the attack success rate is effectively reduced.

column12: Longitudinal federated learning backdoor defense method based on neuron activation value clustering
column13: The invention discloses a longitudinal federated learning backdoor defense method based on neuron activation value clustering. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a longitudinal federated recommendation system comprising a plurality of participants and collaborators; and federated learning: after obtaining a constructed commodity guiding link corresponding to the aggregation embedding representation, the collaboration party classifies the commodity guiding link to effectively screen out a commodity guiding link with potential backdoor attack, and repairs the commodity guiding link with the backdoor attack by using a clustering result. The back door attack commodity sample is guided to learn towards a correct prediction direction, so that the commodity sample of a participant does not need to be obtained, and the repaired commodity recommendation model can defend the back door attack; and the joint embedded representation with the same ID as the aggregation embedded representation of the backdoor attack is filtered or attacked and repaired, so that the parameter optimization of the aggregation embedded representation of the backdoor attack on the commodity recommendation model is prevented or improved, and the defense capability of the commodity recommendation model on the backdoor attack is improved.

column12: Industrial Internet of Things security data sharing method based on block chain and federal learning
column13: The invention discloses an industrial Internet of Things security data sharing method based on a block chain and federated learning, and the method comprises the steps: firstly, enabling a task publishing node to publish a federated learning task, initializing a block chain, and creating a creation block and the initialization parameters of a federated learning model; then, the industrial Internet of Things node downloads the initialization model, local model training is carried out by collecting data generated by local equipment, in the training process, in order to protect the safety and privacy of local data, a self-adaptive differential privacy mechanism is adopted to protect model parameters, and after the training is completed, the local equipment is subjected to local model training; and uploading the data to a block chain network through transaction. The block chain network adopts a consensus committee to verify local parameters of nodes, and adopts a reputation mechanism and model quality to measure participating nodes, so that poisoning attacks of malicious nodes are prevented. And finally, after verification is completed, fusing model parameters by adopting a federal aggregation algorithm, and packaging the fused model parameters to the block chain network, so that the participating nodes and the task publisher can update the global model. According to the method, the influence of noise and malicious nodes on the model precision is reduced while the parameter privacy is protected. And data sharing and privacy protection can be realized with relatively high model accuracy.

column12: Federal learning scheduling system

The method has the beneficial technical effects that unified scheduling of the federal learning related tasks is realized through the task scheduler, so that the participants of the federal learning perform synchronous calculation, the mutual waiting time is shortened, and the efficiency of the federal learning is improved.

column12: Systems and methods for using federated learning for training centralized seizure detection and prediction models on decentralized datasets
column13: A server for updating a current version of a machine learning model resident in implanted medical devices includes an interface, a memory, and a processor. The interface is configured to receive a plurality of updated versions of the machine learning model from a plurality of remote sources remote from the server. The remote source may be, e.g., implanted medical devices and/or subservers. The processor is coupled to the memory and the interface and is configured to aggregate the plurality of updated versions to derive a server-updated version of the machine learning model, and to transmit the server-updated version of the machine learning model to one or more of the plurality of remote sources as a replacement for the current version of the machine learning model.

column12: Block chain federated learning security aggregation framework based on hierarchical index screening
column13: The invention discloses a block chain federated learning security aggregation framework based on hierarchical index screening, and relates to the technical field of federated learning, and the framework comprises a pre-training stage, a formal training stage and an aggregation stage, in the pre-training stage, a training client participates in pre-training and uploads a calculated loss value to a block chain; in the formal training stage, the credible client trains the model and provides a scoring standard, the training client trains and uploads local model parameters, the credible client scores the local model and calculates the weight of the local model, and the credible client uploads a model trust score and the weight; and an aggregation stage: performing model aggregation according to the model trust score and the weight to obtain a current-round global model and performing uplink. According to the method, trust score aggregation is carried out on the uploaded local model through the FLTrust algorithm, malicious clients are eliminated, the Byzantine attack is coped to a certain extent, the accuracy of the finally obtained global model is ensured, the aggregation speed is increased through loss prediction and aggregation weight, and a better global model is obtained with fewer convergence rounds.

column12: Model training method based on federated learning
column13: The invention discloses a model training method based on federated learning. In order to protect privacy (model parameters) of a server from being leaked, a server adopts a homomorphic encryption algorithm to encrypt a model parameter set and then issues the encrypted model parameter set to a node, and the node performs model calculation in an encrypted state by using the encrypted model parameters and a local training sample based on a homomorphic encryption principle to obtain an encryption gradient. Subsequently, the node calculates a difference between the encryption gradient and the encryption random number based on the homomorphic encryption principle, this difference being substantially a meaningless value of the encryption. And then, the node uploads the encrypted value to a server. Furthermore, the server can acquire the sum of the random numbers on each node by utilizing an SA protocol on the premise of not acquiring the random number on each node. Thus, the server can restore the sum of gradients generated by each node according to the sum of the encrypted value uploaded by each node and each random number, so that model parameters can be updated.

column13: The invention relates to an image semantic segmentation-oriented personalized federal learning method, which belongs to the technical field of wireless communication, and comprises the following steps: S1, establishing an edge network system consisting of a plurality of user nodes and an edge server, each user node being configured with a sensing device capable of collecting segmented image data, data among different users are not independently distributed; s2, establishing a personalized federated learning model of mutual decoupling double-layer parallel optimization, wherein the personalized federated learning model comprises an inner-layer optimization problem based on Moire envelope improvement and an outer-layer optimization problem used for generating a local model; s3, the user node and the edge server cooperatively train and update the personalized model, and then update the corresponding local model; s4, the edge server collects local models uploaded by the user nodes, aggregates and updates a global model, and then returns to the user nodes participating in training in next iteration; and S5, repeating the steps S3-S4, and obtaining a solution of the optimization problem after a convergence condition is reached.

column12: Network intrusion cooperative detection method based on federated learning
column13: The invention discloses a network intrusion cooperative detection method based on federated learning. column12: Federal learning-based gradient compression framework for adaptive privacy budget allocation
column13: The invention discloses a gradient compression framework for adaptive privacy budget allocation based on federated learning. The gradient compression framework comprises a gradient dimension reduction compression module based on Top-k, a privacy protection module based on local differential privacy, a parameter aggregation module of communication rounds and an adaptive privacy budget allocation module. Before a client side uploads gradient parameters obtained through training of the client side to a server, the current gradient parameters are compressed through a gradient dimension reduction compression module based on Top-k, then the gradient parameters are disturbed through a privacy protection module based on local differential privacy, and then the compressed and disturbed gradient parameters are uploaded to the server. The server aggregates the gradient parameters uploaded by the client; and finally, a privacy budget is allocated according to the required noise quantity in different rounds of training through a self-adaptive privacy budget allocation module. According to the method, the communication cost, the noise size and the total privacy budget loss of the model are reduced, and the model accuracy is good.

column12: Flow auditing method and device based on federated learning, and storage medium
column13: The invention provides a flow auditing method and device based on federated learning, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: a training node generates a private key and a public key, and transmits the public key, a randomly selected target original data packet, and a reference random number and a proof file generated through a VRF function to a monitoring node according to a public random parameter and the private key; and the monitoring node captures the training data packet, obtains an inspection random number through a Ver if VRF function, determines a target training data packet according to a transmission sequence of the target original data packet when the inspection random number is matched with a reference random number corresponding to the target original data packet, and obtains a traffic auditing result of the training node through comparison of the data packets. According to the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the verification of random sampling inspection can be realized by using the VRF function and the Ver if VRF function, so that the training node is prevented from knowing the sampled data in advance, the reliability of flow audit is effectively improved, and the consumption of communication resources is effectively reduced as only one-time overhead is needed to send related data.

column12: Method, system and device for updating model parameters based on federated learning
column13: The invention relates to a method, system and device for updating model parameters based on federated learning. The method, system and device can be used for data privacy protection. The method is implemented by any training member in a participant, and comprises the steps of performing multiple rounds of updating on model parameters, one round of iterative updating comprising: obtaining a to-be-trained model having the same structure as other participants, the to-be-trained model comprising a plurality of network layers; training based on the held training samples and sample labels to obtaina gradient matrix; updating a first-order moment matrix and a second-order moment matrix based on the gradient matrix, the first-order moment matrix and the second-order moment matrix respectively comprising a plurality of layer sub-matrixes in one-to-one correspondence with the network layers of the model to be trained; interacting with a server, and transmitting at least part of elements in at least part of the layer sub-matrixes to the server layer by layer, so that the server updates model parameters layer by layer; and obtaining updated model parameters from the server so as to take the updated model parameters as a to-be-trained model for next training, or determining a final model based on the updated model parameters.

column12: Distributed communication system and method

column12: Federal learning method and device under data heterogeneity and system heterogeneity conditions
column13: The embodiment of the invention discloses a federated learning method and device under data heterogeneity and system heterogeneity conditions. The federated learning method and device are used for relieving the influence of client data heterogeneity and system heterogeneity on the federated learning effect. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention comprises the following steps: calculating a data heterogeneity index of each client after N rounds of federated learning; based on the sampled condition of each client in the first N rounds of federated learning, determining the minimum unsampled round interval corresponding to each client; based on the minimum unsampled round interval corresponding to each client, determining a system heterogeneity index of each client after N rounds of federated learning; based on the data heterogeneity index of each client after N rounds of federated learning and the system heterogeneity index of each client, determining a comprehensive heterogeneity index of each client after N rounds of federated learning; and according to the comprehensive heterogeneity index of each client after N rounds of federated learning, determining the client participating in the (N + 1) th round of federated learning from the plurality of clients.

column12: Edge cloud based computing system for performing associative learning
column13: The present invention relates to an edge cloud-based computing system for performing federated learning, which can perform hierarchical artificial intelligence learning in an edge cloud-based distributed environment, thereby increasing security and quickly processing large amounts of data generated in real time in an edge computing environment, and a method thereof. To this end, the edge cloud-based computing system for performing federated learning comprises: a plurality of edge clouds applying, to a previously distributed master model, data generated in real time by a plurality of edge devices to train the master model, and transmitting local parameters, which are changed learning contents, to the outside; and a central cloud updating the previously distributed master model by integrating the local parameters received from each of the plurality of edge clouds.

column12: Cloud host load prediction method based on federated learning

And the effects of reducing the cloud host performance index data sent to the outside and better protecting the privacy of the user are achieved.

column12: Federal learning engine alignment method, federal learning method, federal learning device and electronic equipment

column12: Data privacy protection method and system based on adaptive weight adjustment
column13: The invention provides a data privacy protection method and system based on self-adaptive weight adjustment, solves the problems of model performance reduction and slow convergence speed caused by non-independent identically distributed data, and belongs to the technical field of federated learning application. column12: FEDERATED LEARNING METHOD BASED ON CONSENSUS
column13: The present invention relates to a method for performing associative learning based on consensus of clients to prevent a Byzantine attack. column12: FEDERATED UNLEARNING METHOD BASED ON MALICIOUS TERMINAL INTERVENTION TRAINING

column13: The invention provides a federated learning method and device based on a tree topological structure, relates to the technical field of machine learning, and aims to solve the problems of overlong federated aggregation time and high network transmission pressure. A tree-shaped topological structure of the method comprises at least two layers of structures. Each layer of structure comprises at leastone node, and each node corresponds to a training model. Accordingto the method, the network transmission pressure of the layered tree topological structure during federation aggregation is reduced, and the speed of federation aggregation is increased.

column12: Federated learning model training method and system
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning model training method and system. The method comprises the steps that a central server sends initial parameters to all node devices; each node device performs model training based on the initial parameters and a local data set, and obtains a gradient value; the central server generates a key pair and sends the public key to each node device; each node device uses the public key to encrypt the gradient value to obtain an encryption gradient; each node device calculates the encryption gradient sum in a point-to-point mode and sends the encryption gradient sum to the central server; the central server decrypts the encryption gradient sum through a private key to obtain a gradient sum, and sends the gradient sum to each node device; and the node devices perform the next round of model training according to the updated parameters and the local data set based on the gradient and the parameters of the updated model until the training stop conditionis satisfied. The method can ensure the privacy data of all participants and ensure the precision of model training.

column12: HORIZONTAL FEDERATED REGRESSION RANDOM FOREST WITH SECURE AGGREGATION
column13: A horizontal federated random forest regressor with secure aggregation is disclosed. When constructing a node of a decision tree, multiple potential splits are performed at each of multiple edge nodes using local data. Federated variance data, which includes sums, is generated and transmitted to a central node. Using the sums, a global variance can be determined for each of the splits without requiring the individual nodes to share the specific samples. The split with the lowest global variance is selected by the central node and implemented for the node of the decision tree at each of the edge nodes. A random forest regressor can be constructed and trained such that each of the edge nodes includes the same random forest regressor with the same splits for the features at the nodes of the decision trees that constitute the random forest regressor.

column12: Data protection method, device and system based on asynchronous grouping federated learning

Through the scheme of the invention, data security risks are avoided, data security is ensured, and bandwidth resources are saved.

column12: Semi-supervised federated learning method combining self-integration and cross-model integration
column13: The invention relates to a semi-supervised federated learning method combining self-integration and cross-model integration. The method comprises the following steps: S1, each participant performs training by using local data to obtain a local model; s2, all participants upload the trained local model to a central server for parameter fusion to obtain a global model; s3, the central server broadcasts the global model to all participants; s4, the participant uses the global model as a new local model, and starts a new round of local training on the new local model; and S5, returning to the step S1, and circularly executing until a preset condition is met. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the characteristic that a plurality of local models are generated in parallel in federal learning is utilized, a cross-model integration scheme and a self-integration scheme are combined, a teacher model is more reliable while the calculation amount is relatively small, and therefore a better training effect can be obtained.

column12: XGBoost-based cross-sample federated learning and testing method, system, equipment and medium
column13: The invention relates to an XGBoost-based cross-sample federated learning and testing method, system and equipment and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning. The learning method comprises the steps that each training party server uses local sample data federation to train an XGBoost tree model, local modeling parameters are sent to an aggregating party server in each training stage, and the aggregating party server judges whether a current node is a leaf node or not according to the modeling parameters in each training stage; if the current node is a non-leaf node, the current node is splitted according to the optimal division sent by the aggregator server, and the current node is updated as a split node; if the current node is the leaf node, splitting of the current node is stopped; a tree model is generated until all nodes are leaf nodes; and when a preset number of tree models are generated, training is stopped to obtain a cross-sample federated XGBoost tree model. According to the invention, after discrete cosine transform is carried out on the image collected by the client, the direct current component is removed from the transform result, the noise is added to the image after the direct current component is removed, and the image is sent to the training server, and because the image sent to the training server is high-frequency information after the direct current component is removed and the noise is added, the image is more accurate. Meanwhile, in order to improve the recognition accuracy, the image subjected to Gaussian blur processing is sent to a training server for integrated learning, and due to the fact that the sent image is subjected to Gaussian blur processing, face privacy leakage cannot be caused. The method can be applied to the technical field of face recognition.

column12: Financial abnormal behavior detection method and system based on federated learning privacy protection
column13: The invention provides a financial abnormal behavior detection method and system based on federated learning privacy protection, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and data security, and the method comprises the steps: merging a candidate sample with original data, then carrying out local training, and outputting an update parameter of a local model; the locally updated model weight parameters are encrypted, and security aggregation is carried out after updating; and decrypting the updated weight of the encryption model, re-encrypting the global model and returning the encrypted global model to the local node, decrypting the global model by the local node, comparing the global model with the local model in precision, updating parameters, and performing loop iteration until the performance index of the global model tends to be stable. column12: FEDERATED LEARNING FOR DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS IN A WIRELESS COMMUNICATION SYSTEM
column13: Aspects describe federated learning for deep neural networks, DNNs, in a wireless communication system. The network entity requests (620), from each UE in the set of UEs, respective updated ML information generated by the respective UE using a training procedure and local input data. The network entity then receives (640), from at least some UEs in the set of UEs, the respective updated ML information determined by the respective UE. The network entity identifies (645) a subset of UEs in the set of UEs and determines (650) a common ML configuration for the subset of UEs. column12: Federal learning model poisoning reconstruction method and device, medium and equipment
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning model poisoning reconstruction method and device, a medium and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a poisoning federated learning model; based on the accuracy rate of the local model of each client during the training period, screening out poisoned clients during the training period of the federated learning model, deleting the local model obtained by aggregating the poisoned clients in the federated learning model, taking the poisoned clients as malicious nodes, taking the non-poisoned clients as honest nodes, and taking the local model as the local model; removing the malicious node from the initial DAG network to obtain a second DAG network; and based on the local models of the honest nodes in the second DAG network, aggregating the local models of the honest nodes round by round to obtain a latest global model of the federated learning model, and completing poisoning reconstruction of the federated learning model. According to the method, malicious nodes can be quickly eliminated, existing stage training results are added into a new round of training, and the training efficiency and the anti-attack ability of federal learning are improved.

column12: Traffic flow prediction method based on block chain and federal learning fusion

column12: Communication link recommendation method and device for federated learning

column12: Method, system and device for optimizing federated learning compression communication

column12: Model training method and device based on specific federated learning

column12: Hybrid client-server federated learning of machine learning models
column13: Implementations disclosed herein relate to federated learning of a machine learning ("ML") model based on gradient (s) generated at corresponding client devices and remote systems. The processor (s) of the corresponding client device can process client data generated locally at the corresponding client device using the corresponding on-device ML model (s) to generate corresponding predicted outputs, generate corresponding client gradients based on the corresponding predicted outputs, and transmit the corresponding client gradients to the remote system. The processor (s) of the remote system can process remote data obtained from the remote database (s) using the global ML model (s) to generate additional corresponding prediction outputs based on which corresponding remote gradients are generated. Further, the remote system can update the global ML model (s) or weights thereof with the corresponding client gradient and the corresponding remote gradient. The updated global ML model (s) and/or its updated weights can be transmitted back to the corresponding client device.

column12: Longitudinal federal learning task execution method and system based on generative model
column13: The invention relates to a longitudinal federated learning task execution method and system based on a generative model, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps that participants jointly select a preset model to carry out a longitudinal federated learning task, and the longitudinal federated learning task is decomposed into a plurality of subtasks containing part of learning data; in the subtasks, gradient information and loss information are calculated; taking random noise, the calculation gradient information and the loss information as input, and adopting a generation model to map the random noise to obtain a mapping result; sending the mapping result to an opponent, and calculating a difference value between the mapping result and real data of the opponent by using a loss function; according to the scheme disclosed by the invention, available parameters of other participants can be learned in each longitudinal federated learning process, the universality of federated learning is improved, and strong dependence on data of other participants is reduced.

column12: Network attack detection method for equipment heterogeneous federated learning
column13: The invention discloses a network attack detection method oriented to equipment heterogeneous federated learning. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, sampling flow data and constructing a compensation data set; secondly, the server initializes a global model and issues model parameters to the client, and the client integrates flow data obtained by the client, constructs an attack flow data set of this round, completes local training and outputs an attack detection result. And then the client uploads the model parameters and the correct rate to the server, and the server performs parameter aggregation by taking the correct rate as a weight coefficient, and updates global model parameters. And finally, the server carries out correct rate judgment and issues compensation data and global model parameters, and the client receives the global model parameters and the compensation data and carries out local model parameter and data set updating. According to the method, the data isomerism is remarkably broken through, the adaptive capacity of a federated system to continuous distribution drifting is enhanced, and network attack detection is accurately completed.

column12: Federal learning node selection method and system based on gradient similarity measurement
column13: The invention relates to a federated learning node selection method and system based on gradient similarity measurement, and the method comprises the following steps: each node obtains a latest model, carries out the local training, and obtains a local updated gradient; each node submits the locally updated gradient to the central server; the central server receives the gradients of the nodes, similarity calculation is carried out on every two gradients, a similarity matrix is obtained, and the element value in the similarity matrix is the similarity between the gradients of the two nodes; and a reliable node set is obtained through similarity screening, gradient of nodes in the reliable node set is aggregated, the model is updated, the updated model is issued to each node, and a round of federated learning is completed. column12: Secret sharing-based model aggregation method in federated learning
column13: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence security, and provides a model aggregation method based on secret sharing in federated learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1, a central server selects a client participating in iterative training and issues an initial global model parameter; 2, in each round of iterative training, the central server distributes a non-zero parameter for each client participating in the round of training, and the client constructs local model parameters trained in the round into secret polynomials about the non-zero parameters; step 3, each client sends the secret polynomial value to other clients, and the client adds all polynomial values related to self non-zero parameters and transmits the obtained sum value to the central server; and step 4, the central server constructs an equation set, and solves the equation set to obtain aggregation model parameters of the training of this round. According to the method, the client local model can be effectively prevented from being acquired by other parties, and the risk that the client local data is leaked is reduced.

column12: Personalized federated learning system based on Lora and double adapters

According to the method, the training efficiency of the personalized federated learning model is remarkably improved, and the generalization and robustness of the personalized model are greatly improved.

column12: Communication method and device for federated learning model training and electronic equipment

column12: Mixed privacy protection image classification method based on federal model distillation
column13: The invention discloses a mixed privacy protection image classification method based on federal model distillation. The method comprises the following steps: 1, pre-training a local neural network by a client; 2, the central server obtains a public data set, randomly samples the public data set and then issues the public data set to the client; 3, the client predicts the issued data; 4, the client performs norm cutting on the prediction result, randomly splits the prediction result into prediction fragments, and sends the prediction fragments to the corresponding client according to numbers; 5, the client aggregates the prediction fragments to obtain confusion prediction and uploads the confusion prediction to the central server; 6, the central server aggregates the confusion predictions and adds noise to obtain global predictions, and then issues the global predictions to the client; 7, training the local neural network by the client through global prediction distillation, and then reviewing and training the local neural network; and 8, the client performs image classification by using the local neural network. According to the invention, based on a federated model distillation algorithm, privacy-protected image classification is realized by using a secret sharing thought and a differential privacy technology.

column12: Fog-based federated learning backdoor attack defense scheme
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning backdoor attack defense method based on fog. column12: Federal learning poisoning attack defense method based on dual detection of server and client

The server selects the suspicious client and the credible client according to the result of the poisoning attack detector, and completes poisoning attack detection by integrating the score of the credible client to the suspicious client, thereby reducing the false alarm rate of anomaly detection of the server. Thereby, poisoning attack detection under the federated learning background can be efficiently completed on the premise of ensuring the accuracy.

column12: Method for optimizing federated learning model by using frozen model layer

column12: Semi-asynchronous federated learning framework based on tree graph block chain
column13: Federal learning based on a linear block chain is limited by a block chain performance bottleneck in a heterogeneous environment, so that the training efficiency is low. A directed acyclic graph block chain is introduced in a current solution to solve the problem, but the directed acyclic graph block chain sacrifices the verifiability of the block chain, an outdated model is difficult to process, and the convergence speed is low. The invention discloses a semi-asynchronous federated learning framework based on a tree graph block chain, and the bottom block chain structure design is a directed acyclic graph taking a block as a center, so as to support verifiable and semi-asynchronous training. In order to promote rapid convergence, a trunk chain generation algorithm is designed, topological sorting is carried out on a semi-asynchronous training process, and a client is guided to sample a proper model. In addition, a consensus mechanism is closely combined with federal learning, so that attacks aiming at the model and the block chain system can be effectively resisted.

column12: APPARATUS AND METHODS FOR MULTI-STAGE MACHINE LEARNING WITH CASCADED MODELS
column13: Data heterogeneity has been shown to reduce the convergence speed and model accuracy in existing federated learning (FL) and distributed learning (DL) based artificial intelligence or machine learning (AI/ML) model training processes. A multi-stage training process for the cascaded AI/ML model is also provided.

column12: Hierarchical federal learning system based on super network
column13: The invention discloses a hierarchical federated learning system based on a super network. And each edge node uploads quantized and sparse model parameters to the cloud server, and the cloud server performs federal aggregation by adopting a weighted average method to generate a global model and feeds back the global model to each terminal on the premise of ensuring data security. In order to adapt to the practical application of a low-power-consumption chip, a dynamic voltage frequency regulation technology is introduced in the hardware level, and the energy consumption and the communication overhead are effectively reduced. column12: Federal learning method oriented to mobile recommendation and based on semantics

In addition, the method adopts a three-layer federated architecture of client-edge-server to relieve the computing and communication pressure of the server. column12: Method and system for defending backdoor attack in federated learning field
column13: The invention discloses a method and a system for defending a backdoor attack in the federated learning field. The method comprises the following steps: S1, a participant and a server acquire data through respective data collection modes; s2, pre-training the global model for a plurality of rounds by the server through a data set of the server, recording a model update quantity and a finally obtained pre-training model, and training a recurrent neural network model by using the model update quantity; s3, a participant downloads the global model, uses a data set of the participant to train for a plurality of rounds, and uploads an update amount to a server; s4, comparing the model update quantity obtained by the server with the update quantity of each participant, performing scoring, performing weighted summation on double scores, and excluding the client update with the summation score lower than a threshold value from the training of this round; s5, aggregating model updating from the high-score client and the local server to obtain a new round of model updating quantity, updating the global model and the recurrent neural network model, and recording the model updating quantity; and S6, repeating the processes from S3 to S5 until the model converges.

column12: Chain federated learning method based on grouping and weight self-optimization
column13: The invention provides a chain type federated learning method based on grouping and weight self-optimization. The method comprises the following steps: a server side groups all clients; initializing relevant parameters and storing a test set; executing subsequent steps starting from the first group of clients; the server side issues the current global model to the current group client side; each client in the current group carries out local training on the received global model, and sends a local model obtained by training to a server; the server side uses the test set to test all the received local models, the weight of each local model is obtained through updating, all the local models are aggregated to obtain a new global model, and the new global model is returned to the current group client side; the current group of clients transmits the new global model to the next group of clients; the above steps are repeated until the current client is the last group of clients, and the global model obtained by the server at the moment is the global optimal model.

column12: Federal semi-supervised learning method suitable for accurate classification, medium and equipment

According to the method, semi-supervised learning and federated learning are combined in an edge calculation scene, the model fully learns knowledge contained in the unlabeled data by using the unlabeled data, and supervised training is performed on the model by using the labeled data to correct model parameters, so that the accuracy of model classification is improved on the whole.

column12: Local federated learning method for partial pressure aggregation in Internet of Vehicles scene

column12: Method for protecting user data privacy and resisting hostile attackers under federated learning
column13: The invention provides a method for protecting user data privacy and resisting hostile attackers under federated learning. According to the method, firstly, users are divided into different groups, secondly, a verifiable lottery drawing algorithm is introduced, the lottery drawing algorithm can enable the users to locally calculate whether the users are in the lottery or not, and the result can verify whether the users are true or not for other users. On the basis of a lot drawing algorithm, the invention further designs a cloud-edge joint encryption algorithm, and the encryption algorithm can realize the aggregation of ciphertexts and reduce the calculation overhead of a user. column12: Federal learning security aggregation method based on differential privacy
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning security aggregation method based on differential privacy, and the method comprises the steps: a server distributes privacy budget to each client according to collected information, and makes a score data set; and the client initializes a model training optimizer according to the allocated privacy budget, carries out model training to obtain model updating data, and then uploads data to the server according to the privacy budget. column12: MAINTAINING PRIVACY DURING ATTRIBUTION OF A CONDITION

column12: Method for distributing participant weights in federated learning based on clustering algorithm
column13: The invention discloses a method for distributing participant weights in federated learning based on a clustering algorithm. The method specifically comprises the following steps: each participant receives global model parameters, carries out training by using a local data set, uploads local model parameters to a central server after completing local training, and continues to carry out local training on uncompleted participants; after receiving the local models uploaded by at least 50% of participants, the central server carries out vectorization processing on the received model parameters and carries out clustering by using a clustering algorithm, selects a clustering result with the highest score, measures the distance between each intra-class center and each inter-class center, uses the reciprocal of the distance as the weight value of each class of participants, and carries out clustering on the participants; aggregating to obtain a global model and issuing the global model to the corresponding participants, and continuing to perform local training by the participants; and the central server continuously receives the local models uploaded by the participants, and clustering is continued until the global model converges. column12: Heterogeneous robust federated learning method based on self-paced learning
column13: The invention discloses a heterogeneous robust federated learning technology based on self-paced learning. The problem to be solved by the technology is that a traditional federal learning method cannot effectively solve the influence of noise inside a client and noise between heterogeneous clients on a model, and the noise inside the client is usually caused by human professional knowledge difference, so that data set labeling errors are caused; noise feedback among heterogeneous clients causes poor generalization ability of a finally trained common model. A self-paced learning thought is taken as a starting point, negative effects caused by noise are reduced, and the robustness of the model is enhanced. According to the architecture, a self-paced learning mechanism is used, the loss between a prediction label and a real label is calculated, and each sample is added to a local model for updating training in a simple-to-difficult manner; and finally, a corresponding weight is allocated to each client, so that the influence of noisy client knowledge on the overall model is reduced, more attention is paid to clients with clean data sets and efficient models, and the accuracy and robustness of the model are improved.

According to the application, different target nodes are set in different network environments, and then the target nodes select the cooperative nodes, so that the problem that the cooperative nodes in an internal network environment cannot actively perform federated learning modeling with the application nodes in an external network environment is solved.

column12: Federal learning client selection method paying attention to scarce data category
column13: A federated learning client selection method paying attention to scarce data categories comprises the following steps: 1) a server enters a federated learning task preparation process, issues a federated learning task and an award, and waits for a client to apply to join the federated learning task; 2) the server defines and parameterizes a data evaluation function, evaluates data values of all clients applying for joining the federated learning task according to local data information provided by the clients, and scores the data values based on an evaluation result; 3) after determining the score of each client, sorting all the clients according to the scores, selecting to join the federal learning task from the client with the highest score, and determining the payment reward of the selected client; and 4) the server starts a federal learning task according to a selection result of the client. column13: The invention provides a trusted online and offline federated learning method and system based on Shamir secret sharing, and relates to the technical field of distributed computing and cryptography. The method comprises the following steps: a secret key generation center distributes a secret key for a newly registered user; the model requester determines a threshold value according to a task demand, selects a secret value, performs secret segmentation according to the total number of pre-distributed data providers, and transmits a secret share to the server; the data provider trains a local model by using local data, encrypts the local model by using a public key of a model requester, and sends a ciphertext parameter to the server; the server performs secret recovery on the secret share; if the number of the obtained secret shares exceeds the threshold value requirement, the secret is recovered successfully, and model parameters are aggregated and sent to a model requester; otherwise, the server continues to wait until the number of the obtained secret shares reaches the threshold value requirement. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of data privacy, model security and calculation complexity.

column12: Modal heterogeneous federated learning privacy protection method based on cross-modal prototype
column13: The invention relates to a modal heterogeneous federated learning privacy protection method based on a cross-modal prototype, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and information security. The server firstly initializes a global model for each client, wherein the global model comprises a mapping module of a corresponding mode of the client; and the server sends the initialized model to the corresponding client. The multi-mode client initializes a private prototype learning model. And local model training is carried out by using the global model, the single-mode client and the multi-mode client. And after the local prototype and the local model sent by the client are received, the server executes prototype aggregation and model aggregation respectively. And after receiving the global prototype pair and the global mapping module, the client updates the local mapping module and starts a new round of training until a specific number of training rounds is reached. According to the method and the device, the communication overhead can be reduced, local models are not required to have the same structure, and a single-mode client can acquire information from a missing mode prototype in a targeted manner.

column12: Efficient federated learning method based on clustering client selection and bandwidth allocation
column13: The invention discloses an efficient federal learning method based on clustering client selection and bandwidth allocation, which comprises the following steps that: an edge server collects information of clients, and clusters the clients according to the local data distribution condition; in each round of training, the edge server selects candidate clients from each client cluster according to client utility and allocates bandwidth, and broadcasts a to-be-trained global classification model to all clients; each candidate client uses local data to train a global classification model to be trained and uploads trained model parameters to the edge server; the edge server performs weighted average aggregation on all the received trained model parameters to obtain a new global classification model of the current round of training and issues the new global classification model, and whether the performance of the new global classification model reaches the expectation or not is judged; if not, carrying out the next round of training; if yes, training is ended, and a trained global classification model is obtained and used for federal learning classification tasks. According to the invention, the training efficiency of edge federation learning can be improved, and the classification accuracy is improved.

column12: Evaluation method and system of dynamic federated learning algorithm based on multiple nodes
column13: The invention discloses an evaluation method and system for a multi-node-based dynamic federated learning algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: S1, after the last iteration is completed, recording each calculation and interaction time of each node in the last iteration; judging the convergence condition of the last iteration according to the iteration variable; if not, entering the step S2; when convergence is carried out, iteration is stopped, and a target evaluation result is output; s2, calculating the average time of each node in the last iteration or the previous N iterations according to the calculation and interaction time of each node in the last iteration; according to the average time, judging whether the node with the longest average time adopts a second cryptographic algorithm and the node with the shortest average time adopts a first cryptographic algorithm, and carrying out calculation and current iteration on the federal learning model; and S3, taking the current iteration as the last iteration, and returning to S1. According to the method, the calculation efficiency of all the nodes is matched as much as possible, federal learning is completed at the same time, the overall calculation efficiency is improved, and the calculation safety is guaranteed.

column12: MODEL PARAMETER ACQUISITION METHOD AND SYSTEM BASED ON FEDERATED LEARNING, AND READABLE STORAGE MEDIUM
column13: Disclosed are a model parameter acquisition method and system based on federated learning, and a readable storage medium. column12: Decentralized federated machine learning method under privacy protection

column12: Longitudinal federated learning privacy protection method and system based on deep hash
column13: The invention discloses a longitudinal federated learning privacy protection method and system based on deep hash, and belongs to the technical field of distributed machine learning security. Obtaining abstract representation of samples through local models of partners, obtaining a zero-mean continuous code through a normalization layer, and binarizing the continuous code by using a hash layer to obtain a hash code; each participant uploads the Hash codes to the server side, the server side aggregates the Hash codes of each participant, calculates a predicted value through a top-layer model, calculates classification loss according to the predicted value and a label, calculates cosine similarity loss between the Hash codes of each participant by using a pre-generated binary code, calculates a gradient through the loss, updates the top-layer model, and calculates the classification loss through the top-layer model. And distributing respective gradients to partners, wherein the gradients remain unchanged when propagating in a local Hash layer. According to the method, the deep hash technology is utilized, the model performance is not lost on the premise of guaranteeing the safety of user data, the calculation efficiency is improved to a great extent, and the risk that the model is reversely reconstructed by an attacker does not exist.

column12: Federal learning method based on Shapley value
column13: The invention provides a federal learning method based on a Shapley value. According to the method, the difference of data distribution of different clients in federated learning is considered, and when global model parameters are obtained, weighted aggregation is carried out on the parameters according to contribution of local training models of the clients to an overall training target. After each round of iterative training of federal learning, a weighted graph is constructed according to cosine similarity among local model parameters of each client, and a Shapley value of a vertex of each client in the graph is calculated. And the server sets a corresponding weight coefficient for the model parameter of each client based on the Shapley value of the client, and performs weighted aggregation on the model parameter of the client according to the coefficient to obtain a global model parameter of the next round of training until a training target is reached.

column12: Edge pre-caching strategy based on federated learning in vehicle-mounted content center network

Each RSU carries out the self-training of a model according to the locally collected data, then carries out the summarization of the models obtained through the training of each RSU through federal learning, carries out the weighted averaging of the models according to the data size, and carries out the unified distribution of the summarized models to each RSU. And finally, the priority of the repeated content in cache replacement is reduced according to the cache list of the neighbor node, thereby reducing the cache redundancy.

column12: Longitudinal federated learning method based on fully homomorphic ScureBoost model

column12: TEE federated learning privacy protection method based on proxy re-encryption
column13: The invention discloses a TEE federated learning privacy protection method based on proxy re-encryption, and belongs to the field of public key cryptosystem. Comprising the following steps: (1) establishing proxy re-encryption communication; (2) the server issues a federation strategy; (3) the participant performs local learning to obtain gradient parameters, encrypts the gradient parameters and sends the gradient parameters to the agent; (4) the agent side carries out re-encryption operation on the message and sends the message to the server side; (5) the server side decrypts the message; (6) the server side aggregates the gradient parameters, encrypts the gradient parameters and sends the gradient parameters to the agent side; (7) the agent performs re-encryption operation on the message and sends the message to the participant; (8) the participant decrypts the message to obtain a gradient parameter and continues to carry out model training; and (9) repeating the steps (3)-(8) until federal learning converges. The proxy re-encryption scheme used in the transmission process belongs to an NTRU lattice public key cryptosystem, and anti-quantum security and anti-collusion are met; calculation at the endpoint is performed in the TEE to ensure privacy security of the endpoint.

column12: Methods and apparatus for support of vertical federated learning at network data analytics function (NWDAF)
column13: Apparatus and methods to perform vertical federated learning (VFL) in a network, e.g. 5G New Radio network. At step 13, a VFL server, such as a Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) hosting VFL functionality, receives a message from a service consumer such as a consumer network function (NF). The message may be a subscription to analytics or a request for analytics. At step 14, a distributed VFL inference process is triggered by the VFL server invoking a Machine Learning (ML) model inference request. The request is transmitted to a participant, i.e. a VFL client entity which may also be a NWDAF. At step 15, based on the request, the VFL client entity obtains intermediate inference results by performing local inference computation using a local ML model. At step 16, if the VFL client entity is the last participant, the intermediate inference results are transmitted to the VFL server. At step 17, the VFL server performs further inference computation on the received intermediate inference results and derives the requested analytics which may be delivered to the NF consumer at step 18. The VFL server may discover or select the VFL client entities to participate in the VFL procedure.

column12: Federal learning method meeting personalized local differential privacy requirements
column13: The invention relates to a federal learning method meeting personalized local differential privacy requirements, and belongs to the technical field of network and information security. column12: MePC-F model-based real-time federal learning data privacy security strengthening method in Internet of Vehicles
column13: The invention discloses a real-time federal learning data privacy security strengthening method based on an MePC-F model in the Internet of Vehicles. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a plurality of edge servers Ei and a cloud server CS; the edge server Ei downloads the initial A-type gradient from the cloud server CS and decrypts the initial A-type gradient into a randomly initialized B-type gradient for local model training; the edge server Ei obtains part of gradient information needing to be reserved from the edge server Ej through a decoding function, performs homomorphic encryption on the remaining gradient information, and broadcasts and sends the remaining gradient information to all other edge servers Ej through an MePC algorithm; all edge servers update the shared A-type gradient information and upload all edge servers to a cloud server CS, and the cloud server CS aggregates global parameters through a PreFLa algorithm; and repeating the steps until a termination condition is reached. According to the invention, data leakage between ends is prevented, data privacy security protection is realized, and the communication overhead is reduced while original data leakage is prevented.

column12: Federal learning-based wearable behavior recognition model training and behavior recognition method
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of behavior recognition, and provides a wearable behavior recognition model training and behavior recognition method based on federated learning, and the method comprises the steps: firstly constructing an auxiliary data set of wearable behaviors, and obtaining data collected by a plurality of wearable device clients; performing federated learning on the auxiliary data set to obtain a first model; performing federated learning on the data of the at least one client to obtain at least one second model; then, calculating a weight difference between the second model and the first model; according to the size of the weight difference value, sorting the clients participating in federated learning in an ascending order to obtain a client contribution value list; selecting a preset number of clients arranged in the front in the client contribution value list to form a client set for federated learning training; performing federal learning by using data on the clients in the client set to obtain a wearable behavior recognition model; on the basis of protecting user data privacy, a better global model can be obtained.

column12: HOMOMORPHIC ENCRYPTION METHOD AND SYSTEM BASED ON FEDERATED FACTORIZATION MACHINE, DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM
column13: Disclosed in the present application are a homomorphic encryption method and system based on a federated factorization machine, a device and a storage medium. In a training process of a federated factorization machine, multiplication operation between data from different data parties can be omitted by means of reasonable linear approximation, and only addition is performed for the data, so that application scenarios of additively homomorphic encryption are met. By means of using additively homomorphic encryption, the privacy of data can be protected in a calculation process. The present application realizes the training of a factorization machine while protecting data privacy, thus expanding the application scenarios of factorization machine algorithm and the algorithm implementation supported by federated learning, and empowering more industries needing to use federated learning. The present application uses homomorphic encryption technology in the training process of a factorization machine, the data exchanged between each participant of federated learning and a trusted third party is desensitized, and the privacy information of the data cannot be acquired from the data even after decryption, so that data privacy leakage is effectively avoided.

column12: Local model parameter aggregation method for federal learning

According to the method, the privacy protection capability of federated learning is enhanced, and the robustness of a federated learning system is maintained.

column12: Personalized federal learning method based on self-adaptive local model initialization and double knowledge distillation

column12: Federal learning model training method and device, equipment and storage medium

column12: Medical image data set making method based on federated learning and generative adversarial network

column12: Federal learning method based on CKKS homomorphic encryption and Fabric

column12: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR TRAINING MACHINE LEARNING MODELS FOR SIMULATION AND FOR SUPER-RESOLUTION GENERATION
column13: Simulation Tools are used everywhere in the industry today. Machine Learning (ML) offers a unique technology to address the challenge of speed and accuracy in the simulation world. Creating the training data for the ML Model is cumbersome and expensive, if not distributed over many parties. But the problem is: only very few parties, and hardly anyone within industry, is willing to share the data (e. g., a flow field around a car, or the temperature distribution within a gas turbine), as it might reveal intellectual property. This data-challenge limits the applicability of ML-models today.The invention combines local incremental learning approaches for ML-acceleration, and ML-based super-resolution technologies with a federated learning approach.
