column12: Robust watermark forgetting verification method based on adversarial sample in black box scene in federated learning
column13: The invention discloses a robust watermark forgetting verification method based on adversarial samples in a black box scene in federated learning, and the method comprises the steps: randomly screening a part of samples in a local data set of a forgotten user, carrying out the data augmentation, and carrying out the fine adjustment of the augmented data through employing an adversarial sample generation method, and generating an adversarial sample. And the forgotten user accesses the global model of a plurality of next periods through the black box, watermarks are extracted according to the output of the global model on the confrontation samples, and the forgotten condition is verified. The method has the advantages that the robustness is high, the verification effect is good, dependence on data distribution is small, the problem of fairness is avoided through black box access to the global model, theoretical guarantee is provided for forgetting verification results, forgetting can be effectively identified, and the method can be widely applied and deployed in various scenes needing forgetting verification.

According to the method, the client controlled by the Sybil attack in the dynamic federated learning can be effectively detected; and the action of a malicious client is effectively limited, so that the influence of the Sybil attack on model training under dynamic federal learning is reduced.

column12: BAYESIAN NONPARAMETRIC LEARNING OF NEURAL NETWORKS
column13: In federated learning problems, data is scattered across different servers and exchanging or pooling it is often impractical or prohibited. A Bayesian nonparametric framework is presented for federated learning with neural networks. Each data server is assumed to provide local neural network weights, which are modeled through our framework. An inference approach is presented that allows us to synthesize a more expressive global network without additional supervision, data pooling and with as few as a single communication round. The efficacy of the present invention on federated learning problems simulated from two popular image classification datasets is shown.

column12: Centralized client selection method for federal learning based on fuzzy logic
column13: The invention discloses a centralized client selection method based on fuzzy logic in the field of federated learning. The method aims to solve the problem that influence factors cannot be quantitatively analyzed when multiple factors (such as the number of local samples, available network throughput, client selection times, local computing power and the like) are considered in centralized client selection in federated learning. In an actual federated learning system, factors such as transmission signal quality and local computing power of a client (such as a mobile phone mobile terminal and the like) change continuously, and a method capable of quickly evaluating the advantages and disadvantages of the client is needed. For this purpose, a centralized client selection method based on fuzzy logic is provided. The fuzzy logic part runs on a client, collects influence factor values in real time, and then calculates an evaluation value of the client. Then the evaluation values are sent to a server and sorted, and the first n clients are selected as training nodes; according to the method, the model convergence speed in federal learning can be effectively accelerated.

column12: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR BALANCED CLIENT SELECTION FOR DECENTRALIZED MACHINE LEARNING WITH NON-IID DATA
column13: Systems and methods for implementing a balanced client selection for decentralized machine learning (BCS-DL) that can be utilized in both decentralized machine learning and hybrid machine learning for vehicle environments are described. For example, a vehicle can include a processor device training a machine learning model using local data, and a controller device performing balanced client selection in real-time to communicate the local machine learning model with a connected vehicle for decentralized machine learning. Hybrid machine learning combines aspects from federated learning and decentralized machine learning approaches. The disclosed BCS-DL system is designed to execute balanced client selection in real-time for vehicles that are acting as clients in a hybrid machine learning infrastructure. The balanced client selection also calculates a training contribution estimation (TCE) and a model weight computation (MWC) to mitigate imbalance in the data distribution incurred by non-Independent, Identically Distributed (non-IID data) related to decentralized and hybrid machine learning.

column12: Federal learning method, device and system considering Byzantine fault tolerance
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning method, device and system considering Byzantine fault tolerance. According to the method, a credible data set is maintained on an aggregation end, a reputation value is maintained for each node, and the credible data set is synchronously utilized for training in the training process of each participating training node to obtain a reference gradient; after gradients returned by all the training nodes are received, a reference gradient is utilized to exclude gradients with overlarge distances from the reference gradient, and inverse distance weighted calculation and the like are carried out on the gradient of each remaining training node to obtain a preliminary reference reputation value; and then updating the reputation value maintained by each node by using the momentum and the reference reputation value, and finally updating a round of training result by using a weighted average algorithm to realize fault tolerance. According to the fault-tolerant method, the requirements of federal learning on algorithm efficiency and fault-tolerant capability can be met on the premise of maintaining the trusted data set.

column12: GraphSMOTE-based federal learning method for synthesizing minority node oversampling graph

column12: Defense method for federal learning poisoning attack based on isolated forest
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning poisoning attack defense method based on an isolated forest. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a verification model by using a clean public data set, and injecting disturbance to verification model parameters; sampling and uploading the updated model parameters of each node in each iteration of federated learning, and forming a feature matrix by the former and the verification model parameters subjected to disturbance processing; dividing a data space of the feature matrix by using an isolated forest, and calculating an abnormal probability score of each participant; according to the distribution of the scores of the verification model in the scores of all the uploading models, the threshold value is continuously adjusted to eliminate attackers, and the influence of the defense model on benign users is reduced as much as possible. column12: Federal learning user identity continuous authentication method based on model matching
column13: The invention relates to the field of identity authentication of federated learning, and provides a user identity continuous authentication scheme based on model matching. In the traditional federated learning architecture, the identity verification of a central server on each edge user depends on a network security transmission protocol and system access identity authentication, and the traditional federated learning architecture lacks an effective defense means when facing attacks to a client and a transmission process. According to the scheme, continuous user identity authentication is carried out by measuring the matching degree between the edge models uploaded by the edge user in two continuous training of federated learning, and the method comprises three parts of edge user-central server model parameter interaction, edge model feature extraction and user identity authentication. The central server collects edge model decision boundary gradients by utilizing the characteristic that decision boundaries of the models trained by the same data set have high dependency to obtain model features reflecting a private data set, then inputs the matching degree between encoder calculation models based on comparative learning and eliminates users with abnormal identities. The scheme is widely applicable to various federal learning systems based on the neural network, and has high accuracy, practicability and compatibility.

column12: Federal learning method based on Shapril value aggregation
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning method based on Shapril value aggregation, and relates to the technical field of distributed computing. Comprising the following steps: in a federated learning framework, each client performs model training by using local data, and uploads a training result to a server; the server side is provided with a public test set, a virtual participant is configured for each client side, and the combination of all the client sides and the virtual participants is regarded as a new participant; calculating the Shapril value of each client by using the accuracy rate of the model on the common test set; based on the Shapley value, the server performs weighted aggregation on the model to obtain a new global model of the next round; and the server distributes the new global model of the next round to each client, and the steps S1-S4 are repeated until the convergence condition is met. column12: Federal learning method for Byzantine robustness under data non-independent identical distribution
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning method for Byzantine robustness under data non-independent identical distribution. The federated learning method comprises the following steps that 1, a server side reserves historical updating of a user; 2, calculating the similarity between the current update and the historical update; 3, comparing the similarity difference between the current update and the historical update between the users, and distinguishing the update behavior difference between malicious users and benign users; 4, reducing the aggregation learning rate of malicious users; and 5, aggregating user updating to obtain a new global model. According to the method, the difference between the current update and the historical learning update of the user can be effectively identified, suspicious abnormal updates can be captured, the influence of hostile attacks on the model can be reduced, more importantly, the tolerance to the update difference of the benign user can be improved, and the model precision in a data non-independent identically distributed scene can be ensured.

column12: Federal learning method for resisting lagging behind based on summer secret sharing
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of privacy protection technologies, in particular to a federated learning method for resisting a lagging-behind person based on summer secret sharing, and aims to solve the problem of federated learning of the lagging-behind person caused by different client resources and different computing performances by adopting an improved summer secret sharing scheme. In the initialization stage of training, user data and user model parameters are distributed to different users by using summer secret sharing, so that the training stage is a data training stage of all the users, and embedded aggregation of all the clients is rebuilt losslessly by decrypting calculation sharing of non-serial clients; and moreover, a summer secret sharing scheme is used for data distribution and encryption, so that the security of the data in the transmission process is also ensured. column12: Fair federal learning method for non-independent identically distributed data
column13: The invention discloses a fair federated learning method for non-independent identically distributed data, and belongs to the technical field of federated learning. Although many fairness schemes for federated learning exist at present, most of the schemes need to increase client resource overhead. In the implementation process, an auxiliary data set is introduced, cross entropy and marginal loss are combined, and the performance of a global model when a client does not participate in aggregation is compared with the performance of the global model when the client participates in aggregation, so that the influence of the client is measured; establishing an aggregation weight adjustment mechanism by utilizing the solved influence, and ensuring that a client with relatively large influence on the global model obtains a higher aggregation weight; and according to the influence of the participating clients in each round, the number of times that the clients with relatively high influence participate in federal training is increased. The federated learning modeling optimization method comprises the following steps: generating a first sample feature corresponding to a first training sample according to a feature extraction model, and generating a second sample feature corresponding to the first noise data and the first real classification label according to a feature generation model; iteratively training to obtain a feature generation model according to the first real classification label, the first sample feature and the second sample feature; sending the feature generation model and the classification model to a second device, so that the second device constructs a target global feature generation model and a target global classification model; and performing iterative optimization on the feature extraction model and the target global classification model according to a target global feature generation model to obtain a target feature extraction model and a target classification model. The technical problem that a federal learning method has the risk of leaking data privacy of participants is solved.

column12: Federal learning training method and system based on edge device incremental mode

column12: FEDERATED LEARNING METHODS APPLICABLE FOR RADIO ACCESS NETWORK PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION
column13: Techniques of updating machine learning models in a network include combining global and local models at each electronic entity of a network. For example, a first electronic entity (e.g., a user device) may train a local machine learning (ML) model based on data collected by the first electronic entity or other entities (e.g., other user devices, servers) and make predictions based on that model. Nevertheless, other electronic entities may also train or store their own local ML models. Accordingly, for more insight about the network and better predictability of the ML models, the first electronic entity may obtain a ML model from a second electronic entity, i.e., a global ML model. Upon receipt of the global ML model, the first electronic entity may aggregate the local ML model and the global ML model to produce an updated global ML model.

column13: The invention provides a federated learning method, device and equipment and a storage medium. column12: Federal learning data privacy protection method and system based on gradient disturbance

column12: Industrial Internet of Things distributed federal learning method based on Markov chain consensus

column12: High-timeliness federal edge learning scheduling strategy design method

And finally, through experimental observation, the influence of different isomerism of the equipment on the training efficiency is researched. column12: Federal machine learning aggregation method for relieving data heterogeneity
column13: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence federated learning, and particularly relates to a data heterogeneity problem in federated learning. The invention provides a federated machine learning aggregation method for relieving data heterogeneity, and the method integrates current and historical parameter conditions to calculate a global parameter value for reducing heterogeneity data interference. And after each round of iterative training of federal learning, the central server integrates a current gradient node aggregation strategy and a historical gradient aggregation strategy by using an influence coefficient according to received user local model parameters, and performs aggregation, so that new global parameters are obtained. And the server issues the new global parameters to all users, and each user carries out the next round of model parameter training according to the received central model parameters. Compared with a traditional aggregation method, the method can significantly reduce model parameter errors caused by data heterogeneity.

column12: Personalized federal learning method based on client target enhancement
column13: The invention discloses a personalized federated learning method based on client target enhancement, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication networks. In the aspects of communication efficiency and convergence speed, only updated global model parameters need to be uploaded, communication overhead and local calculation burden are reduced, contribution of a client can be more effectively utilized by using personalized aggregation weight, and convergence speed of federal learning is accelerated.

column12: Federal learning-based client selection method and system
column13: The invention provides a federated learning-based client selection method and system. The method comprises the following steps of: logically grouping clients participating in federated learning; based on the received locally optimized model parameters of the clients, calculating angular distance mixing similarities between the locally optimized model parameters and the clients in the group; wherein the calculation of the angular distance mixing similarity specifically comprises the following steps: carrying out principal component analysis on the locally optimized model parameters of the clients, and calculating the similarity of the two clients by adopting an angle and distance combined mode based on the component scores corresponding to the obtained principal components; determining a selected weight of the current client based on the obtained angular distance mixing similarity between the client and other clients in the group; and based on the weight of each client in the group, determining the clients participating in global model aggregation in the current iteration round.

column12: Defense method for data poisoning in federal learning environment

The method comprises the following steps: 1) an aggregation server receives local model parameters uploaded by users, calculates the Euclidean distance of the local model parameters uploaded by each user and records loyalty of the users; the local model parameters are local model parameters of a user training a single round by using private training data; (2) after one training period is finished and the aggregation server receives the local model parameters of the local users, the weight corresponding to each user is calculated according to the loyalty; the training period is a set local model parameter updating round; and 3) issuing the global model parameter to the selected user, and updating the local model parameter after the user receives the global model parameter.

column12: Method for resisting federal learning label flipping attack
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of federated learning, and provides a method for resisting federated learning label flipping attacks, which comprises the following steps that: a server trains and generates a network, and the network learns a mapping relationship from a label to a potential feature space based on a local global model of the server; the client detects the data quality based on the global model and the generative network; the server divides the clients into a benign client set and a malicious client set according to the data quality of the clients, and cancels the qualification of each malicious client to participate in the training; the benign client constructs a personalized model and adjusts local training by taking potential features generated by the generative network as inductive bias; after each benign client completes local training, model parameters are sent to the server for aggregation, and the model parameters are used for updating a local global model of the server; and obtaining a final global model, and defending a label flipping attack based on the final global model.

column12: Federal learning backdoor attack defense method based on model fingerprints

column12: Block chain and fully homomorphic encryption-based edge federated learning privacy protection method
column13: Aiming at the problems of high single-point fault risk, weak privacy protection, poor poisoning attack resistance and the like existing in edge joint learning, the invention provides an edge joint learning privacy protection scheme based on a block chain and fully homomorphic encryption. The block chain technology is combined with the CKKS to encrypt calculation parameters, the privacy leakage risk is reduced, and the functions of tampering prevention, single-point fault resistance, data traceability and the like are endowed to edge joint learning. Meanwhile, an unsupervised mechanism for identifying model gradient parameter updating is designed, and the updating consistency of historical model gradient parameters is taken as a basis. The mechanism can effectively detect malicious update and improve the accuracy of the aggregation model. Experiments show that the method can resist poisoning attacks of 70% of malicious edge servers, provide privacy protection, transparent model aggregation and single-point failure resistance, realize high model accuracy, meet strict requirements of edge joint learning scenes on safety, accuracy and traceability, and provide powerful guarantee for safe and efficient development of edge joint learning.

column12: Federal learning security aggregation method based on QoS gain, medium and device
column13: The invention relates to a federated learning security aggregation method based on QoS gain, a medium and equipment. The invention relates to the technical field of data protection, and the method comprises the steps: screening out a high-quality third-party auxiliary client according with a preset precision gain verification condition based on a precision gain, and introducing a client alliance mechanism based on a cooperative game, the opportunity that a third-party auxiliary client which does not pass a preset precision gain verification condition and is relatively weak in capability is added into federated learning is provided, the speed increment of the client for pushing global model aggregation is mined to the maximum extent, and meanwhile, the intention that illegal clients carry out attack behaviors such as data poisoning through an alliance is restrained; training a reinforcement learning network D3QN model used for screening model parameters; according to the method, global model convergence can be accelerated under the condition that illegal clients exist, and good robustness is shown for poisoning attacks.

column12: Federal learning-oriented data forgetting verification method and system
column13: The federated learning-oriented data forgetting verification method and system provided by the invention are applied to a target client, and a data forgetting request is sent to a server for target data, so that the server notifies other clients to perform federated learning again; after deleting the target data locally, carrying out retraining and generating a first proof according to a retraining process; determining a gradient vector corresponding to the parameter of the new model obtained by retraining, and sending the gradient vector to a server; receiving a second proof and a signature sent by other clients; verifying the retraining process according to the first proof, the second proof and the first preset rule, verifying the signature based on the second preset rule after the verification is passed, receiving the parameter aggregation result after the verification is passed, and verifying the parameter aggregation result based on the third preset rule to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of the information. And the target client does not need to verify each proof through parameter aggregation, so that the verification efficiency is improved.

column12: Data processing method and device, equipment and storage medium
column13: The invention relates to the field of data security, and provides a data processing method, device and equipment and a storage medium, the method is applied to a plurality of participants, a first participant is used for encoding original gradient data of a floating point type of current iteration training into encoding gradient data of an integer type, and performing multi-level encryption on the encoding gradient data, the encryption efficiency is improved, the bandwidth consumption is reduced, the generated second encryption gradient is sent to the adjacent second participant for gradient aggregation, and the model parameters are updated according to the target aggregation gradient obtained by aggregation of the last second participant; each second participant except the first participant in the federated learning task performs gradient aggregation and encryption based on the dense state gradient data of the previous participant and the first encryption gradient of the second participant to obtain a target aggregation gradient, so that the privacy of the gradient data is protected, the communication overhead is reduced, and the communication efficiency is improved. column12: Personalized federal learning method and device based on block chain
column13: The invention discloses a personalized federated learning method and device based on a block chain, and the method comprises the steps: enabling clients participating in federated learning to download a global model of the current round from a consensus node of the block chain, enabling the global model to serve as a first local model, training the local model through a local training set, the local model comprises a first local model used for extracting common features irrelevant to client distribution, a second local model used for extracting personalized features relevant to client distribution and a local classification model used for classifying clients; each client uploads the trained first local model to a consensus node; after each client uploads the trained first local models, the consensus node aggregates the first local models to obtain a new round of global model; and repeatedly executing the process until each client reaches a convergence state. According to the method, the model effect in a serious heterogeneous scene can be improved, the communication cost is reduced, and the reliability and expandability of federal learning are improved.

column12: Federal learning framework construction method based on reverse auction and grouping aggregation optimization
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning framework construction method based on reverse auction and grouping aggregation optimization, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning. According to the method, a three-layer federated learning framework of a central server, a middle layer server and clients is established, in the framework, the central server screens out high-quality clients through a client selection and grouping algorithm, groups the high-quality clients to participate in a federated learning task, and is responsible for global asynchronous aggregation in a subsequent training process; performing global model performance auditing and contribution value calculation; the selected client serves as a participant to use a local data set training model of the selected client, and the middle layer server is responsible for local synchronous aggregation, local model performance auditing and model transmission functions. According to the technical scheme, scenes of Non-IID data distribution difference and equipment heterogeneity can be better dealt with, the convergence speed of a network model is effectively increased, and hostile attacks carried out by malicious nodes are resisted.

column12: Federal learning member reasoning attack defense method and device based on block chain decentration
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning member reasoning attack defense method and device based on block chain decentration. The method comprises the following steps: an edge end participating in federated learning performs model training by using local data to obtain a gradient of a local model; the edge end carries out workload proving through computing power, obtains the accounting right of the account book block according to the workload proving, compresses the gradient of the local model, uploads the compressed model gradient to the account book block, and uplinks the account book block containing the compressed gradient as a block chain node; edge ends corresponding to other account book blocks are broadcast on the block chain by the account book block; and one edge end on the block chain is randomly selected as a temporary central server end in each round, the compressed model gradient of each edge end on the block chain is aggregated to obtain an aggregation model of each round, and the aggregation model is issued to the edge end for next training. The aim of defending the data member reasoning attack can be fulfilled.

column12: Distributed consensus method and system based on federal learning and right election
column13: The invention relates to a distributed consensus method and system based on federated learning and right election, and belongs to the technical field of distributed systems. Comprising the steps that a distributed consensus cluster is provided, in an initial state, the distributed consensus cluster comprises a leader node and a plurality of follower nodes, and a federated learning mechanism is applied to configure an election model for each follower node. When it is judged that no quasi leader node exists in the distributed consensus cluster, the follower node actively runs an election model, a right election waiting queue is obtained within preset election time, and the right election waiting queue comprises a plurality of right nodes. A right election model is configured, the right election model is used for determining the right value of each right node, the multiple right values are sorted, and the right node corresponding to the first right value is elected as a quasi leader node. According to the method, the problems of voting splitting phenomenon, low leader node reliability, data privacy and the like existing in an existing Raft consensus algorithm can be solved.

column12: Federal learning credible training method and device based on block chain
column13: The invention relates to a federal learning credible training method based on a block chain. The method comprises the following steps: a coordinator initiates a federal learning training task request; the participant encrypts and links the statistical information of the own data set; the supervisor obtains the statistical information of each feature of the data set of each participant and verifies the total distribution deviation degree of the statistical information of the data set of each participant; the participant performs local training, and gradient information obtained by training is encrypted and linked; the supervisor verifies the gradient information of the participant; the coordinator securely aggregates the gradient information of the participants; the coordinator sends the aggregated gradient information to each participant to update a local model; and the participant judges whether the model converges or whether the number of iterations reaches the upper limit. According to the method, the situation of training failure caused by inconsistent distribution is avoided, malicious participants can be identified through gradient information abnormity, normal operation of federated learning tasks is guaranteed, and the participation degree and the understanding degree of a supervisor in federated learning are also improved.

column12: Federal learning value evaluation-based chronic disease medical care method and system
column13: The invention discloses a chronic disease medical care method and method based on federal learning value evaluation, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment. column13: The invention discloses a communication-efficient federated learning multi-granularity grouping fine tuning method, relates to the technical field of information security, and solves the technical problems that the communication overhead of the current federated learning is large and the model performance is weak in a non-independent identically distributed data (Non-IID) scene. column12: Federal learning algorithm for non-independent identically distributed data
column13: A federated learning algorithm oriented to non-independent identically distributed data relates to the field of federated learning, and comprises the following steps: initializing global model and local model parameters by a central server and participants, calculating the distance between the local model and the global model of the participants, dividing a participant set into a plurality of subsets according to the distance, participants are randomly selected to participate in training, the training round is limited by the distance, and finally updated local models of all the participants are obtained; the participants directly send the calculation result to the central server or send an intermediate result obtained after the calculation result is encrypted to the central server; the central server calculates and distributes the weight of each participant according to the distance, aggregates each updated local model by using the weight, and updates a global model by using a model aggregation result; and repeating the steps until the global model converges or reaches the maximum communication round limit. column12: No-forgetting and no-data distillation method for heterogeneous federal learning
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to a forgetting-free and data-free distillation method for heterogeneous federal learning. The method comprises the following steps: 1) initializing a generator at a server side, training the generator by jointly optimizing fidelity loss, diversity loss and transferability loss, ensuring that generated samples are aligned with client data distribution and are diversified, and introducing an elastic weight consolidation (EWC) penalty term at the same time; 2) in each round of communication, parameters of a historical difference generator are updated by accumulating differences of the historical generators, so that samples containing historical round knowledge can be synthesized; 3) performing knowledge distillation by using the samples synthesized by the current round generator and the historical difference generator, and minimizing the output difference of the global model and the local model in the aspect of sample generation; and 4) after knowledge distillation is completed, performing heterogeneous fine adjustment on the global model by introducing the difference between the historical global model and the local model.

column12: AI model training method based on block chain
column13: The invention discloses an AI model training method based on a block chain. The method comprises the steps that an original AI model is built according to data set features; before each round of training of the original AI model is started, participants in the training process are randomly allocated into three classes according to a proportion: model trainers, model verifiers and model cochain persons; in each round of training process, the model trainer and the model verifier respectively generate respective local models of the round; the model verifier verifies the local model generated by the model trainer by using the locally generated local model; and the model chaining person aggregates all the local models verified by the model verifier to obtain a global model of the round, and packages the global model of the round, a verification result and all the local models to a block chain. According to the method, the block chain is used for replacing a federated learning centralized server, the single-point fault problem of the federated learning centralized server is solved, later responsibility tracing is facilitated, and the model accuracy and robustness are improved.

column12: Federal learning method and system supporting rapid data revocation

column12: Multi-working-condition online fault diagnosis method based on modular federal deep learning
column13: The invention discloses a multi-working-condition online fault diagnosis method based on modular federal deep learning. When large-scale mechanical equipment works in a multi-working-condition environment, the independent and identically distributed characteristics of data can be damaged, so that the quality of acquired data is low, and a single neural network has the problems of insufficient data utilization, incomplete feature extraction and the like during fault diagnosis, so that the fault diagnosis precision is influenced. Aiming at the problem, the invention provides a modular federated learning method, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, establishing a deep neural network module according to single-working-condition sequence data to carry out feature extraction, meanwhile, carrying out feature extraction on multi-working-condition sequence data by utilizing a new network, and then carrying out feature federated learning of a decision-making layer by multi-module federation; and further performing module division by using a capsule module network, and adaptively allocating weights among the modules to a top fault diagnosis module through adaptive federation, so that multi-working-condition fault diagnosis is performed more accurately. According to the method, fault diagnosis is more accurate through modular federation.

column12: Group verifiable chain type privacy protection federal learning method and device
column13: The invention discloses a grouped verifiable chained privacy protection federated learning method and device, firstly provides a grouped chained learning mechanism to ensure the privacy of a user in a training stage, and then provides a verifiable security aggregation protocol to ensure the verifiability of a global model. Specifically, the method comprises the following steps: firstly, dividing users into different groups for model training, and uploading a training result and a verification label to an aggregation server by each group; then the aggregation server aggregates the training result and the verification label, and returns an aggregation result, namely a global model; and finally, the user verifies the aggregated label, and accepts the aggregation result after the verification is passed. According to the method, the privacy of the client is ensured through a grouped chain learning mechanism on the basis of not introducing complex cryptographic primitives, the verifiability of an aggregation result is realized through a verifiable aggregation protocol, the calculation overhead is relatively low, and the federal learning requirement in a resource limited scene can be met.

column12: FEDERATED LEARNING PLATFORM AND METHODS FOR USING SAME
column13: Provided herein are systems and methods for federated machine learning performed by a central system communicatively coupled to plurality of satellite systems that implement privacy-preserving techniques. Synthetic data generated at respective satellite systems based on the actual data of the satellite systems can be utilized to generate data processing rules that can be applied to the actual data and used to develop a central machine learning model. The systems and methods disclosed herein can be used for both horizontal or vertical federated machine learning by implementing an alignment algorithm as necessary. Insights based on synthetic data and/or the alignment algorithm can be used to develop a central machine learning model without accessing any actual data values directly. Local models can be generated by training the central machine learning model at respective satellite sites and then aggregated at the central system, without transmitting the actual data from the respective satellite systems.

column12: Federal learning method, system and device and storage medium
column13: The invention provides a federal learning method, system and device and a storage medium. According to the method provided by the invention, when the models obtained by training each participant device by using local data are aggregated in federated learning, the model parameters of the plurality of trained models are input into the aggregator for model parameter aggregation, and the parameters of the to-be-trained model are updated according to the aggregated model parameters. The updated to-be-trained model is evaluated by using the public data set, the parameters of the aggregator are updated according to the model evaluation result, the aggregator with the training parameters is used, debiased aggregation of the model parameters can be implicitly realized according to different model parameters, and the model parameters can be quickly and accurately evaluated. And the parameterized aggregator can update the parameters of the aggregator by using the expression of the aggregated model on the public data set and back propagation, so that the aggregator can directly learn aggregation deviation, the problem of data heterogeneity is relieved, the convergence of federal learning training is improved, and the trained model has stronger generalization ability.

column12: Client selection method, system and device in federated learning and storage medium

column12: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR SHARING MEDICAL DATA
column13: The present invention relates to the technical field of data processing. Disclosed are a method and apparatus for sharing medical data. The method comprises: using a consortium chain to connect a plurality of data islands; publishing a federated machine learning task in the form of a smart contract on the consortium chain; adding an image-finding assistant to federated machine learning by means of a smart contract API interface; and summarizing and updating medical data of each node in the image-finding assistant. column12: METHODS FOR RELIABLE OVER-THE-AIR COMPUTATION AND FEDERATED EDGE LEARNING
column13: The disclosure deals with system and method for an over-the-air computation (AirComp) scheme for federated edge learning (FEEL) without channel state information (CSI) at the edge devices (EDs) or edge server (ES). The disclosure adopts the majority vote (MV) principle and defines multiple subcarriers and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) symbols for voting options, which reduces to frequency-shift keying (FSK) over OFDM subcarriers as a special case. Thus, FSK-based over-the-air computation is provided for federated edge learning without channel state information. Since the votes from EDs are separated on orthogonal resources, the proposed scheme eliminates the need for truncated-channel inversion (TCI) at the EDs and allows the ES to detect MV with a non-coherent detector. We also mitigate the peak-to-mean envelope power ratio (PMEPR) of the synthesized signals by using randomization symbols. Simulations show the proposed scheme provides high test accuracy in fading channels for both independent and identically distributed (IID) and non-IID data while resulting in OFDM symbols with lower PMEPRs as compared to one-bit broadband digital aggregation (OBDA) with quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM).

column12: Federal learning method, system and device based on forward gradient
column13: The embodiment of the invention provides a federated learning method, system and device based on a forward gradient. Therefore, on the premise of ensuring the training precision of the neural network model, the expandability of federal learning is greatly improved.

column13: The invention relates to a distributed cooperation method for communication optimization, and belongs to the field of machine learning. column12: METHODS FOR RELIABLE OVER-THE-AIR COMPUTATION WITH PULSES FOR DISTRIBUTED LEARNING AND WITH FEDERATED EDGE LEARNING WITHOUT CHANNEL STATE INFORMATION
column13: An over-the-air computation (AirComp) scheme is proposed for federated edge learning (FEEL) without channel state information (CSI) at the edge devices (EDs) or edge server (ES). The proposed scheme adopts the majority vote (MV) principle and uses pulse-position modulation (PPM) symbols constructed with discrete Fourier transform (DFT)-spread orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) (DFT-s-OFDM) as votes from EDs. By taking the delay spread and synchronization errors into account, we show how to eliminate the need for truncated-channel inversion (TCI) at the EDs and detect MV at the ED with a non-coherent detector. The proposed method naturally reduces the peak-to-mean envelope power ratio (PMEPR) of the signal as it inherits the properties of the single-carrier (SC) waveform. An alternative proposed scheme also adopts the majority vote (MV) principle but further defines multiple subcarriers and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) symbols for voting options, which reduces to frequency-shift keying (FSK) over OFDM subcarriers as a special case. Since the votes from EDs are separated on orthogonal resources, the proposed scheme eliminates the need for truncated-channel inversion (TCI) at the EDs and allows the ES to detect MV with a non-coherent detector. We also mitigate the peak-to-mean envelope power ratio (PMEPR) of the synthesized signals by using randomization symbols. Through simulations, we show that the proposed schemes provide high test accuracy in fading channels for both independent and identically distributed (IID) and non-IID data while resulting in lower PMEPR symbols as compared to one-bit broadband digital aggregation (OBDA) with quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM).

column12: Federal learning working node updating method and system and storage medium
column13: The invention provides a federal learning work node updating method and system and a storage medium, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, generating a loss value loss after each work node is trained for one round, and recording the loss value loss1 of the current round; 2, after the loss value of the next round is generated, the loss value loss2 of the next round is recorded, and the difference value delta 1 between the loss1 and the loss2 is calculated; 3, updating the learning rate lr according to the delta l, and further updating three parameters Kp, Ki and Kd of the AdaPID algorithm; and 4, judging whether the model converges or not, if so, ending iteration, and otherwise, returning to execute the step 1. column12: Method for defending backdoor attack in federal learning
column13: The invention provides a defense method for backdoor attacks in federal learning, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, calculating Euclidean distances between every two clients, adding the Euclidean distances to obtain a final average value of each client, then obtaining the proportion of the final average value of each client in the current round, and recording the proportion as a reputation value of the current round. According to the invention, during each round of client screening, the previous reputation value is used as a reference basis, so that the effect of filtering abnormal clients is achieved. According to the method, the abnormal clients can be effectively filtered in response to the backdoor attack in the federated learning environment, the effect of successful defense is achieved, and meanwhile normal cooperative training of all honest clients is effectively protected.

column12: Federal positioning method based on adaptive aggregation and feature alignment
column13: The invention discloses a federal positioning method based on adaptive aggregation and feature alignment, and belongs to the field of indoor positioning. When federated learning is applied to indoor positioning of the Internet of Things, the problem that data of all terminal devices are not independently distributed is solved, and the influence of the non-independent distributed data on the performance of a global model is reduced by utilizing a self-adaptive federated aggregation coefficient and a feature alignment constraint; according to the algorithm, the aggregation weight of each local model is quantified by comparing the performance difference of a global model before and after local training, and particularly, a more accurate aggregation coefficient is provided for federal aggregation through a variable coefficient of a loss value; considering that differences in client data distribution may cause local model representations to have respective preferences, feature alignment constraints are used to avoid overfitting of local models to improve performance of a global model.

column12: Federal learning-based numerical control tool health state evaluation system and method under side cloud collaborative architecture

Compared with the prior art, data privacy can be protected, the problem of data islands can be solved, consumption of transmission resources can be reduced, global accuracy can be improved, and user fairness can be guaranteed.

column12: Multi model functionality FL training of an AI/ML learning model for multiple model functionalities
column13: A multi model functionality federated learning method is used by a first entity of a communications network to train an artificial intelligence.machine learning (AI / ML) model for multiple related functionalities of the model using a group of second network entities of the network. In some embodiments, the first network entity selects the group of second network entities which have each requested multiple related model functionalities that comprise at least one functionality-specific model layer and at least one common model layer. The first entity may then provide the model layers for at least some of the requested model functionalities to each of the group of second entities, which may then train the layers on a local dataset. The second entities may then send the trained layers back to the first entity, which may then perform aggregation over the received trained model layers. The training process may repeat until convergence.

column12: Device scheduling method based on Stackelberg game
column13: The invention discloses an equipment scheduling method based on the Stackelberg game, which comprises the following steps of: 1) feeding back a strategy of a leader by a BS (Base Station) serving as the leader and a mobile device serving as a follower, establishing a benefit function of the BS and the mobile device, and designing a scheduling selection problem between the BS and the mobile device based on the Stackelberg game; and 2) the mobile device set receives the global model from the specific BS, and cooperatively executes a federal learning algorithm through a wireless network. And 4) uploading the local optimal solution of the mobile equipment to the BS for global aggregation, and broadcasting the next round of global model to the mobile equipment set for the next round of federal learning training until the global model reaches preset precision. column12: APPARATUS AND METHODS FOR MULTI-STAGE MACHINE LEARNING WITH CASCADED MODELS

column12: SHARED MODEL TRAINING WITH PRIVACY PROTECTIONS
column13: A model training system protects data leakage of private data in a federated learning environment by training a private model in conjunction with a proxy model. Proxy models from other participants are used to train the private model, enabling the private model to benefit from parameters based on other models’ private data without privacy leakage. The mixing may include updating and applying a bias to account for the weights of other participants in the received proxy models.

column12: Longitudinal federal learning method and system

column12: SHARED MODEL TRAINING WITH PRIVACY PROTECTIONS
column13: A model training system protects data leakage of private data in a federated learning environment by training a private model in conjunction with a proxy model. The proxy model is trained with protections for the private data and may be shared with other participants. Proxy models from other participants are used to train the private model, enabling the private model to benefit from parameters based on other models' private data without privacy leakage. The proxy model may be trained with a differentially private algorithm that quantifies a privacy cost for the proxy model, enabling a participant to measure the potential exposure of private data and drop out. Iterations may include training the proxy and private models and then mixing the proxy models with other participants. The mixing may include updating and applying a bias to account for the weights of other participants in the received proxy models.

column12: Federal learning backdoor defense method based on similarity filtering
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning backdoor defense method based on similarity filtering, which comprises the following steps of: after local updates are uploaded to a server, comparing cosine included angles of the local updates pairwise, and then identifying the updates with higher similarity as malicious updates; calculating a cosine similarity score between the remaining updates, an update degree score of the updates and a cosine similarity score of each model and the global model; through the three scores, predefined weights are used to weight them so as to obtain all updated model scores, updates with higher model scores are identified as benign updates and incorporated into aggregation, and then other malicious models are scaled through a negative forgetting degree parameter to increase the loss of the backdoor. According to the method, good defensive performance can be kept, the backdoor attack only can obtain an extremely low attack success rate, and meanwhile, the influence on the precision of the main task is relatively small.

column12: Method for relieving Non-IID influence based on interpretable federated learning
column13: The invention discloses a method for relieving Non-IID influence based on interpretable federal learning. column12: Asynchronous federated learning method based on information gain and related equipment
column13: The invention provides an asynchronous federal learning method based on information gain and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a model gradient of a client, determining feature similarity between the model gradient and each group center, dividing the model gradient into a group corresponding to the highest feature similarity, re-determining the group center of the group, and adjusting the group; calculating the information total amount, freshness and effectiveness of each model gradient, calculating the information gain of the model gradient, removing the model gradient of which the information gain is smaller than a preset gain threshold, and determining the information gain rate of the group according to the information gain of the model gradient; when the information gain rate of the group is greater than a preset gain rate threshold value, updating the learning rate according to the stale degree mean value of the gradient of the group model, aggregating the gradient of each model to obtain an aggregation gradient, and executing a gradient descent algorithm on the global model by utilizing the aggregation gradient, the learning rate and the group weight to complete the global training of the round so as to obtain the global model; and issuing to the client.

column12: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR UPDATING MACHINE LEARNING MODEL
column13: Embodiments of this application provide a machine learning model update method, applied to the field of artificial intelligence. The method includes: A first apparatus generates a first intermediate result based on a first data subset. The first apparatus receives an encrypted second intermediate result sent by a second apparatus, where the second intermediate result is generated based on a second data subset corresponding to the second apparatus. The first apparatus obtains a first gradient of a first model, where the first gradient of the first model is generated based on the first intermediate result and the encrypted second intermediate result. According to the excitation method and system based on reverse auction, the problem that a curse is won is solved, and compared with similar methods, the method has higher auction efficiency, participant utility, platform utility and social utility, and the satisfaction degree of all subjects in federated learning is improved.

column12: Multi-base-station queuing type lead code distribution method based on multi-agent cooperation
column13: The invention discloses a multi-base-station queuing type lead code distribution method based on multi-agent cooperation, and provides a non-competitive lead code distribution method in a multi-base-station and multi-cell scene aiming at the problem of congestion during random access of massive agents. Based on deep reinforcement learning, equipment selects lead codes in a queuing manner, and a federated learning training method is adopted, so that the problem of congestion during competitive access is effectively solved. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, grouping newly accessed intelligent agents, and setting priorities according to delay tolerance time; secondly, agents are reasonably distributed to idle queues based on a multi-intelligent reinforcement learning algorithm; and finally, synchronously optimizing the neural network of each agent through average optimization of neural network gradients by adopting a federated training method, and completing lead code distribution of each agent.

column12: MULTI-BASE-STATION QUEUING TYPE PREAMBLE ALLOCATION METHOD BASED ON MULTI-AGENT COLLABORATION
column13: Disclosed in the present invention is a multi-base-station queuing type preamble allocation method based on multi-agent collaboration. A device selects a preamble in a queuing manner on the basis of deep reinforcement learning, and a federated learning training method is used, such that the congestion problem during competitive access is effectively solved. The method comprises: firstly, grouping newly accessed agents, and setting priorities according to a delay tolerance time; secondly, rationally allocating the agents to idle queues on the basis of a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm; and finally, synchronously optimizing neural networks of the agents by using a federated training method and by means of the average optimization of a neural network gradient, so as to complete the allocation of preambles to the agents.

column12: Encrypted traffic intrusion detection method and system based on personalized federal learning
column13: The invention provides an encrypted traffic intrusion detection method and system based on personalized federated learning. The method comprises the following steps: adding a dynamic regularization item into a local model for model training to obtain a local model after feature extraction enhancement; the client inherits the local model according to the local data set to obtain an inherited local model; calculating feature vector distribution similarity between the clients, and optimizing a local model corresponding to a target client with non-uniform data distribution to obtain an optimized local model; and each client encrypts the final local model and uploads the encrypted local model to the server. The dynamic regularization item is added in the local training stage of the client, and the uniqueness of the client data is considered, so that the model can better adapt to the difference of data distribution of different clients, the detection precision in an encrypted traffic scene with high data heterogeneity is improved, and the detection efficiency is improved under the technical clamping of homomorphic encryption transmission. column12: Automobile inflator pump and dynamic voltage monitoring control system thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile inflator pump monitoring, and discloses an automobile inflator pump and a dynamic voltage monitoring control system thereof. The voltage data acquisition module acquires and processes multi-dimensional data, the dynamic noise suppression module removes noise, the voltage fluctuation modeling module extracts voltage and load correlation characteristics, and the adaptive compensation control module optimizes control parameters to stabilize the voltage. In addition, the system is further provided with a digital twinborn simulation module monitoring gas circuit, a distributed updating module optimization model based on federated learning, a redundancy protection circuit guarantee safety, and a fault mode library for providing preventive maintenance suggestions. The system can improve the running stability, safety and efficiency of the automobile inflator pump, and effectively overcomes the defects of a traditional inflator pump in the aspects of voltage monitoring control and the like.

column12: Federal data transaction method based on master-slave game
column13: The invention discloses a federated data transaction method based on a master-slave game, and the method comprises the steps: building a relation between a data resource demander and a data resource supplier, and obtaining the master-slave game balance of the data resource demander and the data resource supplier through a federated learning method; a data resource demander decides a willingness bid tau for purchasing data according to a corresponding first utility Ud function, and a data resource supplier decides a willingness delivery data volume xo corresponding to the willingness bid tau according to a corresponding second utility Us function. column12: Federal learning-based data security sharing processing method

column12: CONTRIBUTION DEGREE EVALUATION METHOD, DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM
column13: To provide a contribution degree evaluation method, device and storage medium.SOLUTION: A contribution degree evaluation method is so configured that: when a participant of a plurality of participants participating in federated learning completes local training of a model, the participant transmits the trained model to a node device of a blockchain network connected thereto; the node device aggregates currently existing models in the blockchain network to generate an aggregated model, and adds the received trained model and the aggregated model to a tree structure; when all the participants transmit models to the block chain network, each node device calculates degrees of accuracy of each trained model and each aggregated model in the tree structure and updates the tree structure using the degrees of accuracy; each node device adds the degree of accuracy of an equivalent model corresponding to each aggregated model to the updated tree structure; and each node device calculates a Shapley value for each of the plurality of participants based on the tree structure to which the degree of accuracy is added, and defines it as the contribution degree of each of the plurality of participants in the federated learning.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

column12: Personalized federal learning method and device based on privacy protection
column13: The invention discloses a personalized federal learning method and device based on privacy protection, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the training of each round through a client, obtaining a trained local model matrix parameter, and uploading the trained local model matrix parameter to a corresponding personalized model; calculating the threshold value of each client according to the variable quantity of the parameters of the local model matrix trained in this round, and then calculating the frequency sparseness of each client; clustering the clients according to the frequency sparseness set; averaging the local model parameters uploaded by the clients of the same cluster, and issuing the average value as a new global model matrix parameter to the clients of the same cluster; and repeating until the global model converges, and completing the training of personalized federal learning. According to the method, the user privacy is always protected in the process of calculating the frequency sparseness, the clients are clustered through the similarity of the sparseness to form K clusters, and the client distribution of the K clusters is aggregated, so that the effects of cooperative training and personalized federated learning are achieved.

column12: Poisoned member inference attack method oriented to black box federal learning
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of machine learning, discloses a black box federated learning-oriented inference attack method for poisoned members, and shows the possibility of successful inference only through a global model black box permission by taking the inference influence as the basis of inference attack. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, poisoning a global model by using a poisoning strategy for a target sample, secondly, measuring prediction results of the target sample in different training rounds, and finally, carrying out dichotomy on a series of measurement values by using an unsupervised algorithm so as to implement member reasoning attack.

column12: Byzantine attack detection method based on iteration invariant index
column13: The invention discloses a Byzantine attack detection method based on an iteration invariant index, and belongs to the field of distributed machine learning. The Byzantine attack is detected by constructing the feature distance and the output layer deviation as iteration invariant indexes. The calculation of the feature distance is based on a pre-training encoder, and the distance between the auxiliary data set features extracted by the pre-training encoder and the auxiliary data set features extracted by a local model is calculated, so that the model poisoning attack is effectively detected; the output layer deviation estimates distribution of user local data based on analysis of local model output layer gradient variance, and then data poisoning attacks are detected; besides, HDBSCAN clustering, namely spatial clustering based on hierarchical density, is adopted, clustering without assuming the number of classes is carried out on iteration invariant indexes of different users, and the problem that the proportion of malicious users is unknown is solved. The method is suitable for the field of distributed machine learning, and the robustness and efficiency of the attack detection method are improved under the instant aggregation strategy of asynchronous federated learning.

column12: Federal learning algorithm for bearing fault diagnosis
column13: The invention relates to a federated learning algorithm for bearing fault diagnosis, which is characterized in that the algorithm runs on a plurality of local nodes and an aggregation node, and comprises the following steps of: 1, converging data of a sensor network by each local node, the data of the sensor are preprocessed in a time-sharing, partitioning, sampling and normalizing manner; 2, training the preprocessed data by adopting a convolutional neural network model; 3, after training is completed, whether the aggregation condition is met or not is judged according to the improved aggregation strategy, and if yes, the round of training is ended; then, calculating an F1 score of the local model; finally, performing homomorphic encryption on the model parameters, the F1 score and the total number of samples, and sending to an aggregation node; and 4, after receiving the information sent by all the local nodes, the aggregation node decrypts the information, then weights and aggregates all the local models according to an F1 score weighting strategy to obtain a new initial model, and sends the new initial model to the local nodes.

column12: Streaming media bit rate adaptive adjustment method based on personalized federal reinforcement learning
column13: The invention discloses a streaming media bit rate adaptive adjustment method based on personalized federated reinforcement learning, and in a dynamic adaptive streaming system based on HTTP, based on personalized federated learning and deep reinforcement learning, a bit rate adaptive process is represented in a formalized manner by establishing a Markov decision process. A user locally learns a bit rate adaptation policy using reinforcement learning. The objective equation aims to maximize the quality of experience of the user. Federal learning is used to coordinate users and a central server to train a global model, and a personalized model is trained for each user on the basis of the global model using local data. Through a large amount of training, a user can select a bit rate by using a personalized model so as to realize the maximum value of a target equation under the current network condition. According to the method, privacy is protected from being leaked, and meanwhile, the heavy tail characteristic of the network environment and the user behavior is solved.

column12: Internet factory operation diagnosis method and system based on federal learning
column13: The invention discloses an internet factory operation diagnosis method and system based on federated learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring video data and sensor data; respectively constructing a first sub-model and a second sub-model based on each data node in the Internet; fusing the first sub-models obtained by training to obtain a first central model and a first diagnosis result; fusing the second sub-models obtained by training to obtain a second central model and a second diagnosis result; training a decision fusion model based on the first diagnosis result and the second diagnosis result; performing analysis and diagnosis on the video data and the sensor data acquired in real time based on the decision fusion model to obtain a final diagnosis result; according to the invention, efficient utilization of video data is realized, data fusion heterogeneous data is broken, and a more accurate diagnosis result is obtained.

column12: Model parameter training method and device based on federated learning, equipment and medium
column13: The invention discloses a model parameter training method and device based on federal learning, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: when a first terminal receives encrypted second data sent by a second terminal, obtaining a corresponding loss encryption value and a first gradient encryption value; randomly generating a random vector with the same dimension as the first gradient encryption value, performing fuzzy on the first gradient encryption value based on the random vector, and sending the fuzzy first gradient encryption value and the loss encryption value toa second terminal; when the decrypted first gradient value and the loss value returned by the second terminal are received, detecting whether the model to be trained is in a convergence state or not according to the decrypted loss value; and if yes, obtaining a second gradient value according to the random vector and the decrypted first gradient value, and determining the sample parameter corresponding to the second gradient value as the model parameter. According to the method, model training can be carried out only by using data of two federated parties without a trusted third party, so thatapplication limitation is avoided.

column12: Security federal learning method based on adaptive Byzantine defense
column13: The invention discloses a security federal learning method based on adaptive Byzantine defense, and relates to the field of federal learning. A current federal learning system has the problems that the Byzantine attack cannot be adaptively resisted, and the model accuracy is low. Therefore, in order to solve the problem, the invention provides a security federal learning method based on adaptive Byzantine defense. According to the method, the global model is disturbed to the minimum extent on the premise that differential privacy disturbance is provided for both the local model and the global model to realize comprehensive privacy protection through self-adaptive preliminary aggregation of excitation association and global aggregation based on exponential weighted average; processing is carried out according to scores of different malicious models so as to adaptively resist Byzantine attacks, the enthusiasm of participants is aroused, and high model accuracy is achieved.

column12: Personalized federated learning model ownership protection method based on robust watermarking
column13: The invention discloses a robust watermark-based personalized federal learning model ownership protection method, which comprises a watermark initialization step: S1, a server sends an initialization model and public watermark information of each client to a corresponding client, and the client generates a private watermark of the client; and a watermark decoupling embedding step S2, the client side embeds the private watermark into the personalized layer through training, and embeds the public watermark information into the corresponding presentation layer position. The presentation layer parameters are uploaded to a server; and a malicious client detection step S3, the server detects the presentation layer parameters uploaded by the client, aggregates the parameters of the honest client as the presentation layer parameters of the next round, and marks the malicious client at the same time. Further, the server circularly extracts the clients for multiple rounds of training until the model meets the standard. The method has the advantages of large client capacity, high watermark robustness and the like.

column12: Dynamic clustering federated learning method based on adaptive distribution similarity calculation
column13: The invention discloses a dynamic clustering federal learning method based on adaptive distribution similarity calculation. The method comprises the steps that a server receives local data feature vectors and parameter updates uploaded by clients; on the basis of the feature vectors and parameter updating, the self-adaptive distribution similarity between the clients is calculated, the self-adaptive distribution similarity comprises static data similarity and dynamic parameter similarity, and the weights of the static data similarity and the dynamic parameter similarity are dynamically balanced through a weight adjustment strategy; according to the self-adaptive distribution similarity, initial clustering division of a cold start stage is carried out on the client; in the iteration updating stage, cluster division is dynamically adjusted based on intra-group similarity updating and inter-group similarity updating until the result of continuous multi-round cluster division is stable; before each round of training, according to the pre-estimated training time and the residual battery capacity of the clients, executing hierarchical client selection to determine the clients participating in the training; and carrying out independent model training on the divided clusters until the model converges. According to the invention, the accuracy of clustering federal learning is improved.

column12: Motor magnetic shoe surface defect detection method and device based on privacy protection and unsupervised motor magnetic shoe surface defect detection method and device
column13: The invention provides an unsupervised motor magnetic shoe surface defect detection method and device based on privacy protection, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a surface image of a target motor magnetic shoe, inputting the surface image into an encoder of a detection model, and obtaining a feature map of the surface image; inputting the feature map into a standardized flow model of a detection model, and determining whether the surface of the target motor magnetic shoe has defects or not; under the condition that the surface of the target motor magnetic shoe has defects, inputting the feature map into a decoder of the detection model to obtain a reconstruction error; obtaining a defect area in the surface image of the target motor magnetic shoe according to the reconstruction error; the detection model is obtained by combining sample data sets in a plurality of clients and carrying out unsupervised learning and federated learning training; the sample image in the sample data set is the surface image of the sample motor magnetic shoe with the normal surface. According to the method, the generalization and robustness of the detection model and the accuracy of defect detection are improved while the data privacy is ensured.

column12: Federal learning model poisoning defense method, terminal and storage medium
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning model poisoning defense method, a terminal and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: selecting a matched cutting threshold according to the norm of each local model increment and a corresponding data set, and carrying out the adaptive cutting of the corresponding local model increment according to the selected cutting threshold; determining a symbol feature of the current global model increment according to the clipped local model increment, and calculating a selection coefficient corresponding to the clipped local model according to the determined symbol feature of the current global model increment; performing selective aggregation on each cut local model according to the calculated selection coefficient to obtain a global model; the method can effectively defend model poisoning attack means such as label flipping and zooming attacks, symbol flipping attacks and minimum maximum distance attacks, and can help a central server to complete aggregation of local models under the conditions of not collecting original data of a client and not intensifying the local calculation amount of the client.
