column12: Robustness clustering federated learning method with trusted anchor client and storage medium
column13: The invention provides a robustness clustering federal learning method with a trusted anchor client, which comprises the following steps that: the trusted client negotiates a key with a server to obtain a shared key; the server removes the masks from the trusted model using the shared key and aggregates them to obtain a trusted aggregation model; taking the credible aggregation model as an anchor model, performing feature extraction on a model with unknown attributes, calculating a plurality of clustering features, and performing clustering by applying HDBSCAN; aggregating the plurality of clustering models, and calculating a credibility factor by considering an average norm of different clustering aggregation models and an update deviation angle between different clusters; in each iteration, the cluster with the highest trust degree is selected, a tolerance threshold value is set, the clusters with trust factors within the threshold value range are added to an aggregation list, and the clusters outside the threshold value range are considered to contain malicious updates. According to the method, an unknown model can be detected by anchor point models provided by different service providers, and a pollution-free global model is ensured to be obtained in multi-service provider joint training.

column12: Federal active emotion calculation method with heterogeneous data
column13: The invention discloses a federal active emotion calculation method with heterogeneous data. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, initializing a global model, sending the global model to a selected client by a server, training a local model by the client, and uploading parameters to the server; step 2, the server performs preference perception grouping aggregation: performing clustering operation according to the class precision of the updated local model on the public data set of the server side, and the client side estimates the clustering ID of the client side according to the prediction performance of the global model on the local marked data set; and step 3, performing debiased federated active sampling: a client firstly uses a pre-clustering method to promote class balance sampling through sub-clustering sampling, and then samples data according to the divergence degree of committee members by using a committee query algorithm in active learning and combining with the improved voting entropy. column12: Client asynchronous federal learning method with adaptive partial training
column13: The invention provides a client asynchronous federated learning method with adaptive partial training, and relates to the technical field of distributed machine learning. The server randomly selects n clients to broadcast a global model, each client executes complete model training of one data batch to estimate time consumption and calculate a loss value, and a result is transmitted to the server; the client time consumption and the loss value are normalized, the comprehensive score of each client is calculated, the maximum time consumption in the clients with the scores ranked at the top k is selected, and the aggregation interval of the maximum time consumption is determined; determining a client part training ratio and a local training period according to the aggregation interval; and the client uploads the model parameters to the server after completing local training, and the server aggregates the model parameters of the client received within the aggregation interval time into a new global model. And repeating the above operations until the global model precision reaches a preset requirement. According to the method, computing resources can be fully utilized, high participation degree of important clients is ensured, and global model aggregation is accelerated.

column12: Method and device for constructing anomaly detection model, electronic equipment and storage medium

The longitudinal federal learning model is trained based on the target feature information set subjected to noise addition processing, the detection model is generated, data privacy is protected, and data utilization is completed. And meanwhile, whether the supply chain transaction data is abnormal or not is detected through the detection model, so that the detection accuracy can be improved.

column12: Defense method and device for convenient vehicle attack in federated learning with privacy protection
column13: The invention discloses a method and a device for defending a convenient vehicle taking attack in federal learning with privacy protection. column12: Automatic auditing method for housing accumulation fund mobile terminal extraction application

column12: Federal learning-based non-alcoholic fatty liver disease data sharing analysis method
column13: The invention discloses a federated learning-based non-alcoholic fatty liver disease data sharing analysis method, which comprises the following steps: firstly, obtaining quality indexes and quantity statistics of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease data of each mechanism, and carrying out cleaning and normalization standardization processing to obtain a data set with a uniform format; thirdly, performing initial training on the local model of each mechanism by adopting a federated average algorithm to obtain a global model initial parameter, and evaluating the initial precision of the global model initial parameter on data of each mechanism; according to the initial precision, gradient contribution of data of each mechanism to the global model is calculated, the contribution rate is determined, and weighting adjustment is carried out in combination with data quality. And further analyzing the lifting weight of the data of each mechanism to the model diversity, comprehensively calculating the contribution score of each mechanism, and allocating the excitation resources according to the contribution score. For a mechanism with low contribution, input is adjusted by increasing the sampling rate or introducing synthetic data, a global model is iteratively updated, model parameters and precision are optimized, and efficient and safe data sharing and analysis are achieved.

column12: Anti-collusion federated learning method and system based on correlation analysis, and storage medium
column13: The invention discloses an anti-collusion federal learning method and system based on correlation analysis and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that each client side calculates an accuracy difference value before and after model updating according to a local privacy data set and calculates an audit score according to the accuracy difference value; the central server calculates correlation scores of the groups according to the audit scores and screens the groups with the correlation scores lower than a preset threshold out of a training system; re-dividing client groups according to the model gradient norm of the groups; calculating a local model gradient average number of each client in the group, and issuing the local model gradient average number to the corresponding group as a new global model gradient of the group; iterations are repeated until a preset number of iterations is completed. According to the invention, the problems that the existing anti-collusion privacy protection technology is only suitable for a scene in which the proportion of an attacker who puts up a car to a total client is relatively low and the performance is poor when the data distribution is Non-IId are solved.

column12: Federal learning method and system based on difference perception collaboration
column13: The invention provides a federated learning method and system based on difference perception cooperation, and the method comprises the steps: S11, calculating local category distribution by all clients before federated training, measuring the difference between the local category distribution and global category distribution through a measurement function, taking the difference as a local difference degree, and uploading the local difference degree to a server; s12, starting federation training, downloading the global model of the previous round from the server by the client selected in the current round, and performing local training; s13, jointly determining the aggregation weight of the clients participating in the training in the round by using the local difference degree and the local data volume; s14, the clients participating in training in the round upload the updated local models to a server, and the server side uses the corrected weights to aggregate the local models to obtain a global model; and S12 to S14, repeatedly iterating for a plurality of rounds until the federal training is finished. The method has the capability of sensing the category distribution difference, breaks through the limitation that the standard aggregation weight only depends on the local data volume, reduces the error boundary of the global optimization target, and improves the performance of the model under the category distribution isomerism.

column12: Multi-center hospital scientific research data modeling method based on federal learning
column13: The invention provides a federated learning-based multi-center hospital scientific research data modeling method, which comprises the following steps of: 1) collecting patient data by a medical institution A, locally forming a sample feature matrix XA in the institution A, and encoding non-numerical patient data; the medical institution B forms a sample feature matrix XB by using the same method; 2) the medical institution A collects diagnosis results of disease species locally, and encodes the diagnosis results of the disease species, or encodes the percentage of the risk probability of the disease; 3) obtaining an intersection of the sample feature matrixes XA and XB to obtain sample data with the same ID; 4) the medical institution A and the medical institution B locally preprocess the sample data with the same ID; (5) carrying out feature binning on the preprocessed data, and (6) carrying out feature selection and joint modeling on the data subjected to feature binning by the medical institution A and the medical institution B, carrying out supervised learning on the model by utilizing the diagnosis result or the disease risk probability of the medical institution A in the step (2) on the disease species, and selecting an optimal model as a champion model based on an evaluation index.

column12: Federal learning-based automatic driving privacy data protection method and device

column12: Model training method and device based on fully-hidden sample data and storage medium
column13: The invention discloses a model training method and device based on fully-anonymous sample data and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the data filtering of local sample data, obtaining candidate local samples, carrying out the random splitting of the candidate local samples, and obtaining local sample data matrix fragments; carrying out interaction on the local sample data matrix fragments and the opposite-side participants to obtain a local fragment splicing matrix, and then carrying out same feature random disorder and identifier encryption processing on the local fragment splicing matrix and the opposite-side participants in sequence to obtain an opposite-side ciphertext matrix; matrix reconstruction based on repeated identification is carried out on the local plaintext matrix after homomorphic decryption to obtain a fully-hidden sample data intersection matrix, and then the fully-hidden sample data intersection matrix is utilized to train a data prediction model. column12: TRAINING METHOD FOR ELECTRICAL LOAD PREDICTION MODEL FOR INDUSTRIAL PARK, AND RELATED DEVICE
column13: Embodiments of the present invention provide a training method for an electrical load prediction model for an industrial park, and a related device. The method comprises: a power supplier device and a power consumer device respectively train initial load prediction models deployed locally, and obtain respective intermediate results; the power supplier device calculates a first gradient on the basis of a first intermediate result of the power supplier device, a second intermediate result provided by the power consumer device and a first sample data set, and sends, to the power consumer device, a residual encrypted by a first public key; on the basis of the residual encrypted by the public key, the power consumer device calculates a second gradient having an encrypted random number; the power supplier device performs a residual removal operation on the second gradient, so that the power consumer device performs random number removal processing on the second gradient having the encrypted random number to obtain a second gradient in a plaintext form; and the power supplier device and the power consumer device control training processes of respective corresponding models on the basis of the gradients. The present invention improves the data security in the vertical federated learning data sharing process.

column12: Malicious software detection method based on block chain
column13: The invention relates to a malicious software detection method based on a block chain, and belongs to the technical field of malicious software detection.The method comprises the steps that firstly, known malicious software is subjected to static analysis, permission characteristics are obtained, and character strings are obtained; calculating a locality sensitive hash value of the character string; building a block chain environment, deploying each malicious software detection node in the block chain environment, and storing the locality sensitive hash value of each malicious software in the block chain environment by using an intelligent contract; by writing the smart contract, each node calculates the TLSH distance between the locality sensitive hash value of the to-be-detected software and the locality sensitive hash value of malicious software stored on the chain to obtain the final distance between the software, the final distance is compared with a set distance threshold, and if the maliciousness of the to-be-detected software is not detected, the software maliciousness of the to-be-detected software is detected. And if yes, performing secondary detection on the to-be-detected software based on a federated learning technology. According to the method, the blockchain and the locality sensitive hashing technology are combined, so that malicious software information sharing is realized while the malicious software detection timeliness is improved.

column12: Federal modeling method, model reasoning method, device, equipment and medium
column13: The invention provides a federated modeling method and device, a model reasoning method and device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of federated learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a feature ciphertext corresponding to each sample in a current tree node, and box division derivative information corresponding to each feature ciphertext; mapping each feature ciphertext to each feature sub-box based on a size comparison result between each feature ciphertext and the sub-box point ciphertext to obtain a mapping result; based on the derivative information of each sub-box and the mapping result, generating cumulative histogram information corresponding to each feature sub-box; and sending the accumulated histogram information to the first participant, and constructing a federal XGBoost model in combination with the first participant. A participant with sample features can complete model training only by transmitting the feature ciphertext and the binning point ciphertext without exposing feature related information including a feature plaintext and a binning point plaintext to other participants, so that the data security of sample feature information of each participant in a federal XGBoost model training process is improved; and the security of federal XGBoost modeling is improved.

column12: Multi-party large model joint training method and device based on federal learning
column13: The invention discloses a multi-party large model joint training method and device based on federated learning, and the method comprises the steps: uniformly dividing a to-be-trained large model to each calculation node according to the size of a parameter, setting s as a random seed for all nodes, and initializing model parameters; each client uses own private domain data to train the large model, and after a round of training is completed, gradient parameters of each computing node are synthesized into a complete gradient Gi; generating a random number matrix Ri with the same shape as the Gi as one of the sub-secrets; ti = Gi-Ri is calculated as another sub-secret; the two sub-secrets are respectively sent to two central servers for summation, and a final update gradient W is obtained; each client divides the W into a node updating gradient and sends the node updating gradient to a corresponding node to complete model updating; and repeating the above process until the large model converges or reaches a preset number of iterations. The client only needs to communicate with the central server, the secret sharing scheme is simple, the communication cost is low, and large model training with huge scale parameters is supported.

column12: Network security space surveying and mapping method, system and equipment based on multi-source data fusion
column13: The invention relates to the field of security surveying and mapping, in particular to a network security space surveying and mapping method, system and device based on multi-source data fusion, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining network security data in real time, and constructing a dynamic network topological graph; calculating a time-varying vulnerability score based on the topological graph and a historical attack log, and predicting an attack path and a propagation probability through a Bayesian network; performing cross-domain fusion on equipment, service and user behavior characteristics by adopting a federated learning framework to generate a dynamic asset portrait; generating a risk thermodynamic diagram in combination with spatial autocorrelation analysis and a multi-index fusion algorithm; a defense strategy effect is simulated based on an attack graph reconstruction engine, a Pareto optimal strategy combination is generated through an NSGA-II algorithm, and closed-loop verification and dynamic parameter correction are realized by utilizing honeypot deployment and flow traction. Therefore, the problems of topology update lag, single risk assessment dimension, cross-domain threat association fracture, defense strategy static stiffness, non-closed loop of a verification system and the like in the traditional technology are solved.

column13: The invention discloses an Internet of Things terminal equipment distributed authentication method for a smart city, and relates to the technical field of equipment authentication. column12: Federal learning gradient attack resistant privacy protection method and system based on block chain
column13: The invention discloses a blockchain-based federated learning gradient attack resistant privacy protection method and system, and relates to the technical field of data privacy protection. According to the invention, the problem of user privacy disclosure is effectively solved, and the problem of model precision reduction is improved.

column12: Weighted K asynchronous federated learning method, system and device based on gradient selection and adaptive learning rate
column13: The invention discloses a weighted K asynchronous federal learning method, system and device based on gradient selection and an adaptive learning rate. The method comprises the steps that a cloud initializes a model and learning rate parameters and broadcasts the current number of iterations and a current global model; and the learner receives the broadcasted model and the number of iterations for local training, and uploads the update to the cloud after the local training is completed. And after the cloud receives K updates, the model parameters are upgraded. The influence of heterogeneous data is relieved by accumulating historical gradients, the influence of delay is relieved by aggregating K gradients based on the delay degree, and a global unbiased gradient is estimated; then selecting a gradient consistent with the descending direction of the estimated gradient, and giving a weight; and further cutting the delay gradient, adjusting the learning rate, and updating and broadcasting the model parameters and the number of iterations. And repeating interaction between the cloud and the learner until the test loss of the model is less than a threshold value, and converging the model. The learning rate is adaptively adjusted according to the delay degree, and the prediction precision of the model is improved.

column12: METHODS AND PROCEDURES FOR SYNCHRONIZATION AND OVER-THE-AIR COMPUTATION
column13: A general-purpose synchronization method allows a set of software-defined radios (SDRs) to transmit or receive any in-phase/quadrature (IQ) data with precise timings while maintaining the baseband processing in the corresponding companion computers (CCs). The presently disclosed method relies on the detection of a synchronization waveform in both receive and transmit directions and controlling the direct memory access (DMA) blocks jointly with the processing system. By implementing this synchronization method on a set of low-cost SDRs, the performance of frequency-shift keying (FSK)-based majority vote (MV) (FSK-MV) is demonstrated. Stated another way, the present disclosure relates to an over-the-air computation (OAC) scheme for federated edge learning (FEEL), and corresponding procedures. Demonstration shows that test accuracy can reach more than 95% for homogeneous and heterogeneous data distributions without using channel state information at the edge devices (EDs).

column12: Personalized federal learning method based on margin constraint and credibility aggregation
column13: A personalized federal learning method based on margin constraint and credibility aggregation belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and comprises the steps of aligning a global model issued by a server with a local model of a client through knowledge distillation of a feature level, so that the client keeps learning of universal features in an updating process; setting two different boundary values under cosine measurement, wherein the two different boundary values correspond to credible distribution and suspicious distribution respectively; discriminating suspicious samples in each small batch, and applying regular terms with enlarged intervals to the features of the suspicious samples; by dynamically adjusting the weight of each client during aggregation, the client which contributes more to the global target can obtain higher weight. According to the method, the federal learning environment with strong heterogeneous and potential hostile attacks can be effectively dealt with, the positive contribution of a high-quality client to a global model can be greatly enhanced, and the interference of a malicious client or a client with poor performance is inhibited to a certain extent, so that the overall robustness of the system and the fairness among multiple clients are considered.

column12: Federal learning method and device based on blockchain
column13: The embodiment of the invention provides a federal learning method and device based on a blockchain, and the method comprises the steps: a first node carries out training an ith round of local model based on local training data, determines the gradient information of the trained (i+1) th round of local model, cuts and quantifies each piece of first sub-gradient information in the gradient information of the (i+1) th round of local model based on a gradient cutting quantization rule to obtain each piece of second sub-gradient information, merges every m pieces of second sub-gradient information in each piece of second sub-gradient information according to a gradient merging rule to obtain n types of third sub-gradient information, and performs homomorphic encryption on the n types of third sub-gradient information to obtain n types of ciphertexts, and sends the n types of ciphertexts to the blockchain. According to the method, due to the fact that the first sub-gradient information in the local model gradient information is cut, quantified and merged, and then homomorphic encryption is carried out, computing resource consumption generated by homomorphic encryption can be reduced, and network resources consumed in the ciphertext transmission process can be reduced.

column12: Inter-cloud federal learning model aggregation method and system for homomorphic encryption
column13: The invention discloses a cloud federal learning model aggregation method and system for homomorphic encryption, and the method comprises the steps: converting the gradient information of a local model of a client into a non-negative floating-point number, thereby avoiding an overflow error caused by the addition of negative numbers; and the process of converting the parameters of the local model of the client into the non-negative floating-point number does not leak the privacy of the user. All clients only send the maximum absolute value in the model parameters to the server; the server determines the maximum value in the absolute values and issues the maximum value to the client; the model parameter of the client is added with the maximum value to be converted into a non-negative floating-point number; then each non-negative floating-point number is converted into a binary number, so that the use of a quantization technology can be avoided, and the precision loss caused by model parameter quantization can be avoided; a binary number formed by splicing a batch of binary numbers is coded into a decimal number, so that the batch number can be increased to a great extent, and the communication and calculation cost caused by homomorphic encryption can be reduced.

column12: Federal learning implementation method and system, terminal equipment and readable storage medium
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning implementation method and system, terminal equipment and a readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps that a client carries out the first round of local iteration through a local neural network model, obtains a model weight and a loss value, and uploads the model weight and the loss value to a server; the server performs weighted average calculation on the model weights of the clients to obtain an average weight, and groups the clients according to the loss values of the clients; the client updates the local neural network model by using the average weight, adaptively adjusts the number of local iterations based on the median loss, and performs iterative training based on the local data to update the model weight and obtain a new loss value; and the client uploads the updated model weight and loss value to a server for circular updating. According to the method and system, the client side adjusts the local iteration frequency with the median loss value of the group where the client side is located as the standard, the local calculation complexity is effectively reduced, the federal learning efficiency is improved, knowledge distillation is further conducted through a public data set, and the model performance is improved.

column12: Open fire detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of joint learning frameworks, in particular to an open fire detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining sample data of one or more participants; performing iterative distillation of local knowledge according to the sample data of each participant, and obtaining an update parameter of a local model corresponding to each participant in each iteration process; and carrying out joint aggregation encryption on the updated parameters to obtain encrypted data, uploading the encrypted data to a joint learning engine, carrying out joint distillation by using the joint learning engine so as to carry out aggregation iteration on local model knowledge of all participants until iteration is finished, and carrying out open fire detection by using ontology models of the participants. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, a federal learning mode is adopted, privacy leakage of a user is likely to be caused, and safety is poor are solved; and for a participant with a large data volume, the aggregation efficiency of joint learning is low, so that the generated model effect is poor, and the like.

column12: Resource dynamic collaboration method and system for data training
column13: The invention discloses a resource dynamic collaboration method and system for data training, the method is used for processing industrial data, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an industrial data sample, carrying out the data distribution according to the characteristics of the industrial data sample, obtaining user data and environment data, selecting a federal learning mode according to the characteristics of the industrial data sample and initializing a data training model; and training the user data and the environment data until the global model achieves convergence. According to the method, high-dynamic and personalized requirements of user data and massive and redundant characteristics of environment data are effectively met, and the requirements of industrial learning terminal data transmission, training efficiency and the like are jointly met through dynamic collaborative scheduling of network resources.

column12: Information processing method and system
column13: The invention discloses an information processing method and system. The method comprises the steps that a collaboration party determines and obtains an intermediate model corresponding to each data provider according to a collaboration party model and issues the intermediate model to each corresponding data provider; the data provider carries out knowledge distillation on the received intermediate model used as the local model and the personalized model of the data provider according to the private data of the data provider to obtain a trained personalized model; the data provider carries out prediction through the trained personalized model according to the common data set shared by the participants to obtain output data and sends the output data to the collaboration party; and according to the output data and the public data set, the collaboration party trains a collaboration party model through knowledge distillation to obtain a target global model, and the target global model is used for executing federal learning operation in a scene that the computing resources of the data provider are less than the preset computing resources. According to the method, large model training can be effectively realized in a scene with few participant computing resources.

column12: Federal learning method for edge industrial Internet of Things
column13: The invention discloses a federal learning method for an edge industrial Internet of Things. The method comprises the following steps: S1, edge devices with different structures carry out multi-exit-point knowledge migration through a knowledge distillation algorithm; s2, performing exit point selection and bandwidth allocation based on a greedy algorithm; enabling the edge equipment to participate in model aggregation when a preset delay requirement is met; and S3, when the edge cloud server aggregates model training results uploaded by the edge devices with different structures, performing layer search update on the original model by adopting a multi-layer model averaging strategy. According to the method, a multi-exit-point mechanism based on knowledge distillation is put forward at a local device to help training of a local model, and average of a federal learning model based on multiple exit points is put forward at an edge cloud server, so that the problem of heterogeneous training results of the model uploaded by the device is effectively solved; and an exit point selection and bandwidth allocation algorithm based on a greedy algorithm is provided, so that the efficiency problem is effectively solved.

column12: Multi-task federal learning method and device for edge device
column13: The invention relates to a multi-task federal learning method and device for edge devices, and belongs to the technical field of computers. column12: Personalized edge caching method for federal forgetting enabling
column13: The invention provides a personalized edge caching method for federal forgetting enabling, and belongs to the field of edge computing. column12: Edge cloud collaborative federal digital twin model construction method based on dynamic hierarchical game
column13: The invention discloses an edge cloud collaborative federated digital twin model construction method based on a dynamic hierarchical game, and aims to construct an edge cloud collaborative federated model generation framework based on distributed sensing data to solve the problems of data islands, high time and energy overhead, poor model performance and the like existing in central dynamic digital twin model construction. And an online decision optimization problem is modeled by taking maximization of long-term model quality and reduction of long-term resource overhead as targets, and dynamic decision optimization is realized. In a federated digital twinborn model generation framework, a bottom sensor collects feature data of a physical entity and transmits the feature data to an edge server to construct a local digital twinborn model, and a cloud server collects all the local digital twinborn models and integrates the local digital twinborn models into a global digital twinborn model. According to the method, the technical problems of model heterogeneous dynamic evolution, sensor resource overlapping and sharing and computing communication resource joint optimization in federated digital twinborn construction are effectively solved, the quality of the digital twinborn model is remarkably improved, and the system energy consumption and configuration cost are reduced.

column12: FEDERATED TRAINING FOR A NEURAL NETWORK WITH REDUCED COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENT
column13: A method for generating a training contribution for a neural network on a client node for a federated training of the neural network. In the method, a complete set of parameters characterizing the behavior of the neural network is received; the parameterized neural network is supplied with training examples from a predefined set so that the neural network in each case delivers outputs, wherein the training examples are labeled with target outputs; deviations of the outputs from the respective target outputs are evaluated with a predefined cost function; the parameters of the neural network are optimized with the aim of improving the evaluation by the cost function; a set of particularly relevant parameters is selected based on a predefined criterion; for the selected parameters, proposed changes are ascertained as the sought training contribution based on the result of the optimization; the proposed changes are transmitted to a server node.

column12: Federal model training method and device
column13: The embodiment of the invention provides a federal model training method and device, and the method comprises the steps: receiving a personalized model sent by central equipment, and enabling the number of effective model parameters of the personalized model to be smaller than the number of effective model parameters of a global model; model training is conducted on the personalized model, the training gradient of the personalized model is obtained, and the training gradient comprises the gradient of each model parameter in the personalized model. According to the gradient of the personalized model, the model parameters of the personalized model and the pruning amount, a target mask sequence is determined, and the target mask sequence is used for the central device to determine the personalized model in the next round of training. And sending the target mask sequence and the training gradient of the personalized model to a central device. Wherein the personalized processing is realized by depending on a mask sequence without training an additional model, so that the calculation amount of local training in personalized federal learning can be effectively reduced.

column12: Personalized federal learning method based on trainable prototype
column13: The invention discloses a personalized federal learning method in a model heterogeneous environment based on a trainable class prototype. According to the method, a trainable global prototype generator deployed at a server side is combined with comparative learning and adversarial training to generate a high-separation global prototype, and the definition of inter-class decision boundaries is enhanced; the client side adopts a double-supervision loss function, the distance between a local prototype and a similar global prototype is shortened, the distance between the local prototype and a non-similar prototype is shortened, and data distribution deviation is relieved in combination with a classifier deviation correction module. And the server dynamically allocates the prototype weight of the client through an adaptive weight aggregation matrix, so that the influence of a low-quality prototype on global training is reduced. Experiments show that on Cifar10 and Cifar100 data sets, the classification precision of the method is improved by 1.27%-3.74% compared with that of FedTGP, and the method is suitable for privacy sensitive scenes such as intelligent medical treatment and edge computing.

column12: Verifiable federal learning smart medical privacy protection system and method
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of privacy protection, in particular to a verifiable federal learning smart medical privacy protection system and method.The system comprises a certificate authentication center, a user, an edge computing node and a cloud server, and the user is supported to independently verify the correctness of an aggregation result returned by the server without assistance of a third party. Specifically, a secure communication transmission channel is established by using a TLS protocol, the integrity in a data transmission process is ensured while a message is encrypted, and a key used for encrypting the message cannot be obtained by any one party except for two communication parties. Gradient privacy is protected by using a double-masking form, and verifiability is provided for the scheme by using a linear homomorphic hash function, so that a user can independently verify the correctness of an aggregation result returned by a server. According to the method, a dual aggregation verification mode is utilized, the computing overhead of the user side can be effectively reduced, the user is supported to exit in the training process, and extra computing burden cannot be caused to the cloud server.

column12: Traceable federal incremental learning method based on grouping feature aggregation
column13: The invention provides a traceable federal incremental learning method based on grouping feature aggregation, and relates to the technical field of federal learning, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out end node traceable task learning; carrying out local pruning and fine tuning based on the initial sharing model, and judging whether tasks are repeated or not according to label distribution similarity; s2, constructing a cloud-end side collaborative grouping model; sending the global shared knowledge generated by the server model and the aggregation weight corresponding to the global shared knowledge to the end node; s3, at the end node, the client updates own model parameters based on the local cross entropy loss, the global shared knowledge generated by the server model of each group and the aggregation weight corresponding to the global shared knowledge, and outputs the updated model; and S4, replacing the new sub-model in the S1 with the updated model or updating the sub-model, repeating the steps S1 to S3, and stopping training until specified training times are reached. The method aims to effectively cope with challenges caused by storage limitation and task repeatability.
